name: Värmlandsstafetten

price_tiers.label: tier_1
price_tiers.description: Pinnen kostar 500:- och ni får er logotyp på pinnen.

price_tiers.label: tier_2
price_tiers.description: Ordinarie anmälningsavgift fram till och med 27/4 1 500:-/lag.

price_tiers.label: tier_3
price_tiers.description: Efteranmälan Sker 29/4 på plats på arenan/växlingsområdet. Kostnad 2 000:- plus stafettpinne 750:- vid start första gången.

description: Värmlandsstafetten in Karlstad is a two-hour relay race where teams of 5 to 15 participants pass a baton around Sundstatjärn on a flat lap course approximately 1,270 to 1,300 meters long. The race starts at 6:00 PM with the goal of transporting the baton to the finish within two hours at the arena in Karlstad, with start and finish at the arena. Teams decide how many laps each person runs and switch after each lap; in the first year, a logo relay baton is purchased that follows the team each year. Register your team and participate in a social, health-promoting evening that contributes to community and team spirit.
course_highlights: Flat lap course around Sundstatjärn, approximately 1,270 - 1,300 meters per lap
Team competition for 5 - 15 participants with switching after each lap and two hours at the arena
Start and finish at the arena; option to order a logo relay baton that follows the team
additional: The course around Sundstatjärn is approximately 1,270 meters per lap (just under 1,300 meters), asphalt surface. Tents and parking are available at the arena/Sundstabadet. Start/finish at the arena; two hours to transport the baton to the finish. The course runs around Sundstatjärn in Karlstad, with each lap measuring about 1,270 meters. Each team consists of at least 5 and at most 15 participants, with the start at 6:00 PM and two hours to complete the relay and transport the baton.

name: adidas Shake Out Run
description: Get a taste of the unique marathon atmosphere by running the adidas Shake Out Run. The race is 5 km and starts and finishes at Stockholm Stadium. It is the perfect warm-up for those running the marathon the next day, but also an opportunity for non-marathon runners to experience the event weekend. The first 1,000 registrants are guaranteed an adidas t-shirt.
course_highlights: 5 km course
Start and finish at Stockholm Stadium
Perfect warm-up before the marathon
additional: The first 1,000 registered participants are guaranteed an adidas t-shirt in their chosen size (the t-shirt will be handed out during the race; others can register afterwards at the information desk to see remaining sizes). Age limit 13 years (11 years with guardian). Late registration is possible until 1 hour before the first start and can be done digitally via the regular registration website. Payment options: internet banking, Visa/MasterCard, Swish, or invoice via Klarna. Registration is binding and the registration fee is non-refundable. The event is organized by the athletics clubs Hässelby SK and Spårvägens FK. Part of the Stockholm Marathon weekend; start and finish at Stockholm Stadium; minimum age 13 years (11 years with guardian); registration fee is binding.

name: Eksjö Stadslopp
description: Eksjö City Run is a community festival in Eksjö's wooden town, held on Friday, May 29, 2026. The race offers 10 km, 5 km recreational run, as well as children's and youth races of 1000 m and 600 m, with finish at Stora Torget in the city center. The course passes through historic neighborhoods and is measured for both 10 km and 5 km. The proceeds go to Eksjö Södra IK's children's and youth activities.
course_highlights: Run through Eksjö's historic wooden town
Measured courses for 10 km and 5 km
Finish at Stora Torget in the city center
additional: Race bibs are collected at Snäckan (next to the swimming hall). Pickup: Thursday, May 28 from 17:00 to 20:00 and Friday, May 29 from 14:00; changing rooms available at Prästängshallen until 21:30 on race day. Race maps are available at Snäckan. Medals for all finishers of the 600 m or 1000 m races; plaques for all finishers of the 5 km or 10 km races. Sprint prize for the 10 km after approximately 1.2 km (first man and woman, must complete the race). Group registration via invoice at tavling.esik@gmail.com. Regular registration open until May 23, 2026; late registration from May 24 with increased fee and possible until one hour before each start via the same registration link. The proceeds go to the club's children's and youth activities. Registration via mittlopp.se; late registration from May 24 with increased fee; group registration via invoice at tavling.esik@gmail.com. Race bibs are collected at Snäckan (by the swimming hall). Courses are verified for both long and short distances.

name: Helsingborg Night Run
description: Lindahls Helsingborg Night Run is an evening race along the city's promenade offering both 5 km and 10 km on a fast, flat, and spectator-friendly course. The start and finish are at Gröningen, and the race is designed for both speed and celebration with music, lights, and a lively afterrun atmosphere. The event appeals to runners chasing personal bests as well as participants wanting an energetic running evening in Helsingborg.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Gröningen, running along Helsingborg's Strandpromenad with sea view
Fast and almost completely flat course (5 km: 2 m total elevation gain, 10 km: 4 m total elevation gain)
Surface: approximately 90% asphalt, 8% hard-packed gravel, 2% grass
additional: Number bibs can be collected at Löplabbet in Helsingborg Wednesday - Friday from 10:00 to 18:00 or on site at the start and finish area from 20:00. Bag storage opens at 20:00 and is marked with a sticker in an envelope. Löplabbet pacers are available with designated pace setters for both 5 km and 10 km. The After Run offers products from partners (including Lindahls quark, Ramlösa, alcohol-free Erdinger, Dole products) and an official afterparty with special prices at Culise. The event is certified as a World Athletics Road Race 2026 and has 1500 starting spots; participants receive an exclusive gold medal. Distance options: 5 km or 10 km. Night race with music and lights in the city’s night scenery. You can choose between timed and untimed options. For corporate registration and invoicing, a downloadable Excel file is available via the registration page. Results, start lists, and photos are available on the website.

name: Öland Lighthouse Challenge
price_range: 1490 kr/100 miles, 990 kr/50 miles, 590 kr/50 km
description: Öland Lighthouse Challenge is an ultramarathon on Öland starting at the Långe Erik lighthouse. The race options are 100 miles, 50 miles, and 50 km, and the course features coastal stretches, meadows, forest areas, and alvar landscapes with views of the Baltic Sea. The race is organized by Högby IF and offers a medal and a shirt to all finishers. Information, race briefing, maps, and GPX files are published on the race website for participants.
course_highlights: Start at Långe Erik lighthouse and coastal stretch along Kalmarsund
Alvar environments with views over the Baltic Sea as well as meadows and forest areas
Finish points: 50 km in Djupvik, 50 miles in Lindby, 100 miles at Långe Jan lighthouse
additional: Medal and shirt for all finishers; water stations/energy depots approximately every 20 km; race briefing, detailed maps, and GPX files published (race briefing updated 2026-03-13, maps updated 2026-03-12); labels for drop bags available; 15% discount on accommodation at Böda Sand (use "Lighthouse Challenge"); late registration until May 27 subject to availability and possibility to pick up race bibs/register on Friday from 13:30; payment at late registration/kiosk: cash, card, or Swish. 15% discount on Böda Sand accommodation during the weekend (use Lighthouse Challenge when booking). Registration deadline: May 22, 2026; thereafter, spots available until May 27. Late registration fees: 100 miles 1590 SEK, 50 miles 1090 SEK, 50 km 690 SEK.

name: Markaryds Sparbankloppet
location: Markaryd, Markaryds Municipality, Kronoberg County, Sweden
description: The Sparbank Race in Markaryd is organized by Markaryds FK in collaboration with Markaryds Sparbank and SK Graal. The race takes place in central Markaryd and is offered in three distances: 10 km, 5 km, and 1.6 km. The news post describes the race as recurring and refers to the organizer's and Sparbank's information page for more details and registration. The information on the club's page is brief and refers to an external page for the complete invitation and registration.
course_highlights: The course runs in central Markaryd
Three distances: 10 km, 5 km, and 1.6 km
Organized in collaboration with Markaryds Sparbank and SK Graal
additional: The news post refers to the Sparbank Race's information and registration page on the Markaryds Sparbank website. Results and photos from the 2025 Sparbank Race are linked via SK Graal. The club provides its mailing address (Snapphanestigen 10, 285 34 Markaryd) and states that the club house is located at Ola Mårtens väg 2. New for this year: free membership in 2026 for all youth. Part of the Sparbank's anniversary program 2025; the Sparbank Race is planned in conjunction with the spring market in Markaryd; a portion of the proceeds goes to participating/organizing clubs.

name: adidas Stockholm Marathon
description: adidas Stockholm Marathon is the city race that offers a new route through central Stockholm starting at Östermalms IP. The course is 42,195 meters long and measured according to the rules of the Swedish Athletics Association and IAAF. The event is organized by the athletics clubs Hässelby SK and Spårvägens FK, and any surplus funds go back to sports. The website contains participant information, course maps, and information about runner services along the route.
course_highlights: Start at Lidingövägen next to Östermalms IP
The course is 42,195 meters long and measured according to Swedish and international standards
Passes Odengatan and Sveavägen as well as landmarks such as Gunnar Asplund's City Library; world-class runner services along the route
additional: The website states that the event is organized by Hässelby SK and Spårvägens FK and that any surplus funds go back to sports; contact via customer service 08-545 66 440 (Tue-Thu 9 am - 3 pm). A PDF with the course profile, kilometer-by-kilometer description, and participant information is available on the site; the organizer emphasizes 'world-class runner services' along the route. The main page also shows a message that the 2026 event is sold out. Any surplus funds go back to sports; approximately 20,000 - 25,000 starters and 25,000 registered participants according to press releases (figures vary between sources).

name: BUM Borås Ultramaraton
description: BUM Borås Ultramarathon is an ultramarathon in Borås organized by SOK Knallen. The race offers three distances - 50 km, 21 km, and 10 km - starting and finishing at Kypegården in Borås. The organizer states that the competition follows a Backyard Ultra-like format, providing a unique race experience for runners at different levels. The race has been held since 2012 and has been run by SOK-Knallen since 2018; the 2026 event is planned for April 30 in Borås.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Kypegården in Borås
Distances of 50 km, 21 km, and 10 km
Backyard Ultra-like format
additional: SOK Knallen does not list email addresses on the contact page but provides payment details: Plusgiro 38 64 13 9 and Swish 123 671 50 49. The club also organizes Borås 6-hour race (circular track 1.892 m, packed gravel with about 30 m asphalt; almost completely flat) and Knallen's Backyard Ultra (start interval announced 08:00 - 19:00). In the information for Borås 6-hour race, race director Torbjörn Svensson can be reached at 0703-15 26 70 and Lars Karlsson at 0709-66 46 92. Club address: SOK Knallen C/O Lars Karlsson, Åsbogatan 20, 50456 Borås. The race is organized by SOK Knallen; the event focuses on runners of various levels and has historically been seen as part of the Borås ultrarunning scene. The 2024 information sheet and previous posts mention updated details and organizer guidelines.

name: Växjöloppet
description: Welcome to Växjöloppet on May 1, 2026 - a running festival for the whole family with distances from children's races up to half marathon. The event offers 5 km, 10 km, 21.1 km, and Little Växjöloppet for younger participants. Start and finish are at Strandbjörket with start on Värendsgatan outside Strandbjörkshallen; the course features both forest paths through the scenic Bokhultet and asphalt stretches around Växjösjön. The half marathon is run as two laps on essentially the same course, providing both variation and spectator-friendly finishes.
course_highlights: Start on Värendsgatan outside Strandbjörkshallen
Scenic course passing Bokhultet (mainly deciduous forest) and transitioning to forest trail after the first kilometer
The last approximately 3.5 km are asphalt around Växjösjön with a finish on Lagunvallen
additional: Distances: 5 km, 10 km, 21.1 km, and several children's distances in Little Växjöloppet (no individual timing for children's races). The 21.1 km is completed as two laps (the first lap just over 11 km, the second 10 km). Hydration stations: at 10 km there are four stations (after 1 km, 3 km, 5.5 km, and 6.5 km); at 21.1 km there are opportunities for fluids eight times (e.g., 1, 3, 5.5, 6.5, 10, 13, 15.5, 16.5 km). Little Växjöloppet: participants in some children's races receive bib numbers, medals, and fruit; The Newspaper Run offers a T-shirt and diploma. It is possible to use a wellness allowance for registration (registration via mittlopp.se and receipt can be used against the employer's wellness benefit). Team competitions are available; start lists and participant information can be found on the official website. The distances are 5 km, 10 km, 21.1 km, and Little Växjöloppet; hydration stations along the course (4 on 10 km; up to 8 on 21.1 km); Bokhultet station closes at 13:40 and tunnel/Växjösjön station closes at 14:00; finish closes at 14:30.

name: Västerås Marathon
description:
NEW RACE 2026

Västerås Marathon offers three distances — 42 km, 21 km, and 10 km — on a flat and fast course through the city center and beautiful Mälaren shores. The course is a loop where you run 10 km per lap.
Experience the joy of running in a well-organized race for all levels.

The race is intended for everyone who enjoys running, from beginners to elite athletes. All ages and paces are welcome, and we will have ample time to complete the race.

Warm welcome!
course_highlights: Flat and fast course along Mälaren's shoreline with little elevation variation
Passes Lögarängsbadet, Aseatornet, Turbinhuset, Isbrytaren, The Steam Hotel, Athletics Hall, and the graffiti wall
The race runs counterclockwise with a tricky tunnel section and the steepest hill about 400 m from the start
additional: Number bib distribution and baggage drop-off open from 07:00 at the City Hall Restaurant. Water stations: 2 at 10 km, 4 at half marathon, and 8 at marathon; water and sports drinks (Umara) are offered along the course. Toilets are available at the start at Fiskartorget and public toilets after approximately 2 km and 9 km. The central station is about 300 m from the start/finish; parking is available in the city and several parking garages. Starts can be conducted in groups/waves (e.g., 21k-A 10:00, 21k-B 10:05). Access to seedings for Stockholm Marathon, timing with C-time, pacers (including virtual pacers for 3 h, 3.5 h, and 4 h; contact for other pacers), start around 09:00, planned finish time 16:30 with a maximum of 7h30m. The roads pass among other landmarks such as Lögarängsbadet and other Västerås landmarks; water stations: 2 at 10 km, 4 at half marathon, and 8 at marathon. A children's race in Vasaparken is also mentioned in sources.

images.alt_text: Affisch för Västerås Marathon 2026 med löpare och en glad gurka.
Västerås Marathon 2026 med löpare, publik och stadssilhuett.
Västerås Marathon logotyp med löpare och en gurka.

name: Pop up Run Åkulla bokskogar
location: Öströö Fårfarm, Rolfstorp, Varbergs kommun, Sweden

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Pris: 300 kr, picknick på Öströö Fårfarm Café ingår

description: Welcome to Pop up Run Åkulla Beech Forests - a guided run of 15 - 17 km through the fairy-tale beech landscape at Åkulla. We run past small lakes, Bexell's "talking" stones, and through dense beech forest, in 2 - 3 pace groups so everyone can keep up. After the run, we finish with a locally produced picnic at Öströö Sheep Farm Café. We recommend carpooling and can help coordinate this.
course_highlights: Running inside Åkulla's beech forest
Passing by small cozy lakes
Bexell's "talking" stones along the route
additional: Gathering at 10:00 AM at Öströö Sheep Farm. Distance 15 - 17 km with 2 - 3 different pace groups. Picnic at Öströö Sheep Farm Café included in the price. The organizer recommends carpooling and offers assistance with coordination. Carpooling is recommended and can be arranged; picnic/meals at Öströö Sheep Farm Café after the run.

name: WINTER BAY Backyard Ultra 2026
description: WINTER BAY Backyard Ultra is a welcoming Backyard Ultra race held in Trekantsparken, Liljeholmen in Stockholm, organized by Run Raisers with proceeds for #Run4Diabetes. The race takes place on a 6.7 km loop around Trekanten and Vinterviken with mixed terrain and a new start every full hour; participants must complete the loop within 1 hour to start the next. The event offers an energy station, medal, goodie bag, and organizer support throughout the race. The start is at 14:00 on May 1, 2026.
course_highlights: 6.7 km loop around Trekanten and Vinterviken (start/finish in Trekantsparken, near Liljeholmen metro station)
Mixed terrain: trails with wooden bridges, gravel roads, and paved walk/cycle paths
A steep uphill at Örnberget and illuminated trail along Vinterviken
additional: Registration opens August 1. Name changes can be made until April 17, 2026, for a fee of 150 SEK (done via info@runraisers.com with new participant details). Bib distribution takes place on Thursday, April 30. Race format: mass start every full hour; those who do not complete the loop within 1 hour are out. The registration fee includes an energy station, race photos, medal, and goodie bag; 20% of the fee goes to #Run4Diabetes. The race is a charity event supporting Run4Diabetes; 20% of the registration fee is donated to Run4Diabetes; includes aid station, medal, race photos, goodie bag, and prizes for winners.

name: Hallandsloppet Trail
description: Hallandsloppet Trail is a family-friendly trail run in scenic areas around Vessigebro with start and finish at Gurkbänken on Brovallen. The race offers adult categories of 5 km and 10 km as well as several children's categories (1,000 m and 2,000 m). Start times are adjusted for families: children start at 10:00, adults at 11:00, and participants with dogs start in waves from 11:30. Registration is done via the RaceID app/website or by emailing the organizer according to the information on the page.
course_highlights: The race takes place on trails and in forests in scenic areas around Vessigebro
Start and finish at Gurkbänken at Brovallen in central Vessigebro
Adult distances of 5 km and 10 km; children's categories at 1,000 m and 2,000 m
additional: Children start at 10:00. Adult start at 11:00 for participants without dogs; participants with dogs start in waves with 1-minute intervals from 11:30. It is allowed to start with a dog - send a message to kontakt@hallandsloppet.se for registration in the dog start. Registration can be made via the RaceID app or website, or via email with personal details if you do not want a RaceID profile. Registration via RaceID; a Facebook post mentions that the entry fee will be increased soon.

name: Sevede Trail Run
description: Sevede Trail Run is a welcoming trail race in Mariannelund organized by Hässleby SOK. The race offers a challenging course mostly run on narrow trails in the beautiful Småland landscape - through dark, fairy-tale forests, along lakes, and over long cliffs with fast downhill sections. There are categories for men and women at 10 km and 26 km, as well as a children's race of about 1 km. Everyone is welcome to register until race day; the children's race is free and awards a medal at finish.
course_highlights: Mostly narrow trails in Småland landscape
Through dark, fairy-tale forests and along lakes
Long cliffs and fast downhill sections
additional: Registration opens at 08:00 at Slättvallen in Mariannelund. Registration is via email to sevedetrailrun@hotmail.com and payment is accepted via Swish (123-358 26 99). Late registration can be done on-site on race day. The children's race is about 1 km, all children run for free and receive a medal and a banana at the finish; a parent can accompany the child. Distance options: 26 km and 10 km; start window Saturday 10:00 - 16:00; contact: sevedetrailrun@hotmail.com; 2025 estimated number of participants approximately 45; 2024 women's course record at 26 km is 2:10:07 by Emelie Braf; children's race with many participants; results and photos are available.

name: Änggårdsbergen Trailrun
location: Karlsrofältet, Linnéplatsen, Botaniska Trädgården, Göteborg, Sweden
description: Änggårdsbergen Trailrun is a 12.5 km trail race in Göteborg's nature reserve Änggårdsbergen, organized by Språng Träning & Äventyr. The single-lap course offers technical trails, hills, and several viewpoints — a true trail race in the middle of the city. The race suits both those who want to push themselves and those who want to enjoy nature; start and finish are located at Karlsrofältet near Linnéplatsen/Botaniska trädgården. The organizer welcomes participants with a focus on adventure and nature experiences.
course_highlights: Technical trails, hills, and fast downhill sections
Varied terrain: soft, rocky, and moss-covered trails as well as shorter gravel sections
Several viewpoints overlooking the sea and central Göteborg, in a nature reserve in the city
additional: Start and finish at Karlsrofältet (about 300 meters from Linnéplatsen/Botaniska trädgården). Registration in three start groups: 11:00, 11:03, and 11:06. Bibs can be collected from 09:30 on race day; start numbers will also be sent via SMS on Friday. Trail shoes with a sturdy sole are recommended; spike shoes are prohibited. A water station is available approximately halfway and at the finish line; energy partner Moonvalley offers sports drinks and bars. A wooden medal inspired by Vitsippsdalen will be awarded to all participants. There is an option to change name or transfer the start place via Eq-Timing for 100 SEK (name change/transfer no later than April 27). Test runs are offered (March 21: hill technique; April 12: full course trial run). Start and finish at Karlsrofältet near Linnéplatsen/Botaniska trädgården. Start groups at 11:00, 11:03, and 11:06. Trail shoes with a sturdy sole are recommended; spike shoes are forbidden. Bibs are collected from 09:30 in the event area at Karlsrofältet. Medals for all participants. Water station approximately halfway. Moonvalley as energy partner. Medical staff available at the finish area. Transfer of start place via Eq-Timing for 100 SEK. Transportation options include tram to Linnéplatsen/Botaniska trädgården and bus to Linnéplatsen. Parking around Slottsskogen; avoid parking in Änggården's residential area. Children from 8 years old can run with a guardian; the guardian is responsible for the child.

name: Trosa Ultra Backyard 2026
description: Trosa Ultra Backyard is a Backyard Ultra on a light and fast lap course in central Trosa where each lap is 6.706 km and the race continues as long as participants can complete a lap within one hour. The start is on May 2, 2026 at 10:00 AM and the concept follows the Backyard format: those who complete a lap within an hour can start again until only one participant remains. The race is open to the public and family-friendly with Mini-TUB for children (start at 12:15 PM) and awards for the top three in men's and women's categories. The organizer offers sports drinks, fruit, sandwiches at the lap change, and has ongoing raffles during the race.
course_highlights: Lap of 6.706 km (large course)
Mostly follows the Trosaån and is very easy and flat (approximately <10 meters elevation gain)
Mini-TUB: approximately 700 m course for children (MiniTUB follows the large course 700 m before deviation)
additional: Start and finish at Västra hamnplan in Trosa; livestream on Facebook page Trosa Ultra Backyard; Mini-TUB sponsored by Camfil; team competition where the top three results count for each club (the club with the top three gets 20% discount next year); tent spaces outside the start area; limited motorhome spaces; no caravan spaces; food and energy support during the race (candy, sports drinks, fruit) and Selfie-Corner after the race; free silicone mug from Umara for all main race participants.

name: Nordens Ark TrailRun
description: Nordens Ark TrailRun is a family-friendly trail race at Nordens Ark organized in collaboration with IK Granit. The courses suit all levels - from 1 km for the youngest to a challenging 30 km for the most enduring - and wind through Ekoparken. The race is highlighted as a folk festival for both participants and spectators, where you can enjoy the park's scenic surroundings and the arrival of spring. Warm welcome to Nordens Ark TrailRun - see you at the starting line!
course_highlights: Courses winding through Ekoparken (forest terrain around Åby säteri)
Routes for all levels: from 1 km up to 30 km
Scenic views and spring atmosphere in Nordens Ark's surroundings
additional: Organizer: IK Granit in collaboration with Nordens Ark. Location: Nordens Ark / Åby säteri (Zooliden). The event is described as a folk festival for participants and spectators. Park entrance tickets are purchased on site (see Nordens Ark's opening hours and prices). Courses from 1 km to 30 km through Ekoparken; the organizer IK Granit is responsible for the race; Paralympic classes are available.

name: Kanallöpet
organizer: Borensbergs IF, OK Skogsströvarna och Vreta SoMK
description: Kanallöpet is a welcoming running event along the Göta Canal between Ljungsbro and Borensberg, open to competitive runners, recreational runners, and families. In 2026, a half marathon (competitive and recreational categories), as well as 10 km and 5 km recreational races, will be offered, and this year's edition has DM/VDM status for the half marathon. The start is at 13:00 at each starting point, and the finish line is at the sports ground Bergvallen in Borensberg. The race is promoted as a competition in beautiful Swedish nature and also offers team registration.
course_highlights: The race follows Göta Canal between Ljungsbro and Borensberg
Finish at the sports ground Bergvallen in Borensberg
Scenic stretch in beautiful Swedish nature along the canal route
additional: Transport: buses are arranged from Borensberg to each start location (half marathon to Ljungsbro, 10 km to Sjöbacka, 5 km to Brunneby) and are booked/paid for during registration (no transport offered after the finish; seat on race day possible subject to availability). The bus fare listed on registration pages is 100 SEK. Team registration: teams of 5 runners, all in the same category; price per runner is 20% lower than individual registration, and team registration can only be done online. Bib numbers are collected at each start location. Registration is valid only after payment is received; if payment is not received within 10 days, the registration is canceled. A detailed information sheet (PM) will be provided later. Start locations: 21 km from Ljungsbro, 10 km from Sjöbacka bridge, 5 km from Brunneby Musteri; bus to the start from Borensberg; registration via Swish or bank transfer; late registration between 11:30 - 12:30 with increased price; bib-laps are collected at the start location.

name: SäterMaran (inkl. DM i halvmaraton)
description: SäterMaran is organized by Säters IF FIK and welcomes runners to the race in Säter. On the club's website, there is an invitation with the course route, PM, start list, and results from previous years. The information is published by the club on the SäterMaran page and in news. The club encourages participants to review the PM/timetable before the race.
course_highlights: Course route published (see invitation/course route)
PM and start list available on the event page
Results from 2025 and earlier years published
additional: Invitations, course route, PM, and start list are published on the SäterMaran page; results from previous years are collected. The website mentions an attached document with the invitation/registration. Official hashtag for the club: #sätersfriidrott. Contact via the club's office (siffriidrott@telia.com) and responsible web contacts are listed on the contact page. In the 2024 results lists for SäterMaran, information about half marathon (DM) and marathon competitions as well as various age classes is included, indicating that both distances may be offered within the race.

name: Vårruset (Halmstad)
location: Civila flygfältet vid Aleskogen i Halmstad, Sweden
description: VårRuset Halmstad will be held on May 6, 2026, at the Civil Airfield near Aleskogen in Halmstad. The event offers distances of 2.5 km and 5 km, with the 5 km route being measured and timing included. A medal, goody bag, and bib are included for individual participants, while team registration includes a picnic after the finish line, as well as a medal and quiz/prizes. Registration is digital, and the last day to register is on race day, at least 1 hour before the first start; age recommendations follow the distances and adult accompaniment. Vårruset is organized by Marathongruppen in collaboration with several athletics clubs; the event emphasizes an inviting, family-friendly atmosphere with opportunities for social activities afterward.
course_highlights: 2.5 or 5 km course at the Civil Airfield near Aleskogen
Timing on the 5 km route, plus medal and bib
Team registration with a picnic after the finish line, plus Vårruset music quiz and prizes
additional: Digital registration; last registration day is on race day, at least 1 hour before the first start. Age recommendations: 5 km up to 13 years (11 years with adult); 2.5 km up to 11 years (7 years with adult). Team registration offers an extra benefit of a picnic after the finish. Teams of 5 persons are offered a picnic after the finish line; all registrations include a medal and goody bag. Timing on the 5 km route is optional (can be opted out of), and registration can be done on race day, at least 1 hour before the first start.

name: Avloppet
location: Sobacken Energi- och Miljöcenter, Borås, Sweden
description: The Drain Run is a short race of 5 km held in connection with the Kretsloppet in Borås and is organized in collaboration with Borås Energi och Miljö. Registration and payment are made directly on the organizer's website until race day, and the rules of the Swedish Athletics Association apply. The starting field is limited (max 150 participants) and the organizer offers optional chip timing. Event information and confirmation are sent to the email address provided at registration.
course_highlights: 5 km distance with a hilly gravel course
Unique theme where the course runs out towards the sewer pipes to Sobacken Energy and Environment Center
Limited starting field (max 150 participants) with parking at Sobacken
additional: Chip timing is available as an option; if the chip is not returned, a fee of 200 SEK is charged. Results are published on the Kretsloppet website and parking is available at Sobacken.

tiers.label: tier_2

description: VAIS Race is a pleasant cross-country race in the Fylleryd nature reserve organized by Växjö AIS every spring and autumn. There are two distances, 8.4 km and 4.4 km, where the long course follows large parts of the Trestugespåret trail and becomes hilly towards the end, while the short course follows the illuminated trail. The start for both courses is at VAIS-torpet at 6:30 PM, and the event concludes with coffee. The race is free for members of Växjö AIS; for non-members, the registration fee is 50 kronor.
course_highlights: Hilly trail through the Fylleryd nature reserve
Long course (8.4 km) follows large parts of Trestugespåret and is particularly hilly at the end
Short course (4.4 km) follows the illuminated trail and both courses end with a long uphill section towards VAIS-torpet
additional: The race instructions will be published on April 28; map and course profile are available as PDF; registration is indicated to open via a form (new tab) on the event page; the event concludes with coffee at VAIS-torpet. Cross-country race in Fyllerydsskogen with start and finish at VAIS-torpet; spring and autumn events; membership affects the participation fee.

name: Vårruset Uppsala
description: Vårruset Uppsala is a women's fitness run organized by the Marathongruppen in Uppsala on May 7, 2026. The race offers distances of 2.5 km and 5 km with start and finish at Studenternas IP. Participants can register as individuals or as part of a team of five people, and timing can be opted out for a simpler experience. After crossing the finish line, teams are offered a picnic and the focus is on community.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Studenternas IP in Uppsala
Distances of 2.5 km and 5 km
Team registration (5 people) or individual participation with optional timing
additional: Distances: 2.5 km and 5 km; open to women of all ages; digital registration; early registrations encouraged; team consisting of five people; after the finish, a picnic is offered to the team. Distance options are 2.5 km or 5 km (5 km is measured); start and finish at Studenternas IP. Team registrations (teams of 5) are provided with a picnic after the finish; registration can be made until race day, no later than 1 hour before the first start, and timing can be opted out.

name: Vårruset Vänersborg
description: Vår Ruset Vänersborg is part of Sweden's largest fitness tour for women and is held on Thursday, May 7, 2026, starting and finishing at Sanden along Vassbottenleden. Participants can choose between a 2.5 km or a certified 5 km course; timing is optional at registration. Group registrations of five people are offered a picnic after the finish, making the event social and family-friendly. The event is organized by Marathongruppen in collaboration with Vänersborgs SK and is open to exercisers of all ages according to recommended age limits.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Sanden (Vassbottenleden)
Selectable distances: 2.5 km or certified 5 km course
Friendly team spirit - picnic after the finish for teams of 5 people
additional: What is included (individual registration): medal, finish bag, Vårruset music quiz + prizes, timing for those who choose it, and bib. For team registration (5 persons): picnic after the finish, medal, finish bag, timing (if selected), and bib. Recommended age: 2.5 km: 11 years (7 years with adult); 5 km: 13 years (11 years with adult). Registration is digital and can be done until race day (at least 1 hour before the first start). Contact via Vänersborgs SK: varruset.vbg@gmail.com; Vårruset main phone: +46 8 545 66 440 (Tue - Thu 09:00 - 15:00). The surface is partly asphalt and partly gravel, both flat and easily accessible. Distance options: 2.5 km or 5 km (certified 5 km course). For individual registrations, included are medal, finish bag, and music quiz/prizes; for team registrations, included are picnic after the finish, medal, and finish bag. Registration can be completed digitally until race day, at least 1 hour before the first start.

name: Run for Change
description: Run for Change is Hand in Hands running initiative where each kilometer is linked to the work to combat poverty, with a particular focus on women's entrepreneurship in Kenya. The initiative functions both as a virtual running journey where participants log kilometers in a shared Strava club and as a way to highlight the organization's work during larger running events. You can participate whenever and wherever you want - run, walk, or cycle - thereby contributing to fundraising and spreading knowledge. The initiative often culminates in a final event in connection with the Stockholm Marathon, where Run for Change is visible at the expo and in the race.
course_highlights: Virtual distance - run whenever and wherever you want
Participate in the organization's Strava Club where every kilometer counts
Final and visibility through Stockholm Marathon (previous finals have been held there)
additional: Participation is flexible - you can run, walk, or cycle and log your kilometers in a shared Strava club; Run for Change uses a temporary tattoo as a symbol and has previously had a booth at the Stockholm Marathon expo; the initiative aims both for fundraising and to spread awareness about Hand in Hands work with women's entrepreneurship. Virtual run with Strava Club; fundraising and awareness around entrepreneurship as well as support for Hand in Hands work in Kenya; the final has previously taken place in connection with the Stockholm Marathon

name: Östgötatidningen Mjölby Stadslopp

description: Östgötatidningen Mjölby Stadslopp is a family-friendly fun run starting and finishing in Stadsparken in Mjölby. The main race is six kilometers through the city, there is also KyrkRundan of about three kilometers and a free children's race. The event features music and activities along the course and is a local community celebration encouraging walking, jogging, and running. Welcome to a day of movement, socializing, and joy on Saturday, May 9, 2026.
course_highlights: Six kilometers with start and finish in Stadsparken in Mjölby
Approximately half of the course runs close to Svartån
99 percent asphalt; some challenging uphill sections and the last kilometer through Mjölby center towards Gästisparken
additional: Race bibs are collected at Intersport on Friday, May 8 from 12:00 to 18:00 (discount coupon 25% upon pickup). Uncollected race bibs are handed out in Stadsparken no later than one hour before the start. The top flap on the bib is the chip - without it, no time will be registered. Late registration is open from April 30 to May 7 via the website and can also be done at the bib distribution on May 8 or in Stadsparken on May 9 (only Swish). Warm-up is provided by Fitness4You; the event offers refreshments from ICA Supermarket Mjölby and water/sports drinks from Finspångs Brunnsborrning. The number of participants has been high previously, with 1074 runners reported; registration for 2026 opens and results and record descriptions will be published by organizing media.

name: Strandmilen
description: Strandmilen is a local running event in Hultsfred that takes place along Lake Hulingen on a nice, flat course. There is a 10 km course and two children's distances, and the organizers welcome both club and recreational runners. Children can also register for the longer course if they wish. For more information, the organizer refers to the race information sheet on the race website.
course_highlights: Flat course along Lake Hulingen
10 km for adults and two different children's races
Friendly family-oriented race environment at Herrstorpet
additional: The children's races start at 10:00 AM and the 10 km race starts at 11:00 AM. You do not need to belong to a club to participate. The organizer refers to a race information sheet for more details. The children's race starts at 10:00 AM according to the schedule; Strandmilen is part of Herrstorpet's new building day with dressage cycling, guided tours, and concerts in the morning.

name: Kungsholmen Runt
description: Kungsholmen Runt is a running race on Kungsholmen in Stockholm offering the distances of a half marathon and 10 km. The event is described as a folk festival and the courses are flat and fast, suitable for those aiming to beat their personal best. The website provides information about the course, a course map, details about the start/finish area, and a kids' race for children.
course_highlights: Flat and fast course suitable for PB
Distance options: half marathon and 10 km
Course map available; course runs around Kungsholmen and includes a kids' race
additional: The website contains a course map, information about the start/finish area, and offers a kids' race for children. Start and finish at Rålambshov Park; distances of 10 km and half marathon; member discount on registration fee; registration via link.

name: Gotaleden Stafett & Ultra
description: Gotaleden Relay & Ultra is a completely new running and relay event taking place on May 9, 2026. Four races are offered along the scenic Gotaleden between Gothenburg and Alingsås - including individual distances (35 km and 75 km) and team relays (35/75 km) with stages ranging from approximately 4.5 to 12 km. The races feature varied terrain and beautiful nature, and the finish line at Nolhaga Park becomes a celebration with prize ceremonies, food trucks, showers, and After Run. The event caters to everyone from recreational runners to experienced ultrarunners.
course_highlights: The course follows Gotaleden between Gothenburg and Alingsås with beautiful nature and industrial environments
Varying terrain: trails, gravel, and asphalt
The ultramarathon has a significant total elevation gain (approx. 1,403 m) and peaks at ~185 m above sea level
additional: Age limits: Relay (35/75) from 14 years, Ultra 75 and Sprint 35 from 17 years. Relay 75 consists of 9 stages (2 - 9 persons per team) with stages 4.5 - 12 km; Relay 35 has 4 stages (2 - 4 persons). Ultra 75: 75 km, terrain includes asphalt/gravel/trail, 16 water stations and food station in Floda; Sprint 35: 35 km, 7 water stations. Stage starts are located near public transport, and the organizer offers the possibility to book a bus to the start via registration. The finish at Nolhaga Park features prize ceremonies, food, showers, and After Run. The races start in Gothenburg (Valhalla IP) and in Floda (Garveriet) for the sprint, with different start points along Gotaleden. After the finish, a celebration and After Run await, as well as a training weekend at Öijared Resort in March 2026 before the race weekend.

name: Koster Trail
location: Kosterhavets Ekobod, Västra Bryggan, Nordkoster, Sweden

tiers.label: tier_1

description: Koster Trail is a challenging trail race in the Kosterhavet National Park, taking place this year on Saturday, May 9, 2026, celebrating its 5th anniversary. The race is held on Nordkoster and offers Bohuslänian cliffs, sandy beaches, trails, and several magical viewpoints along a approximately 15 km course. After finishing, participants can relax with a salt bath and food at Kosterhavets Ekobod. The race is organized by Kosterhavets Ekobod in collaboration with local actors and has a limited number of starting places (200).
course_highlights: Approximately 15 km along the coast on Nordkoster (trails, sandy beaches, and cliffs)
Technically advanced course with sections of stones and cliffs and many viewpoints
Start and finish at Kosterhavets Ekobod near Västra Bryggan; two water stations along the course
additional: Start and finish at Kosterhavets Ekobod at Västra Bryggan on Nordkoster. The course is coordinated with Kosterhavet National Park and the race has only 200 starting spots. Two water stations serve water and the sports drink U Sport from Umara. Bib numbers can be collected on Friday, May 8, from 18:00 to 20:00 or on race day from 10:00. After finishing, pizza from Artisan Bread Karlstad and beer from Qvänum Brewery are served. No shower facilities are available at the finish; luggage storage is available at the start/finish. Participants need accident and liability insurance. Travel and accommodation tips are linked on the race website. Max 200 participants; age limit 18+; start and finish at Kosterhavets Ekobod near Västra Bryggan on Nordkoster; after the race, pizza and fine beer are served; water stations along the course; registration opens January 10, 2026, at 10:00 via RaceID; results via RaceID.

name: BUGGIS BACKYARD ULTRA 12h
description: Buggis Backyard Ultra 12H is a 12-hour backyard ultra held in Buggamåla, Holmsjö. The course runs on well-marked trails through forests and along gravel roads; the track is flat but technically challenging with roots, rocks, and slopes. The race offers scenic views by lakes and is organized by Karlskrona Judoklubb.
course_highlights: Well-marked trails through forests
Flat but technically challenging course with roots, rocks, slopes, and gravel roads
Beautiful views by lakes and natural surroundings without background noise
additional: Organizer: Karlskrona Judoklubb (contact via email). The course is marked and runs on trails and gravel roads; the terrain is technical with roots and rocks and offers scenic lake views. Date: 2026-05-09; Location: Buggamåla 114, Holmsjö, Sweden.

name: Åstöloppet Trail
description: Åstöloppet Trail is a welcoming trail run through Åstön Nature Reserve, scheduled for May 9, 2026. The event offers four distances (1 km, 4 km, 8 km, and 14 km) and features a mix of wide forest trails, technical sections, and unpaved terrain. Start and finish are at Skeppshamn, promising a scenic finish by the sea, suitable for both beginners and experienced trail runners. The organizer is Tynderö IK, and the race director can be reached via the provided contact address.
course_highlights: Four distances: 1 km, 4 km, 8 km, and 14 km
Mix of wide forest trails, technical sections, and unpaved terrain
Start and finish at Skeppshamn with coastal views in Åstöns Nature Reserve
additional: Date: May 9, 2026. Distances: 1 km, 4 km, 8 km, 14 km. Start and finish at Skeppshamn in Åstöns Nature Reserve. Race director Linus can be reached via race.tyndero@gmail.com. The event premiered in 2025, and results from 2025 are published on the website. The distances for Åstöloppet Trail are 1 km, 4 km, 8 km, and 14 km. The terrain consists of wide forest trails, technical sections, and unpaved terrain along Åstöns Nature Reserve. Registration is done via the link on the organizer's page.

name: Kolmårdstrailen
location: Kolmården, Norrköping Municipality, Östergötland County, Sweden

description: The Kolmårdstrail is a hilly and experience-focused trail run in the scenic Kolmården with technical trails, rocky outcrops, and many elevation meters. You can choose between courses of approximately 21 km, 11 km, and 6 km (as well as a children’s course of 500 m). The course is described as challenging but close to nature - passing through Rödgölens Nature Reserve and offering fine views from Kolmården’s highest point. The organizer emphasizes the experience and provides services such as a water station and the option to download GPX data for your watch.
course_highlights: Hilly, technical trail terrain with many elevation meters and rocky outcrops
Passes Rödgölens Nature Reserve and Ågelsjön; Kolmården’s highest point (171 m above sea level) with a view
Small trails and single tracks, wooden bridge over marsh areas, rope in the “koklämman”, and a final tough/partially unpaved kilometer
additional: Regular registration until May 3; late registration online until May 6 and thereafter on site (race day) from 09:00 to 11:00, payment in cash or via Swish. GPX data for the courses can be downloaded. Water stations are available after approximately 7.5 km at the Scout Cabin. A children’s run of about 500 m is available for children up to 10 years old. For the Kolmården Night Trail: bring a headlamp, the course is marked with reflectors, no shower facilities, and chanterelle soup is served at the finish. The organizer offers cancellation and accident insurance as an optional add-on. Kolmården races in the series include Kolmården Vertical (5 km, 300 meters of elevation), Swimrun Kolmården, Kolmården Night Trail (9 km), and Luciatåget (7.5 km). Results are available online, and several distances are emphasized during the event.

name: Östhammars Stadslopp
description: Stadsloppet 2026 is organized by Östhammars Friidrott and will take place on Saturday, May 9, 2026, starting at Frösåkersvallen in Östhammar. The event is presented on the club's competition page and is aimed at local runners and participants in the nearby area. When registering, necessary contact information is collected for race administration and result publication, and images from the event may be used in the club's channels.
course_highlights: Start at Frösåkersvallen in Östhammar
additional: The club informs that contact details provided during registration are used for race contact and that name, age, and results may be stored for result lists and race statistics. Images from the event may be used on the club's website, Facebook, and Instagram; participants can contact the club to request removal. Club membership for 2026 is managed via Svenska Lag. The website contains start lists, registration, and results for Stadsloppet 2025.

name: SHE Silverlöpet

description: SHE Silverlöpet is a restart of the classic Silverlöpet, organized in collaboration with SHE. The race runs through Sala city center and in beautiful surroundings with start and finish in Stadsparken. You can choose 10 km (officially measured), 5 km, or a children's race of 2 km - the race is open to everyone and presented as a community festival with medals for all participants.
course_highlights: Through Sala city center and around Sala's beautiful environment
Start and finish in Stadsparken, Sala
The 10 km course is officially measured
additional: Registration is done via Mitt Lopp (opens 2026-03-01). Online registration is valid until early May; late registration takes place on site on 9/5 (5 - 10 km: 08:00 - 09:00, children's 2 km: 08:00 - 09:15). Prices and awards: medals for all participants; prizes for 1st-3rd place in women and men in the 10 km; raffles for the 5 km. Restart of Silverlöpet in Sala; the last race was held in 1999; distances are 5 km and 10 km. The event is announced by Sala-Heby Energi AB in collaboration with IFK Sala.

name: Spångaloppet
location: Spånga IP, Spånga, Stockholm Municipality, Stockholm County, Sweden
description: Spångaloppet is a local running race organized by Spånga/Bromstens Bandy Club, scheduled for May 9, 2026. The race offers courses for different ages and levels, including 10 km and 5 km through beautiful natural areas and past Spånga center, as well as a 2 km course for younger runners and a 400 m kids' race. The start and finish for all races are at Spånga IP. Everyone is welcome to participate, and registration is done via RaceID under Spångaloppet 2026.
course_highlights: 10 km and 5 km through beautiful natural areas and Spånga center
2 km course for younger runners and a 400 m kids' race
Start and finish at Spånga IP for all races
additional: Registration is via RaceID under "Spångaloppet 2026". Contact for questions: spangaloppet@sbbk.nu. All races start and finish near Spånga IP. Registration via RaceID; questions to spangaloppet@sbbk.nu.

name: Vellinge Beer Run
description: Welcome to Vellinge Beer Run 2026 - a friendly and inclusive fitness run that combines running with local beer culture. The race is 5 kilometers long and starts and ends at Vellinge Brewery in central Vellinge. The start is at 12:00 PM on May 9, 2026, and the course takes you through beautiful surroundings in the Vellinge area. After the finish, beer tasting is offered at the brewery, and the event is suitable for both experienced runners and beginners seeking a social and fun challenge.
course_highlights: 5 kilometer fitness run
Start and finish at Vellinge Brewery (Kompanigatan 18)
The course goes through beautiful surroundings in the Vellinge area
additional: Date and time: May 9, 2026, start at 12:00 PM. Start/finish: Vellinge Brewery, Kompanigatan 18, 235 32 Vellinge. After the finish, beer tasting is offered at Vellinge Brewery. The race is described as suitable for all levels - both experienced runners and beginners. Date: May 9, 2026. The race emphasizes social gathering and local beer culture as core elements of the experience.

name: Åre Halvmarathon
location: Duved, Åre Municipality, Jämtland County, Sweden
description: Åre Half Marathon is held in Åre Municipality and is an annual trail/road race in mountain environment. The second edition offers the main race of a half marathon as well as shorter options for runners who want to run 5 km, and two children's races (300 m and 1.7 km). The event is presented by Åre Municipality and is aimed at both recreational runners and families. More information and registration are available via the event's website.
course_highlights: Race in magnificent mountain environment
Main distance is a half marathon; also 5 km
Children's races of 300 m and 1.7 km
additional: The event is listed as the second edition and is scheduled for May 24, 2025, from 09:30 to 14:00. Organizer/information text is published by Åre Municipality; registration is referred to the event's own website. The date for Åre Half Marathon 2026 is May 9; the distances include half marathon, 5 km, and two children's races (300 m and 1.7 km); start times are approximately 09:30 - 14:00 and registration takes place via the event's website.

name: Älmhult Fights Cancer
description: Älmhult Fights Cancer is a charity run in Älmhult that raises money for the fight against cancer. The race is organized by Aktivitetshuset/IKEA network and welcomes both the general public and IKEA employees and their families. Registration is done via RaceID where participants choose both distance and start time; online registration is open until May 9th at 8:00 PM and late registration can be done on-site from 8:30 AM if space permits. The race weekend is complemented by inspirational lectures and an after-run at Grillen after the finish line.
additional: Registration is via RaceID (select distance and start time). Online registration is open until May 9th at 8:00 PM; late registration is possible on-site from 8:30 AM if space allows. Since the race is a charity event, no fees are refunded upon cancellation. Group registration is supported (add additional participants during payment) and confirmation emails from RaceSupport include the chosen distance and start time. Inspirational lectures are held at Aktivitetshuset before the race (including Aron Anderson on April 10th from 17:00 to 19:00 and a lecture with researchers on April 24th from 17:30 to 19:00). The after-run at Grillen begins at 14:00 after the race. A course map is available as a PDF on the event page, and IKEA Hotel is recommended for overnight stays.

name: Sommarro Snabbare

tiers.label: tier_1

description: Sommarro Snabbare is a unique and fast-paced running race in the cultural reserve Sommarro in Örebro. The race takes place on a 2.6 km loop in a forest park environment where each lap must be completed in progressively shorter times (first lap 25 minutes, next 24 minutes, third 23 minutes, etc.), making the competition faster with each round. Everyone starts under the same conditions, and the winner is the one who lasts the longest – suitable for both fast runners and those who want to challenge their endurance. There is also a Little Sommarro Snabbare for children born in 2013 or later (one lap, no timing).
course_highlights: 2.6 km loop in a beautiful forest park environment (Sommarro cultural reserve)
Hilly course, mostly gravel and jogging trails with some terrain sections
Start/finish on the lawn; race run with progressively faster lap times
additional: Mandatory race briefing at 10:45; warm-up with Nordic Wellness before the start. Timing is done with a transponder around the ankle (number of laps mainly determines placement; in case of equal laps, the time on the last lap decides). Lost transponder incurs an 800 SEK fee. Water/energy drinks (Umara) and energy bars are available, as well as light refreshments. No changing rooms/showers; two public toilets nearby. Parking at Sommarro Värdshus and Lugnets IP; city bus 7 stops at Halltorpsvägen.

name: Ölands Kyrkstafett
price_range: Long bana: 1600-1900 kr; Kort bana: 1000-1200 kr
description: Öland's Parish Relay is a classic long-distance relay race organized by Högby IF and Öland's Sports Association, welcoming both experienced runners and beginners. The race is offered in two variants: a long course with eleven legs (approximately 67.8 km in total) and a short course with six legs (total 23.5 km). Start and finish are at Hamnplanen in Färjestaden, with many officials along the course and a group warm-up before the start. GPX files for all legs are available for download from the organizer's website.
course_highlights: Long course: 11 legs, total approximately 67.8 km (legs 2.7 - 8.5 km)
Short course: 6 legs, total 23.5 km (legs 2.7 - 5.4 km)
Start and finish at Hamnplanen in Färjestaden; leg 3 (Glömminge - Högsrum) passes via Rönnerumsvägen due to reconstruction
additional: Number bib pickup: Friday, May 8 from 15:00 to 17:00 and race day, May 9 from 08:00 to 09:30 at Hamngrillen in Färjestaden; changing and showers at the sports hall (200 m north of Ölands Köpstad) open from 08:00 to 10:00 and 14:00 to 17:00; Wellness Studio leads a group warm-up before the start; the long course has women's and open categories, the short course only open category; GPX files for all legs are available for download. Two courses: long approximately 67.8 km (11 legs) with women's and open categories; short approximately 23.5 km (6 legs) with open category. Start and finish at Hamnplanen in Färjestaden. The event is part of the Öland Running Races and has historically around 95 participating teams.

name: Humlestafetten
description: Humlestafetten is a team relay race consisting of six legs, starting and finishing in Bruksparken in Bromölla. The race takes place on a relatively flat course with varying surfaces (gravel and asphalt) and is open to both recreational runners and elite athletes - a social and energetic event for colleagues, friends, or family. Number bibs are distributed from 09:00, and timing is done with chips; there are shower and changing facilities in Sparbankshallen. Prizes are awarded to the top three in each category.
course_highlights: 6 legs with start and finish in Bruksparken, Bromölla
Flat course with varying surfaces (gravel and asphalt)
Water stations at start/finish and along the course; approximately 3 km on legs 1 and 4
additional: Number bibs are collected from 09:00 in Bruksparken. Shower and changing facilities are available in Sparbankshallen. Timing is done with a data chip; both total and split times are recorded (split times are taken about 20 meters before the exchange line) and the final leg time is taken at the finish. Only runners on their leg are allowed to pass through the timing portal. Prizes are awarded to the top three in each category. The proceeds go to Rotary's international aid work and Ryssberget IK's activities; anniversary celebrations and prize money for the top three in each category; registration via humlestafetten.se.

description: Lundaloppet is a welcoming recreational race in the heart of Lund with distances for all ages and levels. The event offers 2.5 km, 5 km, 10 km, 15 km, as well as the Little Lundaloppet for children, combining city and park environments. The race has a long tradition, and the finish line is located inside the Central Sports Field. The event page encourages a festive atmosphere and is suitable for both walkers and beginner runners as well as more experienced runners.
course_highlights: 10 km through a springtime Lund
5 km course through parks and the city center
Little Lundaloppet - children's race of about 500 meters around the Central Sports Field
additional: Registration is open until the start, but the price increases from April 23 and then you can no longer pre-order an official T-shirt, meal package, or have your name on the bib. Timing is done with a chip on the back of the bib (time is recorded from when you pass the start mat) and the finish line is filmed as a safety measure. Bib distribution takes place inside the IFK hall at the Central Sports Field, Trollebergsvägen 26. Start certificates are sent via email the week before the race and must be presented at pickup. The distances are 2.5/5/10/15 km and Little Lundaloppet; corporate and student registration as well as team registration; additional options including an official shirt, meal package, and training sessions (10 sessions, first session on March 2); for employees at Lund University, the registration fee is free and special conditions apply.

name: Springtime 2025
description: Springtime Helsingborg is an annual running race in Helsingborg operated under the Springtime brand. This year's event takes place on May 10, 2026, and offers several start categories, including Company/Team, MiniSpringtime, Everyone Can Run, and Open IFK Championship. The event is open to runners of various levels and features both competitive and family-friendly elements. Registration is done via the website, and results from previous years are available online.
course_highlights: Several start categories for different target groups: Company/Team, MiniSpringtime, Everyone Can Run, and Open IFK Championship
Family-friendly setup with broad participation
Results from previous years and registration via the official website
additional: Registration is done via Sign up here! on the website; result lists are available for several years back (2011 - 2025). The last regular registration day is April 19; late registration on the website is open until May 3, after which you can register late at Löplabbet. The price includes bib number and medal as well as water and fruit.

name: Springtime
description:
Helsingborg City Race has since its inception in 1981 attracted runners from near and far.

The race takes place through the city center with start and finish at Stortorget. The distances are 5 km and 10 km.

For children born 2016-2020, there is MiniSpringtime, which is 1 km. Everyone Can Run is a race for people with disabilities (all ages) and follows the same course as MiniSpringtime.
course_highlights: Two main routes for adults: 10 km (2 x 5 km) and 5 km
Children's and disability race with loops of approximately 500 m and 2000 m
The course is certified by a national course measurer
additional: Start times (example for 2026): Disability race at 10:30, MiniMarathon at 11:15, 5 km and 10 km (start at 12:00). Participation in senior and veteran classes requires representation by a club affiliated with the Swedish Athletics Association. In the disability race, it is allowed to run together with one or more companions (escort, residential staff, personal assistant, or family member). Award ceremony planned around 13:30; Children's and disability loops of approximately 700 m and 1400 m; Last registration date May 8, 2025; Late registration at the start up to 30 minutes before the race.

name: Vårruset (Växjö)
description: Vårruset Växjö is the Växjö edition of Sweden's largest women's running tour, which in 2026 will visit 19 cities. In Växjö, the distances offered are 2.5 km or 5 km with start and finish at Strandbjörket around Växjösjön. The race can be registered as an individual or as a team, and a medal, a finish bag, and Vårruset music quiz with prizes are included, while timing can be opted out of. Age recommendations apply, and digital registration is used; as an extra feature, free HPV vaccination for women born 1994 - 1999 is available on site during Vårruset according to Region Kronoberg.
course_highlights: 2.5 km or 5 km around Växjösjön with start and finish at Strandbjörket
Team and individual registration with picnic after the finish for teams
Medal, finish bag, and Vårruset music quiz with prizes (timing can be opted out)
additional: Team-based picnic after the finish; digital registration; part of the national Vårruset tour 2026 (19 cities). Distance options: 2.5 km or 5 km (measured 5 km). Start and finish at Strandbjörket; team registrations (5 people) are offered a picnic after the finish. Registration can be done digitally until race day, no later than 1 hour before the first start; timing can be opted out of during registration.

name: Blodomloppet (Uddevalla)
