Distances: 2.5 km or 5 km; team registration (5 persons) includes a picnic after finishing; digital registration for the race must be completed at least 1 hour before the first start; bib distribution via Intersport Sundsvall; recommended age: 13 years for 5 km (adult with 11-year-old) and 11 years for 2.5 km (adult with 7-year-old).

name: Blodomloppet Örebro

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: 13 maj – 26 maj:  400 kr (Lag: 2000 kr t.o.m. 26 maj)

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 12 maj: 0 kr (upp till max 200 deltagare, därefter 100 kr)

description: Welcome to Blodomloppet Örebro - a community race celebrating the vital importance of blood donation. The event offers competitions and festivities for both 5 km and 10 km (women/men), a short Special Race, and the Little Blood Race for children. Registration can be done individually or in teams of five people, and the race is suitable for both walking and running of all ages. The organizer also encourages community spirit and often concludes with a large picnic.
additional: Registrations can be made individually or in teams (team = 5 participants, 1 - 2 spots may be vacant). Team fee and the option to mix classes apply; an Excel template for mass registration is available. The Little Blood Race is for ages 1 - 12 years (adults can accompany) and the first 200 children to register by 2026-04-30 will participate for free according to the organizer’s offer. Discounts: blood donors, ICA members, and campaigns via Nerikes Allehanda (40 SEK, some restrictions - not valid during late registration). The last day for team registration is 2026-05-26; individual registrations can be made up until the race (about 30 minutes before start) but usually at a higher fee. Contact for registration/assistance: orebro@blodomloppet.se or kansli@blodomloppet.se.

name: Vårruset Östersund
description: Vårruset in Östersund is a local event in the nationwide Vårruset tour, inviting participants to a accessible evening race of 2.5 km or 5 km along the shore of Storsjön. The event is open to runners of various ages and offers both individual registration and team registration (teams of five people) with a picnic after the finish for teams. For the 5 km distance, official timing is available but can be opted out during registration; all participants receive a medal, a finish bag, and a bib. The start and finish are located at Storsjön, and the event area is north of Badhusparken near the old Yrancampingen.
course_highlights: The course runs along the shore of Storsjön
Start and finish at Storsjön, event area north of Badhusparken (old Yrancampingen)
Selectable distances 2.5 km or a certified 5 km
additional: Included in individual registration: medal, finish bag, Vårruset music quiz + prizes, bib, and (if chosen) timing for the 5 km; team registration includes a picnic after the finish. Bib distribution at Intersport Östersund on May 23 from 11 to 17 and May 30 from 11 to 17. Recommended age: 13 years and older for 5 km (11 years with adult), 11 years and older for 2.5 km (7 years with adult). Registration can be done digitally until race day, at least 1 hour before the first start. There is also a separate Vårruset Digital (2.5 km or 5 km) that can be completed from May 4 to June 4; digital participants will receive a medal by mail and cannot participate in physical events. Distances: 2.5 km and 5 km (certified 5 km course); teams consist of five people and include a picnic after the finish; digital registration allows opting out of timing; medals, finish bags, and bibs are included; bib distribution via Intersport Östersund.

name: Blodomloppet Stockholm
description: Blodomloppet Stockholm is a community race organized to raise awareness of the need for blood donation. The event offers 5 km and 10 km options for runners and walkers, as well as the Little Blood Run for children, and traditionally concludes with a picnic. There are competitive categories with timing and prizes for the three fastest runners. Everyone is welcome - run, jog, or walk for an important cause.
course_highlights: 5 km and 10 km - options to walk, jog, or run
Walking category 5 km where dogs are allowed
Little Blood Run for children: 1.1 km (7 - 12 years) and 800 m (1 - 6 years)
additional: A team consists of 5 people (at least 3 names required upon registration) and team registration must be completed by May 28; team registration includes a picnic basket. Extra picnic baskets cost 250 SEK and can be added until May 28. Blood donors receive a 40 SEK discount (to be stated at registration) and a blood donor gift is distributed at GeBlod's tent; participants remotely can receive a 250 SEK ICA gift card instead of a picnic basket. Invoice payment is only available for orders over 1500 SEK. Poles are only allowed in walking categories; strollers are not permitted during the race but are welcome at the event area. Venue at Djurgårdsbrunn; start area opens approximately 20 minutes before the start; walking category without timing; no access to changing rooms or showers; blood donors receive a discount on registration (40 SEK).

name: Vårruset 2025 — Luleå
description: Vårruset in Luleå is an evening run in Sweden's largest fitness tour for women, held on Thursday, June 4, 2026, with the arena at StiL Sportscenter. The race is offered at 2.5 km or 5 km (the 5 km course is measured) and is open to participants of all fitness levels. Individual start places include a medal, a finish bag, and a bib; team registration (team of five) includes a picnic after the finish. The event combines running joy with social elements such as Vårruset's music quiz and the option to opt out of official timing.
course_highlights: 5 km course is measured
Selectable distances 2.5 km or 5 km
Arena/start at StiL Sportscenter, Universitetsvägen 11 (Luleå)
additional: Registration is done digitally and can be completed up until race day, no later than 1 hour before the first start. Individual registrations include a medal, finish bag, bib, and (if chosen) timing; timing can be opted out so results are not published. Team registration (five persons) includes a picnic after the finish. Recommended age: 5 km from 13 years (or 11 years with adult supervision), 2.5 km from 11 years (or 7 years with adult supervision). The event also offers a digital race (2.5 or 5 km) where a medal is sent after the tour ends; digital registration does not include a picnic, music quiz, or official timing. Training sessions are organized on the same day/time at several locations (in Luleå: March 19 at 6:30 PM at StiL Sportscenter). Registration is binding and the registration fee is non-refundable. Distances: 2.5 or 5 km; team registration - picnic after finish; digital registration; timing information; age recommendations: 5 km from 13 years (11 years with adult supervision); 2.5 km from 11 years (7 years with adult supervision); training opportunities including training sessions at 19 locations.

name: Jernbrukets backyard Ultra

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Kostnad 150 kr som betalas direkt till The Tannery Club.

description: Jernbrukets Backyard Ultra is a backyard ultramarathon with start and finish at Restaurang Jernbruket in Floda. The race takes place on a 6.7 km loop that must be completed in under 60 minutes; then the next loop starts every full hour and the last runner remaining wins - the race continues as long as participants can keep going. The course runs through hilly forest terrain in the area around Säveån valley and Nääs Castle, and the organizer plans both day and night running. The restaurant at the station serves as the race center, and the organizer emphasizes good food and a genuine early summer forest experience for both runners and spectators.
course_highlights: 6.7 km loop (backyard format, must be completed in under 60 minutes)
Hilly forest terrain with many elevation changes; areas around Säveån valley and Nääs Castle
Start and finish at Restaurang Jernbruket, approximately 150 meters from Floda train station
additional: Start and finish of the race are at Restaurang Jernbruket (Floda stationsväg 3), near Floda train station; the main race is limited to 100 participants. The Backe‑Yard variant starts at 10:00 and the last start is at 15:00 (run as many loops as you like during these hours) and offers blueberry soup, sports drinks (Umara), and snacks. After the race, there is a wood-fired sauna and bathing at The Tannery Club (fee 150 SEK paid directly to the club). Backyard Ultra format; 6.7 km loops under 60 minutes; start every full hour; last runner remaining wins; two courses (day and night running); location: Floda area with Restaurang Jernbruket as the race center; start time according to the Facebook page at 18:00 on June 6.

name: NATTMILEN 2026 - Sundsvall
description: Night Mile is a night race in the city environment of Sundsvall with a festival atmosphere, after-run, and start/finish at Stora torget. The event will be held on June 5, 2026, with a common start at 22:00 and offers both 5 km and 10 km with timing, as well as the option to run any distance without timing. The race is organized by Morron in collaboration with Restaurant Bloco and local sports teams and provides an experience in the beautiful stone city of Sundsvall. The organizer will document the event with photos and videos; if you do not want to be visible, please inform via event@morron.se.
course_highlights: Running through Sundsvall's beautiful stone city
Start and finish at Stora torget (mass start)
5 km and 10 km with timing (also optional distance without timing)
additional: Late registration: online registration possible until 30 minutes before the start if spots are available. Bibs can be collected at Stadium City during race week or on site between 19:00 - 21:30 on race day. Timing with numbered chip and start/finish mat; everyone receives a medal. Water and sports drink available at hydration stations. Age limits: from 12 years with adult accompaniment or from 14 years alone. Possibility to transfer registration until Thursday, June 5 at 23:59 for a fee (100 SEK) via event@morron.se. Accommodation offer at Scandic City (booking: event.sundsvallcity@scandichotels.com). Mass start, timing; START at 22:00; distances of 5 km, 10 km, or 5/10 km without timing (and FunRun according to some sources); finish line with a bar; after-run; documentation of the race (photos/videos) and opt-out info.

name: Söder Runt
description: Söder Runt is an evening race of 10 km that takes a single lap around Södermalm and is consistently described as both beautiful and very fast. The fourteenth edition will take place on Saturday, June 6, 2026, with the first start tentatively at 19:45. The course is measured, flat, and easy to run along the water, making the race popular for personal bests. After the finish, an After Run party is held with food, drinks, and music.
course_highlights: 10.00 km around Södermalm along the water
Flat and easy-to-run course on asphalt and gravel
Water stations after 4 km and at the finish
additional: Age limit 14 years (After Run 18 years); strollers and dogs are not allowed; all finishers receive a medal and products; the race is sanctioned by the Swedish Athletics Association; officials mainly from Löparakademin and Fredrikshofs FIF; payment via internet bank, card, Swish, or invoice/bankgiro for larger group registrations. Start at Tantolunden; finish at Hornstulls strand; course on asphalt and gravel, flat; age limit 18 years; strollers and dogs not allowed; After Run party; sanctioned by the Swedish Athletics Association.

name: Eketånga trail Halmstad
description: Come and experience the wonderfully beautiful and fun trails in Eketångaskogen and between the golf courses in Tylösand/Frösakull! Here you will run on flowing trails, over roots and stones, on a varied course in a fantastic environment that will not disappoint you! In 2026, you can choose to run 10 km or 21 km. Start and finish right next to the sea at Wakeparken in Grötvik harbor. About 400 encouraging runners usually participate; join the running festival by the sea and in the forest too! It will be fun! Registration is open.
course_highlights: Start and finish next to the sea in Grötvik harbor
Winding trails through Eketångaskogen and Eketånga nature reserve - roots, stones, and flowing sections
Loop around the dramatic stone quarry with a nice view (runs at the beginning and end); 21 km also includes sections near Tylösand's golf courses and Nyrebäcken
additional: Number bib, medal, and Eketånga trail bag included. Water/energy stations at 1 point for 10 km (at 5.5 km) and 2 stations for 21 km (at 5.5, 10, and 15 km); sports drinks from Umara offered during the race. Timing and live results; prize money for the top 3 women and men, as well as raffle prizes. Number bibs can be collected at Sportringen from May 30 to June 5 or at Wakeparken before the start. Valuables can be left with volunteers (at your own risk), medical services are on site, and warm-up sessions are held by instructors from Actic. Trail running on trails and gravel roads; opportunities for guided tours along the trails; children's races offered during Halmstad Outdoor Weekend; bib pickup and energy stations available; baggage drop-off at Wakeparken; museum visits and after-race hangout in Wakeparken.

name: Björnfrossa Ultramarathon
description: The Björnfrossa ultramarathon is a scenic yet challenging trail race of approximately 65 km in the bear territories of Gästrikland, starting and finishing at Kungsberget's leisure facility. The course mainly follows Gästrikeleden, Lenåsleden, and Fäbodleden, offering technical trails, gravel roads, several beautiful viewpoints, and approximately 1200 meters of total elevation gain. The race is organized by the Björnfrossa organizing association and has strong local roots — the idea was born in 2017 by a group of runners from Sandviken. All levels wishing to experience long-distance trail running in the region are welcome, but the race is not an officially sanctioned competition.
course_highlights: Approximately 65 km along Gästrikeleden, Lenåsleden, and Fäbodleden
Approximately 1200 m total elevation gain; mix of technical trails and gravel roads
Several viewpoints along the course
additional: Maximum time: 12 hours. Four staffed water stations along the course with water, sports drinks, and light refreshments; trash bags are available for waste. Bib numbers are distributed at the start area and must be worn visibly throughout the race. No drop bag service is offered — everything you want to carry must be taken from the start. Recommended equipment: mobile phone with map and an emergency number to be provided later; no formal equipment requirements but prepare for several hours between stations. Medical personnel are available at the start/finish; on the course, participants are responsible for themselves and in case of emergency call 112. Four staffed water stations; drop bags are not offered; approximately 15 km between each water station; medical support at start and finish; 112 in case of emergency; not an officially sanctioned race.

name: Fiskebäcksloppet - tre hamnar
description:
Fiskebäcksloppet - three harbors
The race where you run for others. The entire registration fee goes to the Rescue Mission's social work.

Fiskebäcksloppet - three harbors
10 km on a hilly and scenic course passing through the harbors of Önnered, Hinsholmen, and Fiskebäck.

Little Fiskebäcksloppet
2.5 km on gravel roads and trails in Sjöbacka nature reserve (children's race)

Fiskebäcksloppet - Sjöbacka
5 km (two laps on the Little Fiskebäcksloppet course)
course_highlights: Course passing through three harbors
Beautiful nature in Sjöbacka nature reserve
Multiple distances: 10 km, 5 km, 2.5 km, and a mini race (~500 m)
additional: The event area is open from 11:30 to 17:00. Number bibs are distributed on site and it is possible to register children for the Mini Race on site. Food can be purchased in the area, there is a stage for warm-up and award ceremony, as well as volunteers, medical staff, and traffic controllers. Additional facilities include a bouncy castle, bicycle parking, toilets, and a luggage drop-off. There is also a team competition where the teams with the most registered runners win prizes. Open between 11:30 and 17:00 for bib distribution, timing, food sales, warm-up on stage, and prize ceremony.

images.alt_text: Löpare på podiet med Fiskebäcksloppets logotyp och priser.
Barn med nummerlappar höjer händerna före Fiskebäcksloppet.
Deltagare springer i Fiskebäcksloppet, en väg- och terränglopp med nummerbrickor.
Löpare i ett väglopp, med nummerlappar synliga.
Fiskebäcksloppet medalj med blått band och en löpare som motiv.

name: Fiskebäcksloppet 2026 (Önnered)
description: Fiskebäcksloppet is the Rescue Mission's running festival in Sjöbacka nature reserve, held on Saturday, June 6, 2026. The race offers several distances - 10 km (Three Harbors), 5 km (Sjöbacka), 2.5 km (Little Fiskebäcksloppet), and a mini race - with the course passing through three harbors amidst beautiful scenery. The entry fee is entirely donated to the Rescue Mission's social work, and the event welcomes both new and returning runners.
course_highlights: The course passes through three harbors
Beautiful scenery in Sjöbacka nature reserve
Multiple distances: 10 km, 5 km, 2.5 km, and a mini race (about 500 m)
additional: The event area is open from 11:30 to 17:00; bib numbers can be collected on site; group warm-up and award ceremony take place on stage; staff, medical services, and traffic controllers are present; bicycle parking, toilets, a bouncy castle, and luggage drop-off are available; team competitions are held, and participants can start their own fundraising for the Rescue Mission. Three harbors along the course; open area from 11:30 to 17:00 with bib distribution, food options, group warm-up, award ceremony, bouncy castle, medical staff, and traffic controllers; opportunities for team competitions and personal fundraising for the Rescue Mission's social work.

name: UppLoppet
description: On June 6, 2026, we invite you to UppLoppet - a wonderful running event featuring 3 km and 10 km distances filled with running joy, community, and festive atmosphere. Whether you aim for a personal best, want to run at a relaxed pace, or simply enjoy the atmosphere, UppLoppet is for you. In addition to the race, we offer several pleasant side events for both participants and spectators. Join us in celebrating movement, health, and community together on National Day!
course_highlights: 10 km and 3 km through central Uppsala
Routes along Fyrisån and through Stadsskogen
Finish at Studenternas IP with spectators, music, and activities
additional: The race takes place in the morning of June 6, 2026. The recommended minimum age for the 10 km is 15 years; younger participants can join accompanied by an adult or choose the 3 km. There are several side events and activities at the venue for participants and spectators. National celebration on National Day; central Uppsala location description; views along Fyrisån and Stadsskogen; side events for participants and spectators.

images.alt_text: Löpare med svenska flaggor springer, UppLoppet 3 km & 10 km, 6 juni.

name: Victorialoppet 2026
location: Kungsgatan, Borgholms Idrottsplats, Borgholm, Kalmar County, Sweden

price_tiers.distance: Lilla Victorialoppet (2 km / 1,5 km) & Parasport (2 km)

description: Victorialoppet in Borgholm is Öland's major running festival and offers races for the whole family - from Mini for the youngest to the main race of 9 km. The running event has a long tradition and donates part of the proceeds to Crown Princess Victoria's fund; there is also a virtual running option. The start for Mini, Lilla, and Victoriajoggen is from Kungsgatan by Borgholm's sports hall, and the event is characterized by a festival atmosphere with spectators, music, and seaside views. All participants receive information about bib distribution, changing facilities, and prizes in the participant information.
course_highlights: The main race has a fast, easy-to-run course
Beautiful seaside views and routes mostly along the harbor area
Enthusiastic spectators and musical entertainment at several locations along the course
additional: Bib distribution on race day at Borgholm's Sports Hall from 10:00 to 18:00. In the 9 km race, water is available along the course; musical entertainment at several locations. Prizes and commemorative plaques/medals are awarded according to category (Victorialoppet receives a commemorative plaque; Victoriajoggen and para categories medals; Lilla Victorialoppet medals, ice cream, and drinks). Changing and shower facilities: men/boys in Borgholm's Sports Hall, women/girls in Viktoriaskolan's gymnasium. Timing is done with disposable chips, and timing services are offered. From June 15, regular fees apply, and late registration after July 15 incurs higher fees; check-in times: 9 km by 18:00, 4 km by 16:45, 2 km/1.5 km by 15 minutes before start.

name: Västerås Stadslopp
description: Västerås City Run is organized by Västerås Athletics Club and invites you to a popular and family-friendly running day in the city environment on Sunday, June 7, 2026. The event offers races for adults (including 10 km and 2.5 km), children's races in three lengths, and a Paralympic race for participants with disabilities. There is a team category for four people with a picnic/bag as a prize, activities for children in Vasaparken, and all participants receive a city run medal. The organizer urges early registration as spots for the children's races are limited and have sold out in previous years.
course_highlights: Start/finish near the Town Hall (festival area and service at the start)
Children's races and Paralympic race in Vasaparken (selectable courses approx. 200 m, 400 m, or 800 m)
Toilets and water refill in front of the Town Hall near start/finish
additional: Children's races have three free distances (approx. 200 m, 400 m, 800 m) and are limited to a maximum of 400 children. A team of four people receives a grocery bag from Hemköp Malmaberg (last day to register the team is 31/5), and team members do not have to run the same race. Bib numbers are collected days before the race; bibs are attached with safety pins and worn visibly on the stomach/chest. Friskis & Svettis leads warm-up about 10 minutes before each race; the Paralympic race awards medals and goodie bags to participants. No prize ceremony or timing for the 2.5 km race; honorary prizes for the top three in the 10 km and 5 km races. Companies can book tents (5000 SEK) or beach flags (2500 SEK) via henrik@vasterasfriidrott.se. Registration is balanced (a team of four people receives a goodie bag after finishing). All participants receive a medal and a goodie bag at the finish line. There are water stations along the course and activities in Vasaparken during the event.

name: Gallaberget Trailrun
location: Gallabergsskogen, Vretstorp, Kumla Municipality, Örebro County, Sweden
description: Vretstorps IF Running organizes the Gallaberget Trailrun in Gallabergsskogen, with running around Gallabergssjön. The event is an evening race suitable for recreational runners and local runners and is part of the club's summer calendar. Information and registration are provided via the club's page on laget.se, and the organizer warmly welcomes participants to forest trails and nature-oriented running.
course_highlights: Forest trails around Gallabergssjön
Evening race (starts at 18:00)
Nature-oriented trail and forest terrain in Gallabergsskogen
additional: Organizer: Vretstorps IF Running. Location in the calendar: Gallabergssjön / Gallabergsskogen. The calendar event is displayed on laget.se and the page offers instructions for subscription via iCal, Google Calendar, and Outlook. The page shows prompts such as "Click to register" in news posts, but no direct registration link was found on the crawled pages.

name: Alpaca Race
location: Hisingsparken, Göteborg, Västra Götalands län, Sweden
description: The Alpaca Race is a challenging trail run in Gothenburg's Hisingparken, built as a loop on a technical course. The competition format offers four selectable distances (1, 3, 5, or 10 loops) with significant elevation gain and is intended as preparation for tough mountain races like UTMB. The race will be held June 13-14, 2026, with night running for the longest distances and a medal for all finishers. The event is organized by IF Kville with gathering and aid station at Tuve Ice Hall / IF Kville's clubhouse.
course_highlights: Technical trail course in Hisingparken / Tuve area
Loop format: choose 1, 3, 5, or 10 loops (10 loops = 106 km, +6000 meters of elevation)
Course designed with the same elevation difference per km as UTMB (challenging elevation profile)
additional: Start and schedule: 10 loops start Saturday at 19:00 (24 hours, 20 spots), 5 loops start Sunday at 07:00 (12 hours, 50 spots), 3 loops start at 10:00 (8 hours, 50 spots), and 1 loop with starts around 11:00/15:00 (1-3 hours, 100 spots). Check-in and allocation of spots before start, aid station/start at IF Kville's clubhouse at Tuve Ice Hall with toilets and facilities for changing/showering. Food: grilling and possibility to bring your own food; energy drinks and evening staffing available. A trial run of the course will be announced separately with own timing for those interested. Trial runs before the race (dates may vary); night running period 19:00 - 07:00; 24 hours / 20 spots; grilling/own food at the base camp.

name: Öland Ultra Trail
location: Böda Sand, Böda, Borgholm Municipality, Kalmar County, Sweden
description: Öland Ultra Trail is a nature-oriented trail run on northern Öland with distances of 50 km and 25 km for both men and women. The course passes through classic Öland forests and coastal landscapes, including Byrums raukar, Neptuni åkrar, and Trollskogen. The 50 km race starts at Böda Sand and the 25 km race starts in Byxelkrok, with a joint finish at Böda Sand. Registered participants will receive a T-shirt if they register by June 6.
course_highlights: Byrums raukar (coastal rock formations)
Neptuni åkrar (coastal meadow landscape with views)
Trollskogen (characteristic pine forest on northern Öland)
additional: Location: Sport Camp, Böda Sand (northern Öland). Date: June 13, 2026; 50 km start at 09:00 at Böda Sand, 25 km start at 10:00 in Byxelkrok; joint finish at Böda Sand. Medal for all finishers. To receive a T-shirt, register by June 6 and specify T-shirt size (men/women). Bib pickup: Friday, June 12 from 19:00 to 20:00 and race day June 13 from 07:30 to 09:00 (last chance for late registration). Payment for late registration: cash, card, or Swish. Organizer: Högby IF. Joint finish at Böda Sand; start times 50 km at 09:00 and 25 km at 10:00; registration deadline for pre-registration is June 6, 2026, and until June 11 for late registration; pre-registration includes a T-shirt.

name: Urskogsloppet

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Anmälningsavgiften är 200 kr och anmälan stänger den 10/6.

description: Urskogsloppet is a recreational race that takes place through primeval forest environments in Örnsköldsvik Municipality and is organized by Björna IF. The race is available in two distances: the original long race of 19.7 km (starting in Backe/Berg, finishing at Bigvallen in Björna) and a shorter race of 6.6 km (start and finish at Bigvallen). The course partly follows the Urskogsleden hiking trail and mainly consists of simple forest paths over logs, stones, and branches, with sections of wet and uneven terrain. Urskogsloppet has been held since 2009 and always takes place on the Saturday before Midsummer.
course_highlights: Partly along the Urskogsleden hiking trail
Mostly simple forest paths over logs, stones, and branches - uneven and locally wet terrain
Checkpoints with fluids and light snacks (long: checkpoints after approx. 6, 13, 15, and 18 km; short: checkpoints at ~3.2 and 5 km)
additional: Participant cap: 350. Registration/parking/changing at the school in Björna; for the long race, a bus will run to the start in Backe after registration. Personal bags can be left at the start and collected at the finish. Food can be purchased at the school cafeteria (cost 120 SEK, last day to book food 2026-06-01). Registration must be completed by 10:00 on race day (online registration closes 2026-06-10 at 20:00), but late registration on site is possible if spots are available. Time limits: checkpoint at 6 km closes 1 hour 40 minutes after start, checkpoint at 13 km closes 3 hours after start, and the finish closes 4 hours 10 minutes after start. Changing rooms and showers are available at the gym hall and swimming pool. Participation is at your own risk. Terrain: mud/simple trails with stones and branches, sometimes wet and uneven. Race limit: 350 participants. Registration via Svenskalag.se (Björna IF's club page). Organized together with the Little Urskogsloppet and the Knatteloppet for children up to 13 years old.

name: Tjejmilen Sälen by EQPE
description: Tjejmilen Sälen is a summer race in mountain environment with distances of 5 km and 10 km, taking place in Lindvallen, Sälen on June 13, 2026. The course offers varied terrain with mountain trails, technical sections, and open views - an experience for both first-time participants and seasoned runners. The race is female-oriented and combines nature experience with camaraderie; timing is available and can be opted out of during registration.
course_highlights: Mountain trails and technical sections in spectacular mountain environment
Mossy areas and views towards Mellanfjället and Hemfjället
Narrow mountain trail up Hemfjället with several mountain tarns
additional: Distance: 5 km and 10 km. Timing is offered (can be opted out). Age limits: 10 km from 15 years (or 13 years with adult); 5 km from 13 years (or 11 years with adult). Late registration is possible (subject to availability) until 2 hours before the first start and is done digitally via the regular registration site. Possibility to book bus travel from Stockholm to Sälen. Payment options: internet banking, Visa/MasterCard, Swish, or invoice via Klarna. Water stations are placed along the course. Distances are 5 km and 10 km; start groups; late registration until 2 hours before the first start; bus trip Stockholm - Sälen; payment options include bank, card, Swish, and Klarna; refunds only according to insurance.

name: Nalta Backyard Ultra
description: Nalta Backyard Ultra is Sweden's northernmost backyard ultramarathon, held at Ursberget's ski cabin in Piteå. The race takes place on a 6.706 km loop with a new start every full hour - the first lap begins at 09:00 - where runners must be in the starting area to continue. Together with Piterunners, the organizers create a communal running festival in the midnight light with simple refreshments and a Nalta Backyard Ultra T-shirt included in the standard registration. All participation is at your own risk and the race follows the rules from bigsbackyardultra.com.
course_highlights: 6.706 km loop with a new start every full hour
Approximately 65 meters of elevation; mostly forest trails, jogging tracks, gravel roads, and about 500 meters of asphalt
The course is marked with signs and ribbons; the race takes place in midnight light
additional: Registration and bib distribution take place from 07:30 to 08:30 at the race management tent; race briefing and rules explanation at 08:30. All fluids and energy sources are available at the lap area (including UMARA sports drink, water, coffee, sandwiches, pickles, chips, candy, fruit); personal assistance along the course is not allowed. There are two small changing rooms (one shower) and two toilets; the organizer cannot provide supervision/storage of personal belongings. Parking is limited near the jogging track and at Tolvmansskolan - carpooling is recommended. The T-shirt is included in the standard registration (not included in late registration). There is a team category (register individually with team name) and awards are given when the last runner finishes. Registration 07:30 - 08:30; no on-course aid; T-shirt included with pre-registration; possibility for 3-person teams; results published on official websites; limited parking.

name: EcoTrail Stockholm
location: Stora Skuggans Amfiteater, Norra Djurgården, Stockholm, Sweden
distance_verbose: 50 miles, 50 km, 33 km, 16 km, 8 km, 0.7 km
course_highlights: Mix of archipelago, technical forest trails, countryside, city, and several viewpoints
Start and finish at Stora Skuggans Amphitheater on Northern Djurgården (easily accessible by subway/bus)
80 km course passes through seven municipalities and nine nature reserves; generous maximum time (14 hours) and limited number of participants
additional: Start and finish at Stora Skuggans Amphitheater; wooden medal for all finishers; mandatory bring-your-own cup/mug or bottle for refilling at water stations; GPX file available for download; 80 km has a maximum time of 14 hours and is limited to 200 participants; more details and program will be sent via email to registered participants approximately two weeks before the race. The registration deadline for the distances is June 11, 2026. For the 80 km, mandatory equipment includes: container for at least one liter of water, cup/mug, fully charged mobile phone, and the race management's phone number; water stations do not provide cups.

name: Flosjön-Edstjärn
description: Flosjön - Edstjärn is the Half Marathon organized by Edstjärns IK in the Flosjön/Edstjärn area. The race is part of the club's annual events and is aimed at recreational runners and local club members. The course layout and results from previous years, including intermediate times, are published on the club's website. For information and contact, the organizer refers to the club's email.
course_highlights: Approximately 21 km trail running between Flosjön and Edstjärn in Dalarna (Gagnef).
The course consists of about 80% terrain and approximately 350 meters of elevation gain.
Organized by Edstjärns IK under the names Walk of Pain and Half Marathon, with results archive available.
additional: The course layout for Flosjön - Edstjärn is published on the page 'Course Layout for Flosjön-Edstjärn'. Results from previous races, including intermediate times, are published on the website. The organizer is Edstjärns IK, a non-profit sports club open to everyone; contact via hej@eik.one. The Walk of Pain title is used; results pages are available for Flosjön-Edstjärn; the 2020 event was canceled; results for the 2024 event are available.

name: Ljungskileslingan
location: Ljungskile centrum, Ljungskile, Västra Götalands län, Sweden
description: LjungskileSlingan is a family-friendly recreational run with distances ranging from 300 meters for the youngest to 10 km. The start and finish are located in Ljungskile center, and the course runs around central Ljungskile and Lyckorna, partly along Ljungskile Bay and the promenade. The routes are scenic and only gently hilly, and the event offers a large prize table. The event is organized by Ljungskile Outdoor Club in collaboration with Hälle IF and is held in connection with Ljungskile Day and Lions' flea market.
course_highlights: Start and finish in Ljungskile center
Course follows Ljungskile Bay and the promenade towards Lyckorna, scenic and gently hilly
Distances: kids' run 300 m, 1 km, 3 km, 5 km, and 10 km; large prize table
additional: The event is a community celebration in connection with Ljungskile Day and Lions' flea market, featuring a carnival, music, and activities. Large prize table - the top three in each category receive prizes, and other prizes are drawn among finishers. The race has been held since 1994, and since 2015, Ljungskile Outdoor Club and Hälle IF share the organizing responsibilities. The invitation page states that registration has opened (see the invitation for more information). A kids' run has been included since 2018; LjungskileSlingan also has connections to Ljungskile Day and has a history of varying distances and organizers before Hälle IF took over in 2024. In 2026, the 10 km race will return with a new route.

name: Öllsjö Löpfest 2026
description: Warmly welcome to Öllsjö Löpfest on June 13, 2026! After two previous editions, we return with a family-friendly running festival featuring several different races for all ages and levels. The event offers chip timing, team competitions, and an activity area with music and family activities. The number of participants is limited to maintain a friendly and family-like atmosphere.
course_highlights: Children's races: 450 m and 1,700 m
Distance races: 5 km
7.5 km trail mix (trail segment on the course)
additional: Automatic chip timing and team competitions are offered. Service fee of 12.50 SEK is mentioned for registrations. The event area is open from 10:00 to 14:00. Late registration from June 8 to 12 costs 225 SEK, and on-site registration on June 13 costs 250 SEK. Music and activities for the whole family; the number of participants is limited. The race is marketed as inclusive for everyone, but information about registration and distances is missing from the text. Webscorer mentions a manual wave start which may affect the start plan.

name: Blue Mountain TrailRun
location: First Camp Ånnaboda, Ånnaboda, Örebro County, Sweden
description: Blue Mountain Trail Run is a nature- and technical-oriented trail race held at First Camp Ånnaboda with four distances (21 km, 15 km, 10 km, and 6 km). The courses run on Bergslagsleden and parts of MTB trails with lake passages, forest paths, and viewpoints such as Sånnabodahöjden. The event is family-friendly and service-oriented with bib distribution, food sales, and showers/changing facilities near the competition area. For the 21 km race, there is an extra competitive incentive: the one who beats the course record will be rewarded with 5000 SEK.
course_highlights: Hilly and technical forest trails along Bergslagsleden and MTB trails
Expansive views from Sånnabodahöjden (266 m above sea level) and several forest lakes along the course
Clear course markings, energy stations at key junctions, and approximately 527 meters of total elevation gain (21 km)
additional: Bib pickup is available no later than 45 minutes before the start; distribution opens at 09:00 and on-site registration takes place from 09:00 to 09:15. Changing rooms, showers, and toilets are available at the red SM cabin about 300 meters below First Camp; swimming options at Södra Ånnabosjön. Electronic timing with a sport steward on the finger; energy stations along the course; food and snack sales on site. Name and class changes can be made until June 9, 2026 (cost 150 SEK); refund protection is offered (17% of the fee). First Camp Ånnaboda offers a 15% discount on cabins when booking via annaboda@firstcamp.se with the code "TrailRun". A service fee of approximately 10 SEK applies. Registration and bib pickup are 45 minutes before the start; food and drinks are available; changing rooms, showers, and toilets near the red SM cabin at the main parking lot; medical kits at the start/finish and water stations; First Camp Ånnaboda offers a 15% discount on cabin rentals using the code TrailRun.

name: Run Malmö
description: RUN MALMÖ is a new city race on June 14, 2026, featuring two distances: half marathon (21K) and 10K, with a shared start and finish area in Dockan/Varvsstaden. The courses are flat and fast, taking you through four distinct zones - from city vibes and parks to the quay and sea breeze at Västra hamnen with views of Turning Torso. The race suits both those chasing personal bests and those wanting to experience Malmö together with spectators and running joy. Organized by Malmö Allmänna Idrottsförening (MAI).
course_highlights: Flat and fast course through four zones: city, parks, quay district, and seaside
Passes Turning Torso and long straight stretches along Ribban and Limhamnsvägen
Surface: mostly asphalt, sections with paved gravel paths in parks and cobblestones in central areas
additional: Registration opens on November 25, 2025, and runners can also register via Epassi (welfare/health benefit). Start times: 10K first wave at 10:00 (last at 10:12), 21K first wave at 10:40 (last at 10:56). Maximum time: 10K 90 minutes, 21K 3 hours. There is a cutoff at 3.5 km for the 10K where runners must pass within 32 minutes after the last start wave. Services include water and sports drink stations from Umara, medical services, medals/fruits/drinks at the finish, and toilets along the course. Distance changes are possible for an administration fee of 95 SEK (and upgrading from 10K to 21K requires paying the difference). Corporate packages are available with gathering tents, group training, and example prices for tents: 25 people 15,000 SEK, 50 people 25,000 SEK, 75 people 35,000 SEK. The distances are 21K and 10K; Epassi wellness reimbursement is accepted as a payment option.

name: Dadathlon Run and Festival (Stockholm, Hagaparken)
description: DaddyHood Dadathlon is a family-oriented sports event that encourages fathers and their children to move and spend quality time together. The Dadathlon is organised as a series of three discipline-specific races held at different times during the year, and participants can join live events (such as in Stockholm's Hagaparken) or take part virtually. One of the events is a running-with-kids challenge where strollers are explicitly allowed and activities are tracked with an app or sports watch and uploaded to the platform. The event emphasises participation, shared experiences and inspiring photos/videos rather than only competition.
course_highlights: Family-friendly running with kids (strollers allowed)
Live event in Stockholm's Hagaparken with a parallel virtual competition
Three-part series across the year (complete all three to become a full Dadathlon; single-event sign-up possible)
additional: Event supports both live and virtual participation; participants track activity with an app or sports watch and upload results and device activation link to the platform. A leaderboard is available, but prizes are awarded for the most inspiring pictures/videos rather than pure time-based competition. It is allowed to stop your tracking device to take breaks for the child's comfort. The organisers encourage tagging @daddyhoodeurope and using #DaddyHoodDadathlon. Gratis registrering; Hagaparken, Stockholm; Löpning med barn (1.5 km eller 3 km); insamling till Barncancerfonden.

name: Modine Söderköpings Stadslopp
organizer: Norrköpings Löparklubb i samarbete med Söderköpings OK

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Alla barn deltar som vanligt helt gratis i Ramunderstaden Lilla Brunnsparksloppet.

description: Modine Söderköpings Stadslopp is a fast and popular 5-kilometer race with start and finish in Brunnsparken in Söderköping. The seventh edition will be held on Tuesday, June 16, 2026, featuring a flat and easily runnable course suitable for both fast runners and recreational participants. The race is lined with music stations and large audience support, and after crossing the finish line, participants are offered a summer plate from ICA Supermarket. The event also includes the free children's race Ramunderstaden Lilla Brunnsparksloppet with several age categories.
course_highlights: Flat, fast 5 km course (measured by federation measurer Per Lindh)
Start and finish in Brunnsparken, Söderköping
Course lined with music stations and large audience support
additional: Number bib distribution: ICA Supermarket Söderköping Monday, June 15, 12:00 - 18:00; other bibs are distributed at the start/finish area no later than one hour before the start. The chip is attached as a tab at the top of the bib and should not be removed for timing. Water is available at the start/finish and at 2.8 km. World Class is responsible for warm-up (15 minutes before each start; children's races warm-up at 16:45). After the race, ICA Supermarket offers a summer plate; massage is available after the race. Late registration: via website and on-site; online registration until June 14 at 16:00 according to info, regular late registration (additional fee +50 SEK = total 375 SEK) is valid from June 8 until one hour before the start, and on-site/bib distribution late registration can also be done (the website's news page mentions on-site registration 345 SEK). The course is 5 km through Söderköping; start and finish area in Brunnsparken; chip timing with Racetimer; warm-up before start by World Class; water at start/finish and at 2.8 km; medal for all participants; bag/outerwear drop-off at start and finish; the children's race Lilla Brunnsparksloppet (1.1 km) for kids; registration via the website; bibs are picked up at ICA Söderköping.

name: Blodomloppet (Visby)
description: Welcome to the Blood Race in Visby - a community race to raise awareness for blood donation where you can walk, jog, or run 5 km or 10 km, as well as participate in the Little Blood Race. The courses pass through Visby's cultural sites and are open to both individual participants and teams. The event is organized locally by VIF Gute Friidrott in collaboration with the Visby Blood Center and often concludes with a picnic and activities for participants.
course_highlights: 5 km and 10 km run along Visby's city wall and through the city center
10 km includes the seaside promenade, Almedalen, and Visby harbor
Beautiful cultural and urban environment with historic views
additional: Team registration (laganmälan) is available and costs 1,750 SEK until May 26; there is an option to register many participants via an Excel template that can be imported into the registration; the race promotes blood donation and provides information about blood donor gifts; local organizers: VIF Gute Friidrott (contact: Annie Gardell, Tel 0733 909722, email visby@blodomloppet.se) and the Blood Center in Visby (Tel 0498-26 84 53, email blodcentralen@gotland.se). Three categories: 10 km, 5 km, and Little Blood Race; registration via blodomloppet.se; start times in Visby according to information on the website; included items: functional T-shirt, bib number, and medal; team registration for companies/groups is available as an option; live broadcast of the race on blodomloppet.se.

name: Midsommarjoggen 2026
description: Midsummer Run is a running festival in Rynningeviken Nature Reserve in Örebro, scheduled for June 17, 2026. The main race is 7.2 km, mostly on easy-to-run gravel paths along the water and through the forest, suitable for both runners who want to run fast and those who prefer to jog or walk at a summer pace. The course passes Rävgången and Naturens Hus and concludes with an after-run at Stora Hjortstorp Farm, where food, drinks, and camaraderie are offered. There is also a KidsRun (approximately 600 meters) for children born in 2016 and later.
course_highlights: 7.2 km mostly easy-to-run gravel path along the water in Rynningeviken
Passes Rävgången and Naturens Hus with evening sun and lake view
Two wooden bridges over Lillån and two longer climbs at Venastugan
additional: Start at 18:30 (warm-up at 18:15, mandatory race briefing at 18:25). KidsRun starts at 17:45 (gathering at 17:40). Bibs can be collected at the secretariat from 16:00, latest by 18:10. Timing is done with a transponder loaned out (lost transponder fee 800 SEK); no timing for KidsRun. Water stations/energy at 3 km and 5 km; toilets are available at the area and water stations. No changing rooms or showers on site. After run at Stora Hjortstorp Farm (BBQ 299 SEK including water and coffee, children under 12 half price). Youth (born 2008 or later) get 50% discount; group registration via info@epictrail.se. The course is detailed as 7.2 km in Rynningeviken Nature Reserve; transponders are loaned at the start and must be returned (800 SEK fee for loss); survival food/drinks along the course and after run at Stora Hjortstorp Farm (BBQ buffet 299 SEK including water and coffee); no changing rooms or showers; KidsRun without timing; registration fee includes entry, bib, timing, medal, sports drink, and energy.

name: Borejoggen

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Lagjoggen följer samma priser som Borejoggen, alltså 300:-/person och ytterligare 50:- per person vid efteranmälan.

course_highlights: Huvudbanan cirka 8,5 km på asfalt i centrala Torsby
Minijoggen cirka 1,5 km för barn och ungdomar
Vätskekontroller vid 2 km, 5,8 km och i mål
additional: Start på Östmarksvägen/Herrgårdsparken. Nummerlappar/tidtagningschip hämtas på Prima Sport under midsomarveckan. Ombyte/dusch finns på Björnevi IP och Valbergsstugan; toaletter i Herrgårdsparken och Björnevi IP. Priser utlovas (bl.a. spurt- och bergspriser samt prispengar till segrare), trafikvakter vid trafikerade vägar och sjukvård finns vid målet. Banan omfattar 8,5 km asfalt i centrala Torsby; starttiderna är Minijoggen 9:30 och Borejoggen/Lagjoggen 11:00; anmälan sker via RaceID eller Prima Sport; lagklass Lagjoggen kräver tre deltagare per lag; vätskekontroller finns enligt specifik bana.

name: Midsommartrail - Möt ljuset
description: Midsummer Trail - Meet the light is a personal trail run held on the longest day of the year with a focus on the experience. The race starts before dawn so you can run into the daylight along a 30 km course in beautiful forest terrain. The number of participants is limited (max 100) to create an intimate and caring atmosphere, and after finishing, the organizer offers a plentiful breakfast. Navigation is done with a pre-delivered GPS route and a map at the start, and there are two energy stations along the way.
course_highlights: 30 km trail run at dawn where you "meet the light" along the course
Two energy stations placed along the route
Navigation with GPS route and map (runner responsible for navigation)
additional: Start/finish at Attunda Orienteering Clubhouse, Ytterbyvägen 22, Sollentuna; easiest public transport: commuter train to Rotebro (1.5 km walk); parking at Sollentuna Golf Club (500 m walk) and parking on Ytterbyvägen is not allowed; maximum 100 participants; breakfast served after the race; registration open until one hour before start; age limit 18 years; recommended accommodation: Good Morning Hotel Sollentuna (discount code NIGHTTRAILRUN). Start time 02:00 on 2026-06-21. 30 km trail run; GPS route and map; two energy stations along the way; breakfast after finish; hotel discount at Good Morning Hotel Sollentuna with code NIGHTTRAILRUN.

name: Night Trail Run  Sommar 2025
description: Night Trail Run Summer Trail is a personal trail race in Sollentuna held on the longest day of the year. The race is 30 km long and starts at dawn to give participants the experience of meeting the summer light; the number of participants is limited to maintain an intimate atmosphere. Participants navigate using a GPS route (sent in advance) and also receive a map at the start. After finishing, a plentiful breakfast is offered so you can share the experience with other runners.
course_highlights: 30 km trail run starting before dawn and reaching daylight
Participants navigate themselves with GPS route + map at start
Two energy stations along the course and breakfast after finishing
additional: Max 100 runners. Start/finish at Attunda Orienteering Clubhouse, Ytterbyvägen 22 in Sollentuna. Nearest public transport: commuter train to Rotebro station and about 1.5 km walk to the venue. Parking is recommended at Sollentuna Golf Club (approximately 500 m); parking on Ytterbyvägen is not allowed. Participants are responsible for navigation; GPS route is sent in advance and a map is distributed at the start. Registration is open until one hour before the race starts. Age limit: 18 years. Recommended accommodation: Good Morning Hotel Sollentuna (discount code NIGHTTRAILRUN). Seasonal variants include Summer Trail as well as Autumn Trail and Dog Trail, where the experience and night adventure are emphasized as the core of Night Trail Run.

name: Böda Beach Run
location: Böda Sand-stranden, Löttorp, Borgholm Municipality, Kalmar County, Sweden
description: Böda Beach Run is a race that stands out a bit extra at Böda Sand. It is a tough competition in sand and water suitable for both those who want to compete seriously and families who want to have fun, with courses ranging from 500 meters up to 10 km. Everyone who completes the race receives a medal. The event is held at Böda Sand Beach Resort on June 24.
course_highlights: Courses from 500 m up to 10 km
Tough competition in sand and water
Medal for all finishers
additional: Date: June 24. The event takes place at Böda Sand Beach Resort (Bödasandsallén 11, 387 73 Löttorp). Contact/phone for Böda Sand: (+46)485-22200. The event is marketed as family-friendly and is a recurring event in the resort's event calendar. Accommodation special offers are available at Böda Sand; registration and bib pickup are from Nordpoolen at 12:00 on race day.

name: Karlstad Stadslopp
description: Karlstad City Run is a popular 10 km race in Karlstad with options for all runners - from those chasing personal bests to those wanting to enjoy the camaraderie along the Klarälven. The event offers the classic 10 km, a shorter 5 km, as well as Karlstad Mini Race and Mini Mini Race for younger participants. The race starts from Tingvallabron and finishes in Museiparken; the 2026 edition inaugurates the Swedish Championships week and will be broadcast on SVT. The organizer IF Göta Karlstad welcomes participants of all ages and experience levels.
course_highlights: Start at Tingvallabron
Finish at Museiparken
Route along the Klarälven
additional: When registering, an estimated running time is provided for seeding; youth born in 2008 or later and students receive a 100 SEK discount during certain periods; team competition is offered for the 10 km (minimum six participants per team) - contact tavling@ifgota.se for team registration; payment via PlusGiro (47 37 91-2) with instructions for class and name; gift cards can be purchased via PG and notified to info@ifgota.se; participant information (PM) is sent via email and published on the website; After Run and concert in Museiparken are included in the Swedish Championships week opening; the race is part of the Swedish Championships week 2026 and will be broadcast on SVT. The race offers 10 km and 5 km as well as Karlstad Mini Race (ages 7-12) and Mini Mini Race (ages 0-6). Age limit 12 years; dogs are not allowed; walking with strollers or rollators can start in the last start group; participation at own risk; no refund of registration fee; image publication is permitted on websites and social media.

name: St Olavsloppet
description: St Olavsloppet is a three-day relay race that runs from Trondheim to Östersund and is conducted in stages over three days. The race includes several daily stages (e.g., Day 1: Trondheim - Stiklestad, approximately 120.6 km) and has alternative start and finish locations such as Stjørdal, Sandvika, Åre, and Mörsil. The competition is organized for teams in various classes and rewards participants with diplomas, raffle prizes, and the Mini-Olav medal. Registration is done via email, and payment instructions for Norwegian, Swedish, and international participants are available on the registration page.
course_highlights: Day 1: Trondheim - Stiklestad, approx. 120.6 km
Three-day stage format: stages via Stiklestad, Åre, and the final destination Östersund
Alternative start points/stages mentioned: Stjørdal, Sandvika, and Mörsil
additional: Registration is via email (Norwegian participants: post@stolavsloppet.no; Swedish teams: larspeterbring@gmail.com). Payment instructions are available: Norwegian participants bank account Sparebank1 SMN; Swedish participants Swish or bankgiro; international participants details via Länsförsäkringar Bank (IBAN/BIC) and payee St Olavsgruppens ideella förening. Discounts for associations/companies registering multiple teams for "St Olav 340" are indicated (team 2: 25%, team 3: 50%, team 4: 75%, from team 5: 100%). All teams participating in the physical race receive a diploma after finishing, and all participants receive a Mini-Olav medal. In previous events, the first starting group (about 20 runners) left Trondheim Stadion at the start. Official website provides information on distances, classes, participant info, accommodation, and sustainability.

name: Trosa Stadslopp
description: Trosa City Run is a long-standing community festival held annually on the first Friday after Midsummer - in 2026, the race will take place on Friday, June 26. The course runs through the summer-blooming Trosa with lots of spectators and proximity to the water, contributing to a summery competitive and recreational atmosphere. The event features categories for elite runners, recreational runners, youth, and children, and offers both the main race of 8,900 meters and shorter recreational options.
course_highlights: Course route through the summer-blooming Trosa, near the water
Main race 8,900 m plus recreational runs Jogging/Nordic walking 4 km and children's race 700 m
Start and finish at Trosa square with enthusiastic spectators and stage activities
additional: Registration portal remains open until the start, and payment can be made via Swish or card; alternatively, use Trosa City Run's bank transfer number 488-8335 for payment. Folksam recreational run insurance is offered (e.g., 155 SEK for basic coverage, Startklar Plus 275 SEK). Bib number distribution opens at 10:00 at Team Sportia on race day. The main race of 8,900 m has time-based start groups (start group 1 at 21:00, followed by additional groups); there are also children's races (700 m) and prize ceremonies from the stage. The organizer distributes 50 cl Vitamin Well to runners in the 8,900 m and 4 km races. Distances also include 700 m and 900 m in the program; Jogging/Nordic walking 4 km; night bus information to Stockholm after the race.

name: Silverleden Ultra 100 Miles
description: Silverleden Ultra is a trail ultramarathon in Bergslagen held in Hällefors with start/finish at Hurtigtorpet during the weekend of June 26-27, 2026. The event offers courses of 33 km, 64 km, and 100 miles and is promoted with slogans such as "Running joy," "Both long & tough," and "Run. Survive. Show off" - a technical and hilly event for those seeking a challenging nature experience. For 2026, the 100 miles category is fully booked. The race is aimed at experienced ultrarunners and runners who want to challenge themselves in rocky, root-filled, and hilly terrain.
course_highlights: Technical trail with many hills; the longer climbs mostly occur on the second half of the course
Roots and rocky slabs that become very slippery in wet conditions - trail shoes with a coarse tread are recommended
Control at Silvergruvan (around 35 km) - possibility to have poles delivered to the control point
additional: Bus: transportation from Hurtigtorpet to the start for the 33 km race departs at 10:30, limited number of seats which must be pre-booked (book by 2026-06-20). Accommodation: several local options listed within 5 - 20 km from start/finish. Caravan/motorhome spots are available in limited numbers - contact via info@silverledenultra.se; electricity is limited and cannot be guaranteed. No charging options for electric cars at the start/finish in Hurtigtorpet. Minimum age for participants is 15 years (the year they turn 15); relay teams cannot be registered in 2026. For international participants, payment can be made via the provided IBAN; the order confirmation from the registration system serves as proof for health insurance benefits. Early Bird prices are mentioned in the information, but exact amounts are not specified.

name: Tänndalen 100 miles
description: Tänndalen 100 Miles is a runnable road race — yet set in landscapes that feel like true mountain running. The roads are quiet, often with more reindeer than cars, and the surroundings offer an almost otherworldly stillness. It’s a journey through both nature and history, where every step is buoyed by the vast mountains, the crisp air, and the silence.
course_highlights: Rolling, quiet roads through mountain environments - a road race feeling in high mountain terrain
Passes Fjällnäs, crosses the border to Norway via Vauldalen, and reaches the UNESCO town Røros
Approximately 980 meters of total elevation gain; officially measured 100 miles (161 km); opportunity to leave a drop bag at Ski Lodge after ~115 km
additional: Maximum time to complete the race is 30 hours. The course length is officially measured to 100 miles (161 km) and all runners carry individual trackers. The registration fee includes food and drinks at aid stations; participant T-shirt if you register by April 30. Registration is final and no on-site registrations are offered. Refunds are available in case of illness/coverage via Startklar insurance (155 SEK) or Startklar Plus (275 SEK). Prize money for 1st - 3rd place (10,000 / 7,500 / 5,000 SEK). Accommodation offer: 10% discount at Ski Lodge Tänndalen with the code 100MILES; shared accommodation offered for 1000 SEK per person. Fjällöparveckan offers year-round mountain runs and technical clinics; registration for Tänndalen 100 Miles opened September 1, 2025, and the race has a maximum of 100 runners. The race marks a mountain-adjacent ultramarathon that is part of a larger week of mountain activities in Tänndalen.

images.alt_text: Löpare på en slingrande väg i fjällandskap.

name: Kalmar Malkars 21 km
description: Kalmar Malkars 21 km is a fast, single-loop half marathon that passes through many of Kalmar's beautiful environments and is suitable for both competitive runners and recreational participants. The start and finish are at Malkars Training Center on Torsåsgatan, and the course offers views of the Kalmar Sound, Kalmar Castle, and the Öland Bridge. In addition to the half marathon, Malkars Femman (5 km) is also offered, which is open to walking, wheelchair users, and strollers — with a focus on joy of movement. Medals are awarded to all who complete the races.
course_highlights: Single-loop course passing Kalmar Castle and Kalmar Sound
Views of the Öland Bridge along Ängöleden
Fast course where many set personal records
additional: Start and finish at Malkars Training Center, Torsåsgatan 1, Kalmar. Bib distribution: Friday, June 26 from 15:00 to 17:00 and Saturday, June 27 from 12:00 to 15:00; late registration until June 25, thereafter possible at bib distribution. Payment methods for late registration: cash, card, or Swish. Water stations on the half marathon after 5, 10, 15, 18 km and at the finish line (Umara sports drinks and water). All who register for the 21.1 km by June 20 will receive a shirt at bib distribution. Medals to all finishers; ICA MAXI offers drinks, fruit, and chocolate after the race. Information: Jonne Svensson 070-693 87 44, Calle Nilsson 070-444 31 02. The half marathon includes hydration stations after 5, 10, 15, 18 km and at the finish; bibs are collected at designated times; late registration is open until June 25; payment via card, cash, or Swish; a shirt is offered to those registering before June 20; medals to all finishers.

name: Jordgubbslunken
description: The Strawberry Slush is a popular countryside race in Rudskoga with the motto "walk, stroll, run". The race offers Little Slush (6 km) and Big Slush (10 km) as well as a Mini Slush for children (born -17 or later). Start and finish are at Grunnebacka School, and the courses follow winding village roads through a beautiful cultural landscape. At the finish line, all participants receive a liter of strawberries, and there is a generous prize table as well as a high-value prize raffled off with the start number.
course_highlights: 6 km loop on gravel surface
10 km loop alternating between gravel road and well-maintained grass
Start and finish at Grunnebacka School; courses follow winding village roads through cultural landscape
additional: Always on the first Saturday after Midsummer; Categories for men, women, and children; Mini Slush for children born -17 or later; All participants receive a liter of strawberries at the finish; Generous prize table and a high-value prize raffled with the start number; Information about this year's race is published under "På gång i Rudskoga" on the website. The 6 km course has a gravel surface, while the 10 km course alternates between gravel road and well-maintained grass. Start at 15:00. Registration on site by 14:30 at the latest (on-site registration against a higher fee). Payment via Bankgiro 505-1404 or Swish 1233296605; questions can be directed to the provided phone numbers listed in the details.

name: H2 Trail
distance_verbose: 50 miles, 50 km, 28 km, 18 km, 10 km, 5 km
description: Umara H2 Trail 2026 is the OK Skogsvargarna's trail race taking place on Saturday, June 27, from the race center Bergagården on Hunneberg. The event includes several distances (80 km, 50 km, 28 km, 18 km, 11 km, 6 km) as well as a kids' and mini trail for the youngest participants. The courses run over Halle and Hunneberg plateaus and offer viewpoints, cottages, and swimming spots in varied terrain. The event features family-oriented activities for children and practical information about equipment and safety on the website.
course_highlights: The course runs over the Halle and Hunneberg plateaus with several viewpoints
Surface: majority trails (about 73%), plus gravel roads (23%) and a little asphalt (4%)
Technical and difficult downhill at Krösa Klev, marked with extra signs
additional: Race center: Bergagården, parking approximately 300 meters from the center (follow signs). Course marked with blue arrows and blue-white ribbons. All participants must carry their own fluids and a mug (mugs available for purchase at the race center). Support is available at two designated locations along the course (Halleberg turnaround and Hunneberg north of Fristorps Gransjö, and at the turnaround at Bergagården). Recommended headlamp for those running late (especially 80 km); mobile phone and power bank are recommended. The kids' and mini trail and mini race have a separate, family-friendly setup, medals for all participants, and a fee of 50 SEK (late registration/onsite registration for children’s races). Showers and sauna are available at the club house at Bergagården. Race center: Bergagården, Hunneberg. Start times according to distance: 80 km at 08:00, 50 km at 08:00, 28 km at 10:00, 18 km at 09:00, 11 km at 10:15; Kids' trail start around 10:45/11:00. The kids' and mini race are for the youngest age groups.

name: Fjällmaraton Gastronomi
location: Ottsjö, Åre Municipality, Jämtland County, Sweden
course_highlights: Point-to-point in mountain terrain with both 24 km and 42 km options
Food stations approximately every 7 km serving local mountain-based dishes on site
2026 routes: longer course starts/finishes in Ottsjö; shorter course starts in Trillevallen and finishes in Ottsjö
additional: Non-competitive format with open start; recommendation to start early for slow hikers. Transfer to start can be booked (transfer booking opens about two weeks before the race). Organizers recommend accommodation at Trillevallens Högfjällshotell or in Ottsjö (contact details available on the website). Event memos contain details about transportation and logistics. Open start times to allow a relaxed pace; feed stations roughly every 7 km featuring local producers; accommodation suggestions at Trillevallens Högfjällshotell or Ottsjö; bus transfers to start from Ottsjö, Trillevallen and Undersåker; electronic timing and transport logistics managed by the event.

name: Silverleden Ultra
description: Silverleden Ultra is a trail race in Hällefors/Bergslagen with distances of 64 km, 33 km, and 100 miles. The race will be held from June 26 to June 27, 2026, and is marketed under the slogans running joy - technical, hilly nature with lots of trails and climbing awaiting participants. The 100 miles race is fully booked for 2026. The organizer's language and information emphasize natural, demanding courses where proper equipment is recommended.
course_highlights: Hilly terrain with many climbs - the larger climbs are mainly in the second half of the course
Technical trail with roots and rocky surfaces; trail shoes with a coarse pattern are recommended
The course passes the control at Silvergruvan (mentioned as a control point after approximately 35 km)
additional: Practical: Bus to the start for the 33 km race departs from Hurtigtorpet at 10:30 and must be booked in advance (booking available until 2026-06-20); payment outside of card can be made to IBAN SE09 9020 0000 0906 0545 6739 with reference number from registration; limited parking spaces for caravans/motorhomes - notify via info@silverledenultra.se (limited access to electricity); relay registration not possible in 2026; minimum age 15 years (the year they turn) to participate, 33 km can be completed under supervision of a guardian even if younger; confirmation from the registration system serves as proof for health insurance benefits; equipment recommendations: trail shoes are recommended and metal studs are not recommended; poles are used by few but can be recommended for the second half of the course and can be delivered to the control at Silvergruvan. GPX and Strava links are available; maximum time 12 hours; energy stations along the course; map and course descriptions are available on the website.

name: Bocksten Trailrun
location: Öströö Fårfarm, Åkulla Bokskogar, Varberg Municipality, Halland County, Sweden
distance_verbose: Marathon, 24 km, Halvmarathon, 12 km, 6.7 km, 5 km
description: Bocksten TrailRun is a nature-oriented trail race with the competition center at Öströö sheep farm and courses in Åkulla beech forests. The event offers four distances (5 km, 12 km, 22 km, and Ultra 44 km) through beech forest, spruce forest, lake views, and varied trails. The races are spectator-friendly, have limited starting spots, and participants receive a special medal. Welcome to experience running joy and community in a magical forest environment.
course_highlights: Running in Åkulla beech forests and mystical spruce woods
Varied terrain: technical trails, off-trail sections, and gravel roads with lake views
Many elevation meters and scenic vistas; also a 6.7 km loop for Vineyard Backyard Ultra
additional: Distance options: 5 km (start at 10:15, 200 spots), 12 km (start at 10:00, 400 spots), 22 km (start at 10:30, 300 spots), and Ultra 44 km (start at 08:00, 100 spots). Total limited number of starting spots (only 1000 spots). GPS coordinates for the competition center: 57.06881078975495, 12.506526026672418. During the event, only tap water is used (no plastic bottles); Tailwind and juice are available as alternatives. For Vineyard Backyard Ultra, a personal cup/mug is mandatory; headlamp and personal medication are mandatory, and the headlamp must be worn between 20:00 and 07:00. Bib distribution and registration are handled at the start area (times specified in the invitation); for assistance, contact race management at 076-8159678. Possibility to purchase Startklar cancellation and accident insurance (prices specified in the invitation). The summer edition takes place on June 27, 2026, with distances of 5/12/22/Ultra 44 km; the winter edition is held at Öströö Gård with 5/12/24 km and 500 spots, accommodation can be booked via Åkulla Resort with a discount (code bockstentrailrun). The Backyard Ultra race at Ästad Vingård has a 6.7 km course and starts every full hour.

name: Kustmaran (Kristianopel)
distance_verbose: Marathon, Halvmarathon, 10 km, 5 km, 2.5 km, 0.9 km
description: Kustmaran and Kristianopel Runt is a running festival for the whole family in the picturesque Kristianopel on the east coast, with distances from 0.9 km up to a marathon (42.2 km). The event will be held on June 27, 2026, and offers both competitive races and recreational options, as well as dedicated support from Team Blekinge's officials. The day combines running in an idyllic summer landscape with opportunities for swimming, dining, and accommodation in the area. Everyone is welcome, from children’s races and walks/'Sommarlunken' without timing to half and full marathons for more experienced runners.
course_highlights: Running in an idyllic summer landscape around the picturesque Kristianopel on the east coast
Range of courses: marathon (42.2 km), half marathon (21.1 km), 10 km, 5 km, 2.5 km, 0.9 km (children's race), and Sommarlunken 4 km
Children's race takes place at Kristianopel Camping; opportunities for swimming and services in the village
additional: Number bibs can be collected and late registration can be done on race day from 08:00. Payment for regular registration is by card or Swish; for bank transfer, contact register@teamblekinge.nu before registration. Electronic timing is provided by Racetimer. Half marathon and marathon require participants to be at least 17 years old during the year. Sommarlunken is without timing and no medal is awarded; there are prize draws. Start times vary by distance; electronic timing; registration and payment options include card and Swish for regular registration, bank transfer via contact if needed; late registration via Swish or cash; parking outside Kristianopel; water and changing facilities, toilets, and medical services at the finish area; rules according to the Swedish Athletics Federation.

name: TrailÖvik
description: TrailÖvik is a welcoming trail race in Själevad on June 28, 2026, featuring several courses (Mini, 6 km, 12 km, 22 km, and Night Edition) suitable for both recreational runners and elite athletes. The routes pass through spectacular nature with technical singletracks, hilly terrain, and several viewpoints over the World Heritage site Höga Kusten. The event emphasizes a family-friendly yet professional atmosphere, with pre-race runs, maps, and services along the course. The arena and start/finish are at the Skogslöparnas clubhouse, and the race has been praised for its varied and challenging trails.
course_highlights: Spectacular nature and views over Höga Kusten from, among others, Mycklingberget's summit
Technical trail paths with steep sections, stairs up Mycklingberget, and ropes at certain passages
The 22 km course includes three mountain peaks, marshes, stream ravines, and water stations (sports drinks and water)
additional: Arena/start and bib number pickup at the gravel area below the Skogslöparnas clubhouse (Nordhemsvägen 41, 89430 Själevad); bibs must be collected no later than 30 minutes before the start; race info will be published 10 days prior; registration is via Mittlopp, with late registration opening at the arena and closing 30 minutes before each start; pre-runs and maps are available (physical maps in mailboxes at the start of Älgstråk and downloadable maps); live stream and live results will be provided; it is recommended to wear studded shoes in wet weather and information about water stations (22 km: first station around 4 km with sports drink and water). Four distances and Night Edition; start around 11:00 am; registration via Mittlopp; the arena is located below the Skogslöparnas clubhouse in Själevad (Nordhemsvägen 41); maps/pre-runs and course markings are offered; results are displayed immediately at the arena and online.

name: Böda Sandsloppet
location: Böda Sand SportCamp, Böda Sand, Öland, Sweden
description: Böda Sandsloppet is a family-friendly fun run organized at Böda Sand on Öland by Högby IF athletics. The race offers several distances for adults and youth - 6.5 km and 4 km for adults, and 1.8 km and 1 km for youth - starting and finishing at Böda Sand SportCamp. All finishers receive a medal, and the highlight of the meal class is sausage after crossing the finish line. Registration is available via olandrunning.se or on-site, with the last registration day on June 26, 2026 (with late registration until July 1).
course_highlights: Forest terrain along Böda Sand area on Öland
Distance options for adults: 6.5 km and 4 km; for youth: 1.8 km and 1 km
All finishers receive a medal and sausage is served after the finish
additional: Start and finish at Böda Sand SportCamp. Last registration date June 26, 2026; late registration until July 1. Registration via olandrunning.se or on-site. Payment by cash, card, or Swish.

name: Byrundan
location: Unos Park, Gamleby, Västervik Municipality, Kalmar County, Sweden
description: The city run is a race held within Gamleby with start and finish in Unos Park. The event offers races for all ages and is well suited for both recreational runners and families. Welcome July 3, 2026 - registration opens soon.
course_highlights: Runs within Gamleby (urban environment)
Start and finish in Unos Park
Race for all ages
additional: Registration opens soon; start and finish in Unos Park; races offered for all ages; organizer's mailing address: C/o Lena Persson, Lapserums Gård, 594 92 Gamleby. The race is held indoors in Unos Park; registration opens soon for July 3, 2026.

name: Strömstadmilen
description: The Strömstad Mile is organized by Strömstad Running Club and takes place on Saturday, July 4, 2026. The race offers runner-friendly distances through the center of Strömstad when Bohuslän is at its most beautiful, with the course lined by dense spectator areas. The main course is an exactly measured 5 km loop that can be run once or twice (5 km or 10 km); start and finish are at Strömsvallen. Everyone is welcome - there are also children's classes and a walking class for those who want to experience the race without timing.
course_highlights: Runner-friendly 5 km loop through Strömstad city center (run 1 or 2 laps for 5/10 km)
The course is lined with spectators and clearly marked with many signs
Start and finish at Strömsvallen; lap in the outer lanes according to instructions
additional: Number bib distribution and late registration: Friday, July 3 from 15:00 to 18:00 at Strömstad Shopping Center and on race day from 09:30 at Strömsvallen. The T-shirt can be pre-ordered with registration by June 7 (199 SEK) and picked up with the bib; sizes for children and adults are available. Timing ends at 16:45. Limited parking spaces at Strömsvallen; alternative parking at Strömstad Gymnasium (~500 m). Everyone who finishes receives a specially designed medal; photographers are along the course and a selection of images will be published on Facebook/Instagram after the race. A new walking class approximately 3 km along Strömstadvattnet; start and finish at the Open-Air Museum/Fiskartorpet; start time 11:00; distances include 10 km as two laps of 5 km, 5 km, 4 km walk, 10 miles for youth, and 1 km for the youngest children; bibs and late registration via Strömstad Shopping Center or Strömsvallen; T-shirt, medal, award ceremony, parking, and other logistics.

description: Kolmården Ultra Trail is a welcoming yet challenging trail run for both elite runners and amateurs. Choose between longer challenges (45 km or 60 km) where the course takes you through Kolmårdsskogen, up to Kvarseboklints mountain ridge, down to the shore of Bråviken, past Nävsjön's nature, and finally through the technical Bråviksbranten before reaching the finish line. The race combines technical trails, boardwalks over mosses, and spectacular views, with well-equipped water stations along the way. The organizer emphasizes safety and mandatory equipment, as well as a finishing medal and light refreshments at the finish.
