description: Welcome to Ekerumsloppet, a fall cross-country race around Ekerum and Rällaskogen on Öland, organized by Högby IF athletics. The race offers 10 km for adults and approximately 1.3 km for youth, starting at 11:00 and 10:00 respectively, with start and finish at Ekerum Resort. Registration must be completed by September 26, 2026; late registration is available at the bib pickup from 09:00 on race day. The course runs on forest trails around Ekerum and Rällaskogen.
course_highlights: Cross-country trails in forest terrain around Ekerum and Rällaskogen
Start and finish at Ekerum Resort
Two distances: 10 km for adults and approximately 1.3 km for youth
additional: Cross-country race in forest terrain around Ekerum and Rällaskogen; Start and finish at Ekerum Resort; Registration deadline September 26, 2026; Late registration at bib pickup from 09:00 on race day

name: Tidaholm Marathon
description: Tidaholm Marathon is a running event in Tidaholm, Sweden, organized by Motionsloppet. Official information and results are published on motionsloppet.se. The event is promoted via Motionsloppet's Facebook page and advertised as Tidaholm Marathon by the municipality's event page, indicating that it is a recurring race in the area.
additional: Results are available at motionsloppet.se; the event has been communicated via the municipality's Facebook event page (Tidaholm Marathon).

name: Rya Åsar Trail Run 2025

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 295 kr jubileumspris max 100 platser eller till och med 31 mars

description: Rya Åsar Trail Run is a family-friendly trail race in the Rya Åsar nature reserve in Borås, with several distances for both competitive runners and recreational participants. The race offers beautiful trails, challenging hills, and stunning views over lakes and cliffs. The event is a festival at the start and finish area with music, exhibitors, and a runners lounge. The event has been held since 2017 and includes both children's races and sanctioned competitions.
course_highlights: Beautiful trails and challenging hills (including Djävulsbacken/Björbotoppen)
Scenic views with passages at Rya Klint and Fjällsjön; 24 km has approximately 685 meters of elevation gain
Varied terrain: technical trails, gravel roads, and a downhill finish
additional: Number bib distribution is available on Friday from 13:30 to 18:00 at Glasögonmäster and on Saturday from 09:45 to 12:45 at the race area. Chip timing via Eq Timing; leave bags at the start/finish area. Parking options are available at Almenäsvägen, Ryda Sportfält, and Knalleland; good bus connections to nearby stops. Runners Lounge and food/drinks are available on site; changing rooms and showers are available at Borås Camping. Water stations: 24 km has 4 stations, 12 km has 2 stations (sports drinks from Umara). Recommended equipment: mobile phone, elastic bandage, and trail shoes (especially for 24 km). Sanctioned by the Swedish Athletics Association; part of the Trail Tour; start time 13:00; the 2025 race was moved to October 5 due to weather warnings; contact and registration via info@ryaasartrailrun.se; results are published on the race results page.

name: Malmö Marathon
description: A flat and fast course in beautiful Malmö
course_highlights: Joint finish at Ribersborg
Very flat courses (marathon ~28 m elevation, half marathon ~19 m elevation)
The marathon course includes a 7.5 km loop around Ribersborg and rounds via Limhamn, Ön, and First Camp Sibbarp
additional:
See the website and FAQ 
https://malmomarathon.com/qa/

images.alt_text: Lyckligt par kramas vid mållinjen på Malmö Marathon med Puma-logotyp.
Löpare samlade vid startlinjen för Malmö Marathon.
Löpare korsar mållinjen i Malmö Marathon med armarna utsträckta, publiken hejar på.

name: John Bauer Trail Run
distance_verbose: 18 km, 10 km, 5 km, 5 km, 2 km, 0.4 km
price_range: 18 km: 400–700 kr; 10 km: 320–600 kr; 5 km upplevelseloppet: 160–300 kr; 5 km Stortrollens lopp: 120 kr; 2 km Knattetrollens lopp: 120–250 kr; 400 m: ej angivet
description: John Bauer Trail Run is a challenging and hilly cross-country race held from IKHP cabin on Huskvarnaberget. The race is offered in several distances (18 km, 10 km, 5 km, and several children/youth classes) and takes place partly on trails and partly on unpaved terrain with significant elevation changes and technical sections. A special feature is Strutsabacken, where run times are measured and the Bergatrollet award is given for the fastest ascent. The event is family-friendly with catering and activities at the start/finish, as well as changing rooms and showers in the IKHP cabin.
course_highlights: Challenging, hilly terrain with both trail and unpaved sections
Strutsabacken (slalom slope) with separate ascent time and the Bergatrollet award
View over Vättern and technical downhill through Ulvadalen
additional: Registration can be done on race day between 9:00 and 11:00. Bibs with timing chips are to be collected at the IKHP cabin no later than 11:15 and must be worn visibly during the race; the chip does not need to be returned. There are water stations placed along the course (kilometer markers per distance), changing rooms and showers in the IKHP cabin, secure valuables storage at bib distribution, and catering at the start/finish. The organizer offers participants a "troll menu" after finishing (show bib). After the race, hamburgers are served; water stations are available along the course; changing rooms and showers; insurance Startklar available (175 SEK/year); maximum 500 participants; bibs must be collected by 11:00 at IKHP cabin.

name: Broloppet Motala
description: Broloppet Motala returns with a new-old course layout and starts and finishes in Stadsparken in central Motala. The race is organized by Motala AIF Friidrott and offers short recreational distances suitable for a wide range of participants - both 5 km and 10 km are available. The event is promoted as one of Sweden's most beautiful recreational races and welcomes recreational runners and runners of all levels to participate on October 3rd.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Stadsparken in central Motala
New-old course layout through central parts of Motala
Shorter recreational distances (5 km and 10 km) suitable for casual runners
additional: Organizer: Motala AIF Friidrott. The event is described as "Sweden's most beautiful recreational race". The website encourages to mark October 3rd in the calendar and notes price levels until September 28th (next increase). Four distances: 10 km, 5 km, 1.5 km (youth), and 400 m (kids' race). Bibs can be collected at Team Sportia on October 2nd and 3rd. The award ceremony takes place in Stadsparken around 2:30 PM.

name: Förbifartspremiären
description: The bypass premiere is a one-time event where you can run or walk on the new E4, both above ground and through tunnel tubes, before the road opens to traffic. The race will be held on October 3, 2026, with start and finish at the new traffic junction Akalla and is suitable for both beginners and experienced runners. There are race categories (approximately 12 km), recreational categories (choose approximately 4, 7, or 12 km), and walking categories (Herr Gårman, approximately 4 km). The event is highlighted as a unique "once in a lifetime" experience to be among the first to traverse the new road.
course_highlights: The course goes both above ground and through tunnel tubes on the new E4
Start and finish at the new traffic junction Akalla (Vandagatan)
Recreational class has exits after approximately 4, 7, or 12 km so you can choose your distance during the race
additional: Registration opens February 5 at 12:00. The maximum race time is 1 hour 30 minutes; the competitive category starts around 09:00, the recreational categories have start times between 10:00 and 17:30, and Herr Gårman (walk) between 18:00 and 19:30. Customer service: Gustavslundsvägen 18, 167 51 Bromma, phone +46 8 545 66 440, opening hours Tuesday - Thursday 09:00 - 15:00 (lunch 12:00 - 13:00). Payment for individuals via card, Klarna invoice, or Swish; corporate invoices are only offered for groups of 20+ via special contact. Registration is binding and personal. Registration opens February 5 at 12:00; the first stage Hjulsta - Häggvik is planned to open at the end of 2026; the entire Stockholm Bypass will be completed in 2030; start places are sold through Marathongruppen; the race offers bib number, timing, finish line service, and medal; approximately 10,000 start places were sold in the first hour.

name: Hostruset

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 700 m Barn 3-7 år 50 kr (80 kr efteranmälan)

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 5 km Män, Kvinnor, PF19, Veteraner 60+ och Motion 150 kr (250 kr efteranmälan)

description: The Autumn Run is a fast-paced 5 km race in Örebro with start and finish at Björkhagaskolan. The race is sanctioned by the Swedish Athletics Association and is part of the Southern Svealands Running Series. There is also a 700 m children's race for ages 3 - 7. Information on the website is preliminary and will be updated for the 2026 event.
course_highlights: Fast 5 km course on bike paths around Varbergaskogen
Start and finish at Björkhagaskolan (changing rooms and showers available)
Measured course (measurement on 2024-09-08); timing with ankle transponder
additional: Late registration from September 29 (additional fee) can be made via the registration system and on race day (Swish only). Bibs are distributed on race day. Timing is done with a transponder on the ankle, which must be returned (lost transponder incurs a fee of 400 SEK). Parking options at the school are very limited; carpooling or parking at Karlslunds Sports Center is recommended. The race is sanctioned by the Swedish Athletics Association and is part of the Southern Svealands Running Series. Parking at the school is very limited; carpool or cycle to the area. Late registration increases the fee and Swish is used on race day. Registration is via anmalmig.nu; results are displayed online via Hug Timing.

name: Vånga Mountain Xtreme
description: FK Göingarna welcomes runners and spectators to Vånga Mountain Xtreme on October 4, 2026. Choose between 8, 16, or 40 km trail running with 300, 600, or 1500 meters of elevation gain; the course features the steep Vångabacke, winding trails through wilderness, and views by lakes and quarries. The race is promoted as both beautiful and very challenging, leaving a lasting impression. For the youngest participants, there is VMX Kids with free registration on-site.
course_highlights: Steep classic Vångabacke as a short but powerful climb
Winding trails through wilderness, past small lakes and deep quarries
Total elevation gains: 300 m (8 km), 600 m (16 km), 1500 m (40 km)
additional: Online registration via the website is open until Wednesday, September 30, 2026, at 23:59. Late registration can be made at the venue subject to availability until about an hour before the start; payment on-site is via Swish. Registration is binding and refund of the entry fee is only possible with valid insurance (e.g., Startklar). The races are sanctioned by the Swedish Athletics Association. Organizer: FK Göingarna. VMX Kids: free registration on-site. Maximum number of participants: 800; online registration until 2026-09-30 at 23:59; start times: VMX Kids starts at 12:15; maximum times: 3 hours (16 km) and 7 hours (40 km); Startklar insurance recommended; VMX Kids free registration on-site; the race is sanctioned by the Swedish Athletics Association.

name: Skrylle Challenge
location: Skryllegården, Skrylle naturreservat, Södra Sandby, Sweden
description: Skrylle Challenge is a trail-oriented race organized by Björnstorps IF with start/finish at Skryllegården. For 2026, the organizers are focusing on a new, more trail-based loop course where you can choose to run one or two laps: 12.5 km (one lap) or 25 km (two laps). The race is promoted as a close-to-nature and challenging experience on the best trails in the area, with information updated continuously during the spring. An early bird spot is offered, and there is also a children's race of 600 meters.
course_highlights: Loop course starting from Skryllegården
More trail - the course utilizes the area's best trails
Time limit for 25 km: passing 12.5 km no later than 12:15 (based on a start at 10:30)
additional: Registration can be done online up to 60 minutes before the start, and on-site registration is also available. On race day, name or class changes can be made for a fee of 100 SEK (class change 12.5->56 km 200 SEK). On-site payments can only be made via Swish. The 600 m children's race is free, medals are awarded, and pre-registration is not possible; bib numbers for the children's race are collected during check-in on race morning. Parking at Skryllegården may be crowded - the organizer encourages carpooling or cycling. New course with trail elements; first start at 12.5 km at 11:00 and 25 km at 10:30. The 25 km race has a time limit for the second lap at 12:15. Registration online until 60 minutes before the start; on-site or class changes allowed for a fee. On race day, registration can also be done on-site and paid via Swish. Bib distribution at Löplabbet in Lund before the race and at Skryllegården on race day. There is baggage check, and the 600 m children's race is free.

name: Bromöllamilen
description: Bromöllamilen is organized by Ryssbergets IK and offers several races on the same competition day: 10.0 km, 5.0 km, children's race 2.0 km, as well as a Walk - Stroll - Run option. Registration is done via the club's registration page and maps for 10.0 km and 5.0 km are published on the website. The club encourages participants to review the age/class division and volunteer information in advance. The organizer continuously communicates practical information via their website and contact email.
course_highlights: Courses for 10.0 km and 5.0 km (maps are available on the website)
Children's race 2.0 km and Walk - Stroll - Run as alternatives
Age/class division according to age/class (see division on the website)
additional: Maps for 10.0 km and 5.0 km are published on the website. There is a volunteer registration - the organizer requests volunteers and volunteer participation affects the handling of entry fees (see volunteer registration). Contact details and mailing address: Ryssbergets IK, Kyrkvägen 1, 29535 Bromölla; tel. 0705876711; email info@ryssbergetsik.se. Results will be published after the race.

name: Mental Health Run
description: Mental Health Run is a charity race aiming to raise awareness of how important physical activity is for mental health. The race is organized by the association Mental Health Run and all proceeds go directly to psychiatric research. In Stockholm, the start and finish are at the Maritime Museum, and the course is an easy 5 km loop around Djurgårdsbrunnsviken. Everyone should be able to participate regardless of background or fitness level - the event also offers a virtual option.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the Maritime Museum on Djurgården
Easy 5 km course around Djurgårdsbrunnsviken
Course on Djurgården with lake views and city environment
additional: There is a virtual version of the race (scheduled for October 10 - 18, 2026) and the event offers medals as an optional add-on during registration as well as the possibility to donate. Optional medals and donations are shipped within a month after the virtual race has ended. Information about bib numbers and pickup is published on the news pages (in previous years, bibs could be collected at Filmstaden Sergel). Medals as an optional add-on and the opportunity to donate to psychiatric research; medals are sent out within a month after the virtual race. The virtual race takes place via the Jogg app during the period October 10 - 18 with a special code, and results are displayed at the finish area. Timing is done with Racetimer; baggage drop, accessible toilets, and refreshments are available; Nordic walking and dogs are allowed to start further back.

name: Å-stadsloppet
price_range: 5 km: 150–300 kr; 10 km: 250–400 kr; 21,1 km: 300–450 kr; KidsRun: Gratis
description: Å-stadsloppet is a city race in Örebro that showcases the city's best features along the Svartån river. On October 10, 2026, distances of 21.1 km, 10 km, 5 km, and an Ullmax KidsRun for children are offered. The race is organized by KFUM Örebro Friidrott with start and services at Tybblelundshallen; information is updated continuously on the organizer's Facebook page. The race courses are measured and the event is conducted according to the rules of the Swedish Athletics Association.
course_highlights: Running along the beautiful Svartån
Passing through scenic Rynningeviken and Wadköping
The 5 km, 10 km, and 21.1 km courses are measured (measurer Bertil Sundin, 2024-09-22)
additional: Number bibs are distributed on race day at Tybblelundshallen (ID is not required and can be collected for multiple people). Timing is done with transponders attached to the foot/ankle and must be returned at the finish line or if the race is abandoned; lost transponders are charged at 400 SEK. Some participants receive a disposable chip on the bib that does not need to be returned. Changing rooms and valuables drop-off are available at Tybblelundshallen. Water stations, toilets, and medical services are located along the course; water and sports drinks are available at 10 km, 21.1 km, and at the finish. Parents are allowed to run with their children in the KidsRun free of charge. The half marathon requires participants to be at least 17 years old during the year; 5 km and 10 km have no age limit. Registration is done via anmalmig.nu; transponder-based timing and bib collection at Tybblelundshallen; water stations along the course; age limit of 17 years for the half marathon; 5 km and 10 km have no age restrictions.

name: Göteborg Marathon
description: Gothenburg Marathon is a classic race that in 2026 will be held for the 52nd time and offers a marathon and half marathon starting and finishing at the historic Slottsskogsvallen. The course was certified in 2024 and is a flat, straight loop course following the cycle path on the old railway embankment along the coast with a turnaround point at Lilla Amundön. Half marathon runners complete one lap and marathon runners two laps, providing good opportunities for fast times. The event is organized by Solvikingarna with the competition center at the Athletics House.
course_highlights: Flat and straight loop course along the old railway embankment by the coast with turnaround at Lilla Amundön
Half marathon = 1 lap, marathon = 2 laps; each kilometer marked
Water stations every four kilometers with water, sports drinks, Coca-Cola, bananas, and raisins
additional: The competition center is the Athletics House (race bibs and late registration). Start groups: 10:00 AM Marathon; 10:30 AM Half marathon (estimated time under 1:45); 10:45 AM Half marathon (estimated time over 1:45). Water stations are located at approximately 4.2 km, 8.4 km, 12.6 km, and 16.8 km and offer water, sports drinks, Coca-Cola, bananas, and raisins. After finishing, all participants receive drinks, a banana, coffee/tea, and a sandwich. There is an option to have personal fluids/energy transported to the water stations. The last registration day is race day, October 10, 2026, at 09:00 unless the race is full; entries can be transferred or sold via MittLopp until October 7, 2026, for a fee of 100 SEK. Distance changes can be made until October 7, 2026, or on race day up to one hour before start (additional fee may apply). The minimum age for participation is 17 years during the year. Distances: marathon and half marathon. In 2025, over 500 starters (514 participants, 354 finishers) according to the results page. The race is held in October. The start and finish for the Diabetes Wellness Gothenburg Marathon 2025 was at Slottsskogsvallen.

name: Ultunamilen
description: The Ultuna Mile is a recreational race in Uppsala offering distances of 5 km and 10 km. According to the results list published for the race on October 10, 2026, the categories for men in the mentioned distances are visible. The race appears to be organized by Upsala Idrottsförening, with registration managed via SportAdmin. The date for the mentioned edition is October 10, 2026, and results are published in connection with the event.
course_highlights: Distances of 5 km and 10 km
Results published (men's categories) according to EasyRecord
Organized by Upsala Idrottsförening in Uppsala, registration via SportAdmin
additional: The results page shows October 10, 2026, as the date and the distances of 5 km and 10 km. Note that external pages (such as Stockholm-updates) require login for full information.

name: Umemaran
description: Umemaran is a traditional marathon and half marathon race organized by Jalles TC Umeå in collaboration with IFK Umeå, starting and finishing at Tegs Centralskola. The marathon course (42 km) largely follows the Ume River via Ön and features a partly new, faster route; the course has been measured by SFIF's official course measurer, and each kilometer is marked. There are hydration stations with Umara sports drink and water approximately every four kilometers, chip timing, and shower facilities at the start area. Medals are awarded at the finish for both 42 km and 21 km, and the 42 km race is held simultaneously with the Northern Norrland Championships for seniors and veterans.
course_highlights: The course largely follows the Ume River via Ön on both sides
Partly new, faster route; course measured by SFIF official measurer
Each kilometer is marked; hydration stations with Umara sports drink/water approximately every 4 km
additional: Timing is done with a chip (chip must be returned at the finish); bibs and chips are to be collected at Tegs Centralskola no later than 45 minutes before the start. Late registration can be done at the start area via Swish or cash. Showers are available in the Jubileumshallen (basement level) for men and women. Award ceremony: 21 km immediately after the finish; 42 km around 16:20 in the Aula. The registration fee includes a participant medal, Umara energy bar, coffee, and a sandwich; Team Sportia Ersboda raffles a bicycle among finishers of the 42 km who are present at the award ceremony. Starting times (according to the 2025 invitation): 42 km at 11:00; 21 km at 11:30. Fees: Half marathon 300 SEK (late registration 400 SEK); Full marathon 500 SEK (late registration 600 SEK). Hydration every four kilometers, changing rooms, and showers in the Jubileumshallen. Registration via raceid.com; chip timing and medals included; after the race, coffee and a sandwich as well as raffles.

name: Bohusläns Bästa
location: Havstenssund, Tanum Municipality, Västra Götaland County, Sweden
description: Bohusläns Bästa is a coastal trail run of 22 km from Havstenssund to TanumStrand. The race is the final in Outnorth Trailtour and is expected to gather the Swedish trail running elite for decisive confrontations. The course profile is hilly and features cliffs, winding trails, and expansive sea views along Bohuslän's characteristic coastal landscape. The organizer also recommends accommodation and a banquet at TanumStrand to complete the weekend.
course_highlights: 22 km trail run along the coast from Havstenssund to TanumStrand
Cliffs, piers, and coastal views with the scent of seaweed
Winding trails through fishing villages and varied terrain (mountains, forest, sea)
additional: Final in Outnorth Trailtour; part of Trails of SWE c/o Dacia; recommended accommodation and banquet at TanumStrand Spa & Resort; newsletter offers from partners (including 20% discount on Asics trail shoes via Outnorth). Start in Havstenssund, bus to the start from TanumStrand; orange course markings; some sections narrow/tricky and water conditions at high tide; metal studded shoes not allowed; gear drop-off costs 30 SEK; name change for a fee of 200 SEK; dogs not allowed; toilets and showers/changing facilities at TanumStrand Spa & Resort.

name: Tjurruset
description: Welcome to Tjurruset in Norra Djurgården – a fun and challenging cross-country race where the fighting spirit often matters more than a perfect running stride. The course offers forest trails, muddy passages, wet sections, and technical elements; choose between 5 or 10 km as an adult. For children, there is Kalvruset (approximately 3 km) and Lilla Kalvruset (approximately 700 m). The event is organized by Marathongruppen together with local athletics clubs and is open to both beginners and experienced participants.
course_highlights: The course in Norra Djurgården with forest trails, muddy passages, and wet sections
Choice between 5 km and 10 km for adults; Kalvruset approximately 3 km and Lilla Kalvruset approximately 700 m for children
Technical terrain with steep hills where shoes with good grip are recommended
additional: Practical information: warm showers in tents are available a few minutes walk from the finish line, as well as simple rinsing facilities immediately after finishing. There are clothing disposal stations for items that may not be taken home. Kalvruset has a medical first aid team on site, and all children receive a medal with the year. The organizer is Marathongruppen in collaboration with Hässelby SK and Spårvägens FK; profits go back to sports. Group registration for companies; company tents and gathering areas; profits go back to sports.

name: Running Lights Alingsås 2026
distance_verbose: 10 km, 5 km, 5 km, 1.7 km, 0.6 km, 0.3 km
description: Running Lights is an evening race held during the Lights in Alingsås festival, offering a magical, illuminated city environment. The event features distances for all ages - from Maxi-Knatte and youth races to 5 km, 10 km, and a relay 3×1660 m. The start and finish are located at the top of Stora torget (Kungsgatan), and the courses run through beautifully lit environments in central Alingsås. Running Lights is family-friendly and is part of the West Swedish Running Cup.
course_highlights: Courses through illuminated city environments during Lights in Alingsås
Start and finish at the top of Stora torget (Kungsgatan)
Distances: Maxi-Knatte 300 m, Energiloppet 600 m, Youth Race 1660 m, Relay 3×1660 m, 5 km (1 lap), 10 km (2 laps)
additional: Start times: Maxi-Knatte 16:00, Energiloppet 16:30, Youth Race 16:45, Relay 17:05, 5 km 18:00, 10 km 19:00. Start & finish at Stora torget (Kungsgatan). 5 km is one lap; 10 km is two laps. The races are part of the West Swedish Running Cup. Registration and race packet pickup October 9-10; Running fair free entry; After Run starts at 19:00 with discount code 'runninglights' for 15% off.

name: Hässelbyloppet / Lilla Hässelbyloppet
description: Welcome to Hässelbyloppet on Sunday, October 11, 2026 - a fast and well-organized 10 km race through Hässelby, Grimsta, Råcksta, and Vällingby in northwest Stockholm. The course is flat, precisely measured to 10,000 meters, and sanctioned by the Swedish Athletics Association. On the same day, the Little Hässelbyloppet for children and youth is also held. All information about the course, start, registration, and practical details for runners can be found on the website.
course_highlights: Flat and fast 10 km course through Hässelby, Grimsta, Råcksta, and Vällingby
Asphalt for most of the course; start on grass and finish on all-weather track
Two water stations along the course
additional: Race center is Hässelby Idrottsplats (Loviselundsvägen 100), the start takes place on a field 400 meters from the sports ground, and Hässelby Gård station is less than a kilometer away. The minimum age for the main race is 14 years (born in 2012 or earlier); children aged 5-13 can participate in Little Hässelbyloppet. The maximum allowed time is 2 hours. The course has been measured by an approved course measurer and sanctioned by the Swedish Athletics Association; the event is broadcast live as part of the adidas Adizero Running Tour, and pacers are available (approximately 37:30 - 60 minutes). Live streaming of the event is offered according to information from the organizer.

name: Night Trail Run (Sollentuna) — Hundtrail / 5 km & 10 km
description: Night Trail Run is a nighttime trail race focused on the experience and the magic of darkness. Dog trail is a special class where you can share the evening with your dog on 5 km or 10 km, and the courses are designed for a memorable evening in the forest. The event emphasizes safety in the dark - the courses are reflective marked and headlamps are mandatory. All proceeds go to youth sports in Attunda Orienteering Club.
course_highlights: Reflective marked courses
Free start time 18:00 - 19:30 (10 km until 19:00)
Two distances for dog handlers: 5 km and 10 km
additional: Free start time between 18:00 - 19:30 (10 km can start until 19:00). The courses are reflectively marked and headlamps are mandatory. The event is for runners who want to run together with their dog (5 and 10 km). Free start time between 18:00 - 19:30 (10 km until 19:00); courses with reflectors; headlamp required.

name: Hellasloppet
description: Hellasloppet is a family-friendly running event at Hellasgården in Nacka that invites runners of all ages and levels. The races go through the Hellas area past lakes and over hills on lovely running trails and roads, offering short courses for children as well as longer options for recreational runners. For the youngest participants, there is a relatively flat course, and the event is arranged as a pleasant day with music, refreshments, and award ceremonies. It is emphasized as a local and friendly family race with plenty of parking and cycling options.
course_highlights: The course runs through the Hellas area past lakes and over hills
Beautiful running trails and sections on roads - mixed terrain
Three-stage format: 400 m (MICA race), 1,400 m, and 5 km
additional: Location: Hellasgården, Ältavägen 101, Nacka; bus from Slussen is indicated as a transportation option. There is ample parking and bicycle parking at the start area. Award ceremonies are held continuously and the catering will be open. The MICA race (400 m) is part of Hellasloppet. Distances include 400 m, 1,400 m, 5 km, and 7.5 km, as well as a 1.5 km walking loop. Bus from Slussen to Hellasgården; plenty of parking around the start area and space to park bikes at the start; catering opens.

name: Växjö Marathon
description: Welcome to the 32nd edition of Växjö Marathon, presented by VLK. The race runs eight laps around Växjösjön on what the organizers call "Sweden's fastest course." The course is very flat (elevation change approx. 3 m) and mostly paved with about 300 meters of fine gravel; each lap is measured in August 2024. There is also a relay race and a children's race, and the course is marked with lead cyclists and flag marshals.
course_highlights: Eight laps around Växjösjön
Very flat course, elevation change approx. 3 m
Mostly asphalt with ~300 m fine gravel; marked with lead cyclists and flag marshals
additional: The course is not closed, which means runners share the paths with pedestrians and cyclists; motor traffic occurs at three points along the course. Each lap is measured (August 2024). There is an option to participate in a relay as a team, and the event also includes a children's race for 2026. The relay consists of four runners each running two laps; the course is open to pedestrians and cyclists and shares space with them as well as motor traffic at three locations.

name: Åhus TrailRun
location: Strandridaregården, Friseboda, Kristianstad Municipality, Skåne County, Sweden
description: Åhus TrailRun is a trail race in the coastal forests and along the sea south of Åhus in Skåne, organized by Pan-Kristianstad. The event offers distances of 17 km, 11 km, 6 km, and 2.5 km, as well as a children's race of about 350 meters with a medal and no timing. The courses are gently hilly and consist of a mix of trails, sand dunes, terrain, and beach running along the coast - participants are guaranteed a running experience beyond the ordinary. The race suits both competitive runners and recreational athletes and also features team competitions and a maximum of 1000 participants.
course_highlights: Gently hilly terrain with a mix of trails, sand dunes, challenging hills, and beach running along the sea
17 km: approximately 60% trail, 25% terrain, 15% beach - elevation gain approx. 310 meters
Arena at Strandridaregården, only about 100 meters from the sea
additional: Participant limit: max 1000 participants. Start times: 12:30 for 2.5 km and 6 km; 12:40 for 11 km and 17 km; children's race individually from 13:00 to 15:00. Bib distribution from 10:45 (pick up no later than one hour before your start). Cut-off time: the finish line closes 2 hours and 50 minutes after the 17 km start (at 15:30) - the last 6 km lap must be started no later than 60 minutes before the finish line closes. Arena: Strandridaregården in Friseboda; parking is limited and only allowed according to officials' instructions (carpooling tips via the race's Facebook group). Valuables storage available for a fee (20 SEK, cash or Swish). Children's race with medal and free registration; online registration closes the Wednesday before the race; late registration can be done at the start/finish area; bib must be collected by 10:45; parking is limited near the arena; water stations at all stations; electronic timing and live online results.

name: Uppsala Marathon (inkl. DM i marathon)
price_range: Maraton: 825 kr; Halvmaraton: 625 kr; Stafett (4 deltagare): 1800 kr
description: Uppsala Marathon is an urban and nature marathon that runs through historic Uppsala with start and finish at Uppsala Castle. The race combines city pulse in central Uppsala with scenic views along Ekoln, Fyrisån, and the mounds in Gamla Uppsala. The event offers a marathon, half marathon, and relay for four-person teams, and also serves as the district championship (DM) in marathon. The race is spectator-friendly and targets both competitive runners and recreational runners.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Uppsala Castle; passes Carolina Rediviva and central shopping streets
The route goes along the shores of Ekoln and Fyrisån and out to the mounds in Gamla Uppsala
Flat, fast single-loop course consisting of half asphalt and half hard-packed gravel
additional: Start and finish at Uppsala Castle. The start area opens at 07:00; bib number pickup from October 1 to 16 at Löplabbet (Dragarbrunns Torg 4 - 6) and on race day October 17 from 07:30 (lasts 45 minutes before the start). Registration is accepted via RaceID and Epassi can be used as payment. Maximum participants: Marathon 1500, Half Marathon 2500, Marathon relay 150 teams. Anyone registering by September 15, 2026, will have their name on the bib. Age limit 17 years for marathon/half marathon (born 2009 or earlier). Award ceremony at the finish area at 13:00. Food and non-alcoholic drinks are available at the finish area; relay teams receive a finisher’s shirt and medal. Recommended to use public transport or bike (bus stops Slottsbacken or Blåsenhus, buses 2 and 7); parking is available within walking distance. DM medals in Marathon and Half Marathon; medal ceremony the Tuesday after the race; age limit 17 years for marathon/half marathon; Epassi payment, transfer via RaceID, start times, transportation and parking, baggage drop, changing/shower, insurance, and prizes; registration opens until October 12, 2026, with the possibility of closing earlier if maximum capacity is reached.

name: Jönköping 10K/5K
description: Jönköping 10K/5K is a pleasant race in central Jönköping suitable for both elite runners and enthusiastic amateurs. The races, starting at Lillsjöplan, take place on a completely flat and measured course, making it ideal for personal bests and seedings. Both 5 km (1 lap) and 10 km (2 laps) options are offered, and the organizers emphasize a good atmosphere with pacemakers for 40, 45, and 50 minutes on the 10K. Group registration offers a 10% discount when three runners sign up together, and there are options for group registration for larger parties.
course_highlights: Completely flat course in central Jönköping, starting at Lillsjöplan
5 km = 1 lap, 10 km = 2 laps
The course is measured by the Swedish Athletics Federation and seedings are based on it
additional: Start at Lillsjöplan. 5K run in one lap, 10K in two laps. Pacemakers with flags for 40, 45, and 50 minutes on the 10K. Register up to 5 runners at the same time via the regular registration; for more runners, group registration is available. Group registration (three people) offers a 10% discount and the chance to win prizes. No start certificates are sent out. The course and profile are presented on the map/course profile page. Date and start time: October 17, 2026, start at 11:00 at Lillsjöplan; 5K in one lap, 10K in two laps; refreshment stations with UMARA sports drinks and water; baggage drop-off at start/finish; proximity to parking garages; start list and pacer information; limited baggage drop-off and on-site start certificate pickup.

name: XC-race Linköping

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Anmälan kostar 250 kr fram till och med den 11:e oktober.

description: XC Race is an annual cross-country race in Linköping organized by Linköpings OK. The race offers a marked 5 km trail through varied terrain - from paths to marshes - and is suitable for both recreational runners and competitive categories. There are classes for Men 10 km, Women 10 km, and Recreation 5 km, with the 10 km races running two laps. The start and finish are located at Vidingsjö Sports Center, and the organizer welcomes everyone.
course_highlights: Varied terrain: from paths to marshes
5 km marked trail - the 10 km classes run two laps
Start and finish at Vidingsjö Sports Center; muddy and challenging terrain
additional: Number bibs are collected on race day from 10:00 at the venue and must be visibly worn on the chest for correct timing. Changing facilities are available at LOK-gården; parking is available at both Vidingsjö Sports Center and LOK-gården. Registration via a link with card payment is open until race day; late registration and payment on site are available via Swish. Venue at Vidingsjö Sports Center. Changing in LOK-gården. Parking at Vidingsjö Sports Center and LOK-gården. Number bibs are collected on race day from 10:00. Start and finish at the arena. Race starts at 11:00. Distances: 5 km (marked) and 10 km (two laps).

name: Night Trail Run 30 km
description: Night Trail Run in October offers evening trail runs focusing on the experience of how light and darkness meet. You can choose 5 km, 10 km, or 30 km with start and finish at Väsby gård in Sollentuna. For the 30 km, you navigate with a downloadable GPS route and map, and the race has energy stations along the way. Welcome to register - all proceeds go to youth sports in Attunda Orienteering Club.
course_highlights: Night trail run in the glow of headlamps with course marked with reflectors
30 km run with GPS route and map, featuring two energy stations
The final part of the 30 km follows the same reflector-marked course as the 5/10 km
additional: For 5 km and 10 km, there is free start time within specified windows (18:00 - 19:30 for 5 km; 18:00 - 19:00 for 10 km). For the 30 km, you receive a GPS route and map in advance, the race has two energy stations and a maximum time of 4 hours 30 minutes; the last part follows the reflector course. Start and finish are at Väsby gård in Sollentuna, the organizer requests participants to finish by 20:30, and registration is open until one hour before each start. The 30 km starts at 16:00 on October 17, 2026. For 5 km, free start is between 18:00 - 19:30, and for 10 km between 18:00 - 19:00; the course follows the reflector course to the finish.

name: Stockholms Brantaste
description: Stockholms Brantaste is an intense uphill race in Hammarbybacken scheduled for October 17, 2026. The race is just over 3 - 3.5 km long with steep inclines and over 200 meters of elevation gain, suitable for both experienced runners and beginners looking to challenge themselves. The finish line is at the top of the hill with a beautiful view of the city. The children's races Brantaste Mini and Brantaste Minsta are also offered, but registration for these may be closed at certain times.
course_highlights: Approximately 3 - 3.5 km with over 200 meters of elevation
Up and down the steep slopes of Hammarbyhöjden; finish at the top with a view of the city
Intensive uphill focus (finish line services, water stations along the course)
additional: Start bibs are sent via email (usually about 2 weeks before the race or sooner if registering late). Number bib distribution takes place at the event area Hammarby Fabriksväg (details in the information text) and opens from 09:30 according to participant information. The bib contains a chip and should be worn unfolded at 45 - 90°; attach with safety pins (bring about 4) and write name/phone number and medical info on the back. The race includes timing, a medal, and water stations; in the children's races, water is available at the finish and medals are awarded. Registration for Brantaste Mini and Brantaste Minsta may be closed at certain times. Free uphill training sessions in Hammarbybacken are available before the race day.

name: Rönninge Backyard Run 2026
location: Rönninge, Salem Municipality, Stockholm County, Sweden

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Anmälan sker på plats och kostar 50 kr.

description: Rönninge Backyard Run is a lap race in Toredal where each lap is 6.706 meters, and the format is built around hourly starts: the first lap starts at 09:00, followed by a new start every full hour up to a total of 12 laps. Participants must complete a lap in under one hour to start the next; the one who completes the most laps (and is fastest on the last lap) wins in the women's and men's categories. The race suits both competitive runners and those who want to challenge their endurance on a technical but easy-to-run trail in the scenic Garnudden. A smaller MiniBackyard is offered for children/beginners with on-site registration and their own start time in the afternoon.
course_highlights: A lap length of 6.706 km with start/finish at Bubblan in Toredal
Surface approximately 80% asphalt and 20% gravel, partly along the promenade around Garnudden
Several longer inclines and a concluding downhill run as well as a flat asphalt stretch towards the finish
additional: Registration for Rönninge Backyard Run opens March 1, 2026. Rönninge 6h (June 6, 2026) starts at 10:00 and runs until 16:00; registration via RaceID (link on the page). MiniBackyard starts at 14:00, registration on site. Registration for the main race is personal and binding; cancellations must be made via info@lopklubb.se no later than October 1 with an administrative fee of 45 SEK. The race features hourly starts: lap 1 at 09:00, lap 2 at 10:00, etc.; the final start at 20:00. Laps are registered with a chip (in the 6-hour race). Coffee and snacks are served at 20:00 after the last lap. The race: 6706 meters per lap; up to 12 laps over twelve hours; first start at 09:00, last start at 20:00; surface approximately 80% asphalt/gravel; women's and men's categories. Mini Backyard is organized by KIF Toredal with a fee of 50 SEK on site.

name: Täby Halvmarathon
description: Täby Half Marathon is an easy-to-run and fast half marathon in a scenic environment with start and finish at Näsby Castle. The course offers coastal views along Värtan’s shoreline, a scenic loop around Rönningesjön, and a finish back at the sea with a view towards Bogesundslandet. The race is measured and organized by Täby IS Athletics, and suits runners who want to end the season on a fast and beautiful course. In previous years, the race has been very popular with limited spots, so the organizer encourages early registration.
course_highlights: First approximately 5 km along Värtan’s shoreline with sea views
Scenic loop around Rönningesjön passing Ängsholmsbadet and Skavlötens outdoor recreation area
Approximately 125 meters of elevation; about 2/3 asphalt and 1/3 gravel
additional: Start and finish at Näsby Castle. Little Täby Marathon for children aged 5 - 11 years (1.2 km) with start times at 10:00 (born 2017 - 2020) and 10:15 (born 2014 - 2016). Sports drinks from partner Umara are served at water stations. The maximum time for the half marathon is 2 hours and 45 minutes. Bib number distribution: Stadium in Täby Centrum from Wednesday before the race and pickup at the start area from 09:00 to 10:45 on race day. The course has approximately 125 meters of elevation and consists of about 2/3 asphalt and 1/3 gravel; water stations along the course with Umara; previous capacity approximately 1500 participants.

name: Täljemilen
description: Enhörna IF presents Täljemilen - perhaps the fastest controlled measured 10K run this autumn at Geneta Sports Field in Södertälje. The course runs entirely on bicycle and pedestrian paths and is fully asphalted, making the race very fast and suitable for those aiming for a personal best. Water stations are available at 5 km and at the finish line. Instead of medals, the organizer donates a sum to the Children's Cancer Foundation for each registered runner; prizes are awarded to the top 3 in both women's and men's categories, and there will also be a raffle of approximately 20 prizes.
course_highlights: Controlled measured course (approved by a course measurer from the Swedish Athletics Federation)
100% asphalt on bicycle and pedestrian paths - very fast course
Water station at 5 km and at the finish line
additional: Changing rooms are available on site but the organizer recommends that participants come dressed. Late registration on the day of the race is possible if the race is not fully booked. The organizer forgoes medals and instead donates an amount to the Children's Cancer Foundation per registered runner. Prizes are awarded to the top 3 in both women's and men's categories, and approximately 20 prizes will be raffled among all participants. Names and images from the race day may be published on the club's website and social media. Contact information: Henrik Kvarnlöt 073-0400790 and Peter Ness 070-3791299. Last registration date is October 15; late registration on site if spots are available; water at 5 km and at the finish; no medal will be awarded this year; approximately 20 prizes will be raffled among all participants; contact details are provided in the event page text.

name: Skövdeloppet
description: Skövdeloppet makes a comeback in 2026 with a new, city-centered course that mainly follows foot and cycle paths through several of Skövde's residential areas. The race day is October 18, and the runs are intended as easy routes in an urban environment suitable for both recreational runners and competitive athletes. There are three distances offered (21.1 km, 10 km, and 5 km) with a common start and finish at Lillegårdens Fritidsområde.
course_highlights: New route mostly following foot and cycle paths through residential areas
Passes Södra Ryd's church ruin, Vadsboleden, Aspö, Havstena, and Billingen/Dälderna
Start and finish at the small parking lot by the tennis hall at Lillegårdens Fritidsområde
additional: All distances start and finish at Lillegårdens Fritidsområde (small parking lot by the tennis hall). The secretariat can accept late registrations subject to availability until 30 minutes before the start; registrations can be accepted from 08:30 on race day. Parking is available at Billingehov's large parking lot. Valuables can be handed in at the bib number distribution and retrieved upon showing the bib. Terrain: urban course on foot and cycle paths. Start/finish at Lillegårdens Fritidsområde. Distances of 21.1 km, 10 km, and 5 km. Parking at Billingehov's large parking lot. GPX files are available. Information about the courses may change.

name: Yxbacken Extreme Challenge by E2C
location: Yxbackens slalombacke, Norrköpings kommun, Östergötland, Sweden
description: Yxbacken Extreme Challenge by E2C is a hill race held in Norrköping's own ski slope. The race is described as challenging - in 2024, five tough laps were completed in the hill - and it caters both to competitive runners and families through a separate children's race. E2C is the title partner, and the event combines competition, children's activities, and subsequent prize and photo ceremonies.
course_highlights: Run in Norrköping's ski slope (Yxbacken)
Consisted of five challenging laps in 2024
Children's race "Lilla Yxbackenloppet" introduced in 2024
additional: The 2024 race was held on October 19, and E2C was the title partner for the fourth year. The 2024 children's race had approximately 50 participating children who received medals at the finish line; the winners received wreaths at the award ceremony. Photographer Magnus Media took pictures published on the race's Facebook page. About 300 participants in the first edition; in 2023, the event was photographed by Magnus Andersson (Magnusmedia.nu); the children's race Lilla Yxbackenloppet by E2C was added in 2024.

name: Yddingeloppet
description: Yddingeloppet is one of Skåne's largest cross-country races, organized by Heleneholms IF in the autumnal Bokskogen in Torup. The race starts from Torups Friluftsgård and traditionally takes place on the last Sunday in October (2026-10-25). The course consists of forest terrain and welcomes both competitive runners and recreational participants who want to experience the autumn nature. All practical information and the invitation are available on the race's information pages.
course_highlights: Forest terrain in Bokskogen (Torup)
Start/finish at Torups Friluftsgård
Autumn landscape and trails - traditionally the last Sunday in October
additional: Registration is done via AnmälMigNu (see registration page). The invitation, classes, registration fees, course description, PM, start list, and practical information are available in the left tabs on the race page. Contact for the race: tavling@heleneholmsif.se. Heleneholms IF's office: kansli@heleneholmsif.se, phone 040-19 42 20. Cross-country race in Bokskogen, Torup; two course lengths (12 km and 6 km); start/finish at Torups Friluftsgård; bankarta available; registration via AnmälMigNu; contact tavling@heleneholmsif.se.

name: Kilterrängen
description: Do you prefer trail running over asphalt? Whether you're a curious beginner, a happy recreational runner, or an elite athlete, Kilterrängen is for you. In an autumnal Kil, the 16 km or 6 km trail race is held, featuring some tough final kilometers filled with hills, including the notorious slalom hill.
course_highlights: 16 km and 6 km trail races with a common final section
Technical trail running (Öhmansmilen) with the highest point of the course after ~6 km
Last 2 km on a fast illuminated track with a concluding slalom hill
additional: Arena: Frykstastugan near Frykstahöjden; parking at Frykstastugan. The course is permanently marked with red-white markings, signs, and kilometer markers; follow the instructions of the course marshals at crossings. The first 2 km are easy to run downhill, then technical trail (Öhmansmilen); after ~10 km, the course again features easy running sections and sandy parts. The 6 km course consists of the first kilometer plus the last ~5 km of the 16 km course. Please note that it is winter on race day; trail shoes are recommended. Registration is done via the form under 'anmälan' and is valid only after payment; late registration is possible on race day. The terrain is often wet and soft; trail shoes are recommended. Timing is with Emit chip. All runners receive a medal. After the finish, there will be soup, homemade bread, as well as showers and a sauna in Frykstastugan; bibs can be collected at the secretariat from 9:30 to 10:30. Registration is via the form on the info page, and payment is mentioned in the registration instructions.

images.alt_text: Deltagare i terrängloppet Kilterrängen löper längs en sjö under hösten.
Löpare i terränglopp med sjö och höstlöv i bakgrunden.

name: Sjögarpslunken 2026
description: Sjögarpslunken is a recurring running event that will celebrate its 50th anniversary in 2026 and is scheduled for Sunday, October 25, 2026. The event page indicates that the race has offered several distances (according to previous registration forms: 2.5 km, 5 km, 7.5 km, and 14 km) and that the organizer publishes invitations, race rules, start lists, maps, and results on the website. The website describes the course's beautiful scenery and a challenging 14 km profile. More information and details about the course and profile are available via links on the event page.
course_highlights: Beautiful course layout (linked on the event page)
Challenging 14 km course profile
Multiple distances - 2.5 km, 5 km, 7.5 km, and 14 km (according to previous registration forms)
additional: The race celebrates its 50th anniversary in 2026. The website contains links to maps and course profiles as well as previous years' race rules, invitations, start lists, and preliminary results. Previous registration forms (2020) showed options for distance and preferred race day (October 23, 24, or 25). Content includes invitation, race rules, start lists, course map, results, and course profile; 14 km course. The race is traditionally held during the last weekend of October and will celebrate its 50th anniversary in 2026.

name: Kullamannen by UTMB
description: Set along the rocky shores of Sweden's Kullaberg, Kullamannen by UTMB® offers trail courses that range from a fast 20 km to a challenging 100-mile test of endurance. Runners traverse rocky headlands, beech and pine forests, and coastal paths with dramatic ocean views, making it an adventure-focused event for trail runners of varying ambitions. The event weekend combines technical coastal terrain, well-supported aid stations and organised race services to welcome both international and local participants.
course_highlights: Rocky coastal trails and cliffs along Kullaberg with ocean views
Runs through beechwood and pine forest singletrack and compact dirt trails
North Shore 20K features narrow beachside paths and a night start (headlamp required)
additional: Minimum ages: North Shore open to runners born 2010 or before. Registration sales windows: UTMB Index holders 18 - 20 Nov 2025 (exclusive), open to all from 20 Nov 2025 until 10 Oct 2026 or until sold out. Registration includes race bib, access to aid stations, baggage transport depending on distance, medical assistance and after-race services. Transfer to a shorter distance allowed until 3 weeks before the event (deadline: 2026-10-10). Bib distribution and expo in Båstad on the event weekend. Races range from 22 km to 100 miles; start in Höganäs, via Mölle and Kullaberg, finish in Båstad; November weather can be tough; DNF rate 40-60% for 100-milers; Running Stone lottery and direct qualification to UTMB World Series finals.

name: Halloweenloppet
description: Trail run in darkness.
course_highlights: Halloween course: 5 km and 10 km (women/men)
Girls/boys: 2.5 km
Mini scare: children/minicourse
additional: Distance options according to the course layout: women/men 10 km/5 km (Halloween course), girls/boys 2.5 km, and Mini scare for the youngest. Organizer: Falkenbergs OK (contact address on the page: Christer Nelsén, Thomas Thorilds väg 6, 31140 Falkenberg). There is a separate page with registered participants for 2025 ("Registered 2025"). Distance distribution: 2.5 km (youth), mini scare for children, 5 km and 10 km; night race in darkness; part of Tour de Falkenberg.

images.alt_text: Belysta skyltar 5 km och 10 km vid mörkt terränglopp.
Deltagare springer på en stig i mörker med pannlampor på Halloweenloppet.
Deltagare med pannlampor springer en mörk skogsstig under Halloweenloppet.

name: Finalloppet Göteborg

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Parvelbanan, ca 250 m, anmälan endast på plats tävlingsdagen. 40 kr

description: Finalloppet is West Sweden's largest trail race, organized by Göteborgs Skidklubb since 1968 and held at Skatås Motionscentrum in Gothenburg. The event offers several distances (19 km, 10 km, 5.3 km, 2.3 km, 1.9 km, as well as the Paraloppet and Parvelbanan) for both competitive and recreational runners. The courses alternate between technical trail sections and wider forest roads, marked with clear arrows and kilometer markers. The organizer gathers finish and service areas at the competition site at Skatås and offers water stations, medical services, and post-race patrols on all courses.
course_highlights: 19 km features an advanced trail section of approximately 2,500 meters
10 km includes a more than 500-meter-long trail section that is often wet, muddy, and stony
The courses are marked with orange arrows and colored kilometer markers; the lead groups are guided by cyclists
additional: Registration is handled via RaceID (payment by card, Swish, Google Pay, or Mobile BankID). Multiple persons can be registered at the same time and gift cards can be purchased via RaceID. The organizer offers the optional Startklar insurance, which refunds the registration fee in case of illness, injury, or pregnancy. The arena is located at Skatås Motionscentrum with finish and service tents, medical tents at the finish, and medical personnel at certain water stations (Ugglemossen and Svarttjärn). Post-race patrols start after the last start for each course and are responsible for runners remaining on the course. Donate 50 SEK to the Jontefonden when registering; a GPX file is available for download for the 19 km course.

name: Höstmilen
description: The Autumn Mile is a cross-country race in the Kolmård Forest outside Åby, north of Norrköping, taking place on November 1, 2026. The course runs on trails between Sörsjön and Lillsjön and offers scenic and challenging terrain for both competitors and recreational runners. The organizer is OK Kolmården, and there are three main course options: the classic 10.6 km, Höstfemman 5.2 km, as well as courses for children and youth.
course_highlights: Cross-country race on trails between Sörsjön and Lillsjön
Höstmilen 10.6 km (Sörsjön → Lillsjön) and Höstfemman 5.2 km (start/finish at Lillsjön)
Running in the scenic and hilly terrain of Kolmård Forest
additional: Registration closes on October 29 at 23:00 online; thereafter, registration is possible on October 31 from 11:00 to 14:00 at XXL and at the start location on November 1. For the classic Höstmilen, a bus departs from Jurslaskolan to Sörsjön. A race information packet with practical details will be published approximately one week before the race. The competition classes have only two prize categories (Men and Women) for the adult races. A complete list of registered participants is published on the 'Registered' page. The distances and race formats are 10.6 km, 5.2 km, and children’s races (1.4 or 2.0 km); team race, corporate race, and school race. The race info and registration can be found at hostmilen.nu.

name: Energiruset
organizer: IF Göta Karlstad och Karlstads Energi
description: The Energiruset is an evening race in Mariebergsskogen organized in collaboration between IF Göta and Karlstads Energi. The race takes place on Thursday, November 5, 2026, and is family-friendly with optional distances of 2 km and 5 km. The 5 km includes a competitive class for those wanting to test their strength; the course is largely in a forest environment and some parts lack lighting. After the finish, the organizers offer all participants sausages with bread.
course_highlights: The course runs in Mariebergsskogen (forest environment)
Parts of the course lack lighting - headlamp recommended
Distances of 2 km and 5 km; 5 km has a competitive class
additional: Date and location: Mariebergsskogen, Thursday, November 5, 2026. There is an option to purchase a headlamp during registration. A pre-race information sheet (including chip distribution and exact start times) is published on the organizer's website, and previous sheets are available as a PDF: https://ifgota.se/files/PM_ER_2025.pdf. After the race, IF Göta and Karlstads Energi will serve sausages with bread; for non-competitive participants, the course is open during the evening and they can start within a specified time window. The distances are 2 km and 5 km; a headlamp is recommended and can be purchased at registration; some parts of the course lack lighting; tentative start times around 18:00; the course is open during the evening with the option to start between two times; after the race, participants are offered sausages with bread.

name: Jämjöhalvan och Jämjöhallenstafetten
price_range: Jämjöhalvan 21,1 km: 300 kr (4/6-2/10) eller 400 kr (3/10-2/11); Jämjöhalvan 10 km: 250 kr (4/6-2/10) eller 350 kr (3/10-2/11); Jämjöhalvan 5 km: 200 kr (4/6-2/10) eller 300 kr (3/10-2/11); Barnlopp 50 kr; Jämjöhallenstafetten: 600 kr per lag (4/6-2/11).
description: Jämjöhalvan is a road race organized by Team Blekinge LF with distances ranging from children's races up to a half marathon, as well as a relay race (Jämjöhallen Relay). The half marathon and other races take place on a flat, spectator-friendly loop course around Jämjö and also serve as a qualifying race for events such as Göteborgsvarvet. The competition center and finish line are located at Jämjö Knowledge Center, and in 2026, the Veteran-SM in half marathon will be held in connection with the race. Welcome regardless of level - the race emphasizes running community and clear laps.
course_highlights: Loop course: 4 laps for the half marathon, 2 laps for 10 km, 1 lap for 5 km
Flat and spectator-friendly course around Jämjö
Distances are measured (measured September 25, 2021) and officials are present along the course
additional: Start/finish and competition center are at Jämjö Knowledge Center. Starts occur at different locations depending on the distance; half marathon and Jämjöhallen Relay start at 10:30, 10 km at 10:40, 5 km at 10:45, and children's race (500 m) at 12:45. The course traffic rule is right-hand traffic and overtaking occurs on the left side - runners not maintaining high speed are encouraged to stay to the right. In the relay race, the baton is exchanged at the relay exchange area near the lap turn; there is no registration on-site for the Jämjöhallen Relay. Late registration (for other distances) is open on race day from 08:00 to 10:00 at Jämjö Knowledge Center. Payment can be made in cash or via Swish. Start times: 21.1 km and Jämjöhallen Relay at 10:30, 10 km at 10:40, 5 km at 10:45, youth class 12-16 years at 10:45, children's race (12:45). Starting locations vary depending on the distance. No late registration for Jämjöhallen Relay. Finish/start is at Jämjö Knowledge Center. The course consists of a loop with water stations every 5 km in collaboration with Umara. Changing and shower facilities are available at Jämjö Knowledge Center from approximately 09:00. Open training sessions (free) are held on September 17 and October 15 before race day.

name: Skanneloppet
price_range: Fram till 7 oktober: 17,3 km 200 kr; 7,6 km 150 kr; 3,9 km 100 kr. 8 oktober – 24 oktober: 17,3 km 300 kr; 7,6 km 200 kr; 3,9 km 150 kr. 25 oktober – 5 november: 17,3 km 400 kr; 7,6 km 300 kr; 3,9 km 250 kr.
description: Skanneloppet is organized by IS Skanne and takes place on Saturday, November 7, 2026, with start and finish at Tingvalla Nöjespalats in Åstorp. The race is individual with approximately ten starters per minute and offers three courses for both elite and recreational runners. The courses are hilly and mostly run on gravel roads with sections of asphalt and trail paths, suitable for both young and old. Information about registration and start lists will be published on the organizer's website.
course_highlights: Three distances: Red 17.3 km, Blue 7.6 km, and Green 3.9 km
Hilly terrain - mostly gravel roads with sections of asphalt and trail paths, especially steep at the beginning
Water stations marked on the map (yellow circles)
additional: Number bibs will be distributed from 08:00 on race day; check your start number in the start list inside Tingvalla and pick it up yourself. No late registration on site. There are no showers or changing rooms on site (toilets available). Medical services are available at the finish line and a defibrillator is accessible. Maximum running time until approximately 12:30. Those who register before October 24 will have their name printed on the bib. A commemorative plaque will be awarded to all finishers; medals are distributed after completing 5, 10, 20, 30, and 40 races. Start times are between 10:00 and 11:05 with about 10 starters per minute. Start and finish location: Tingvalla Vramsvägen 9, Åstorp. No late registration on site. No showers or changing rooms; toilets available. Start lists and results will be published on the IS Skanne website. Bib numbers can be collected on site from 08:00 on race day for the 17.3 km race.

name: Höstrusket
description: The Autumn Run is a trail and road race in Northern Djurgården, Stockholm, taking place on November 7, 2026. Choose between 10 km, half marathon (21.1 km), or marathon (42.195 km) with start and finish at Fisksjöängsvägen. The race is suitable for both beginners and experienced runners and offers motivating pacers, well-stocked water stations, and a festive conclusion to the running season in the Royal National City Park. The event is organized by Marathongruppen in collaboration with local athletics clubs, and the proceeds go back to sports.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Fisksjöängsvägen in Northern Djurgården (about 800 m from Ropstens T‑station)
Measured courses mostly on asphalt with some gravel; 10 km: +103.9 m, marathon: total +439 m
Rich water stations and lap services as well as clear kilometer signs
additional: Start/finish at Fisksjöäng (about 800 m from Ropstens T‑station). Bib number distribution, pacer tents, food/coffee sales, drop-off of outerwear and toilets at the event area. Opportunity to change clothes and shower in a facility a few hundred meters away for a fee. Chip timing by RaceTimer; pacers offered for several finish times (list per distance). Max and cut-off times: 10 km 2:00, half marathon 2:30, marathon 5:30 (repetition at the last lap at 13:40). Age limits: 15 years for 10 km (13 years with guardian), 17 years for half marathon and marathon. Certain aids and vehicles (staves, inline skates, strollers, bicycles, handcycles, racing wheelchair) are not allowed; special conditions apply for escorts/wheelchairs. Proceeds go back to sports. Registration is open.

name: Kroppefjäll Trailrun

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 900 meter: 0 kr för de allra minsta

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 10,5 km: 350 kr för ungdom under 18 år

tiers.label: tier_3
tiers.description: 10,5 km: 550 kr för ungdom under 18 år

description: Kroppefjäll Trailrun is an evening race at Kroppefjäll B&B in Dals Rostock, where runners in two-person teams are offered three main distance options (42 km, 21 km, and 10.5 km) as well as a children's race around the lake. The course is technical terrain with lots of singletrack and natural trail, and the race has a relaxed, adventurous character without official timing. After finishing, participants can enjoy the large sauna and take a refreshing dip in the lake, as well as book accommodation at Kroppefjäll B&B with discounts. The organizer welcomes both experienced trail runners and younger participants (Lilla KTR) in a friendly environment.
course_highlights: Approximately 60% singletrack/untrodden terrain, 35% gravel road/forest road, and 5% oil gravel
Race format: trail running in two-person teams
Lilla KTR: children's race around the lake (about 900 m), with the possibility to run 1 - 3 laps
additional: Bus to start from Kroppefjäll B&B; GPX file for 21 km; bring your own fluids; bib pickup days before the race or the evening prior; accommodation discounts via Trailrun1/Trailrun2; Lilla KTR race held on November 7 at 18:00; last registration date 4/11.

name: Iron Backbone Ultra
description: Iron Backbone Ultra is a trail adventure in Kristinehamn built around the Iron Trail, offering three distances (15 km, 30 km, and 50 km). The race takes place in varied and characterful terrain - deep forests, marshlands, small lakes, pastures, and older trails - where both mental toughness and running joy are tested. The start and finish are at Hultets outdoor recreation area, and the 15 km course partly runs outside the Iron Trail. The organizer Topp & Dröm welcomes both experienced trail runners and those trying trail running for the first time.
course_highlights: The course largely follows the Iron Trail through varied terrain (forests, marshlands, lakes, pastures, and older trails)
Start and finish at Hultets outdoor recreation area, Kristinehamn
The 15 km course partly runs outside the Iron Trail
additional: Three distances are offered: 15 km, 30 km, and 50 km; start and finish at Hultets outdoor recreation area; from October 1st, the number of spots is limited to ensure a specially designed medal for all participants; organizer is Topp & Dröm (contact person Lasse / phone 073-853 75 21) and there are sections for water stations and equipment on the information pages. Start times: 30 km and 50 km at 17:00; 15 km at 17:30. No mug at water stations; bring your own mug. Start and finish at Hultets outdoor recreation area, Kristinehamn. Registration fees are updated over time and from October 1st, the number of spots is limited to secure a specially designed medal for all participants.

name: Gränsö Trailrun
description: Gränsö Trailrun is a running event in the Gränsö nature reserve outside Västervik that offers technical and scenic trails, sea-facing rocky areas, and some of Sweden's finest oak groves around Gränsö Castle. You can choose between 8 km and 15 km on well-marked courses, or let children participate in the Gränsö Kids Trail (up to 12 years old). The race is open for both timed and untimed Fun Run and encourages a wonderful nature experience - feel free to combine it with a spa visit at Gränsö Castle. Welcome to experience Västervik's archipelago at its best.
course_highlights: Sea-facing rocky areas and Skanvik cliffs along the course
Trails through sparse pine forests and valuable oak groves; technically varied sections
15 km has a bonus loop at Ekholmen; 8 km and 15 km courses join at the energy station Kroken
additional: Event center opens at 09:00 at Gränsö Castle. Start times: Gränsö Kids Trail 10:15, 8 km at 11:00, 15 km at 11:15. First finish is expected around 11:35 and the finish line closes at 13:45. The courses are marked with hanging red/white ribbons and signs; parts of the course follow existing hiking trails. Terrain: mostly trail/hiking trail with sections of rocks, terrain, and short road segments. Energy stations: 8 km has one station, 15 km has two. All children receive a medal and energy after finishing. Registration is online and possible until one hour before start. 8 km and 15 km courses; online registration until one hour before start; energy and water stations along the course; timed or untimed Fun Run; start times: 11:00 (8 km) and 11:15 (15 km); first finish around 11:35; finish line closes at 13:45; spa options at Gränsö Castle.

name: Kristianstad Trail
description: Kristianstad Trail is organized by Härlövs IF in the Bockeboda area outside Kristianstad and is promoted as a fall highlight for trail runners. The race is offered in several distances, making it accessible for both experienced trail runners and recreational runners. The website features preliminary competition information and course maps, as well as information about test runs before the event. Organizer pages and registration links are collected on the race's homepage.
course_highlights: Running in Bockebodaskogen - forest terrain near Kristianstad
Multiple distances: approximately 25 km (25 - 26.4 km), 12 km (12 - 12.9 km), and 5 km (5.3 - 5.7 km) depending on measurement method
Course lengths vary depending on different measurement methods
additional: Registration: individual registration and group registration are mentioned on the page. The website mentions insurance and has a link to registration for previous editions (Registration for Kristianstad Trail 2025). Test runs have also taken place before the race, and it has been communicated that late registration has been possible via Racezoo. The race has a long tradition in Kristianstad, and information about this year's edition can be found in news articles and race information on Härlövs IF's page as well as on RaceID.

name: Team Fillinge Ultras Terränglopp
location: Gummiverkstaden, Bankekind, Linköping Municipality, Östergötland, Sweden
description: Team Fillinge Ultras Trail Race is a pleasant, local trail race organized by Team Fillinge Ultra. The race is approximately 10 km long and mainly consists of beautiful gravel roads and nice forest trails just outside Fillinge, south of Bankekind/Linköping. The event is held for the second year and has a relaxed, welcoming character for trail runners who want to enjoy nature. Gathering takes place at Gummiverkstaden (gathering at 10:40) and the start is at 11:00.
course_highlights: Approximately 10 km
Mainly beautiful gravel roads and nice forest trails
Gathering and start at Gummiverkstaden south of Bankekind (near Fillinge/Linköping)
additional: Gathering for information at 10:40 at Gummiverkstaden; start at 11:00. The race is organized by Team Fillinge Ultra (contact: marcuslundin@gmail.com). Website operator/organizer partner: Trailrunning Sweden AB (info@trailrunningsweden.se). New course layout for 2025 and fully booked 100 starting places one week before the race; new walking prize “The Golden Toaster”; logistics information includes bus from Linköping to Åtvidaberg (stopping at Sandtorp) and parking at Gummiverkstaden (limited space, carpooling encouraged).

name: Hammarby Alpin Marathon
location: Vindskyddet i Barnbacken, Hammarbybacken, Stockholm, Sweden
description: Hammarby Alpin Marathon is a unique alpine marathon race in the middle of Stockholm, running up, over, and around Hammarbybacken. The race consists of 22 laps and is slightly longer than a standard marathon - a micro ultra which, according to the organizer, can also be called Sweden's probably slowest marathon. The course is technical and spectator-friendly with lap and finish at the wind shelter in the children's slope. The event is a festive Advent celebration organized by Stockholm Multisport Club.
course_highlights: 22 laps around Hammarbybacken (start/lap/finish at the wind shelter in the children's slope)
Start at the bottom of the slope (to the left of the lift when facing the top) and up over the "Trysil" section at the bridge
Technical sections: down along the machine road, around the chimney, through Indian Park, inside the allotment gardens, and along the bike path
additional: Organizer: Stockholm Multisport Club. Registration takes place at lap and finish (wind shelter in the children's slope). Nearest subway: Hammarbyhöjden. Starting situation: start at the bottom of the slope to the left of the lift. Registration is done via RaceID according to the registration page. Registration and finish at the wind shelter in the children's slope; bags can be left at the foot of the slope; rain cover provided; toilets behind the parking lot; the right of public access applies; results published after the race (top 10 fastest).

name: Sylvesterloppet Kalmar
description: The Sylvester Run in Kalmar is a local running classic organized by Högby IF Athletics and will be held on December 31, 2026. Basic information about the race can be found on the club's website. For officials and volunteers, the club's login system is used for registration.
course_highlights: Distances of 5 km and 10 km around Fredriksskans and Lindöfjärden
Medal and a specially designed hat for all registered participants
Walk class 5 km without timing and various class divisions
additional: Kalmar Sylvesterlopp is described as a running classic. Registration as an official/volunteer is done via the website's registration form (WordPress) and requires login: https://friidrott.hogbyif.se/wp-login.php?action=register Start times for different classes include P/F 5 - 13, 0.4 - 2.0 km, M/F 5 and 10 km, as well as Walk class 5 km without timing; late registration and payment options include card, Swish, or bank transfer.

name: Sylvesterloppet Olofström
description: The Sylvester Run in Olofström is a traditional concluding race organized by UF Contact since 1971. The main distance is a quarter marathon (10,549 meters), which has been run in two laps on the current course since 2018, and there is also a shorter route of approximately 5.3 km. The event has long featured finish, changing, catering, and award ceremony in the Sports Hall, providing a pleasant setting for runners and spectators. The history and club connections make the race a folk festival for both competitive and recreational runners.
course_highlights: Quarter marathon 10,549 m (run as two laps on the current course since 2018)
Shorter route approximately 5.3 km remains as an alternative
Finish, changing, catering, and award ceremony in the Sports Hall
additional: Registration is done via EasyRecord (specified in the invitation). PM and course maps are available as PDF files on the organizer's pages (invitation, PM, course). Start list is published separately on the organizer's website. The event has historically included changing, catering, and award ceremony in the Sports Hall. History and course profile, including start and finish points around the Sports Hall and Nya torget.

name: adidas Premiärmilen
description: Adidas Premiärmilen is a 10-kilometer race in Northern Djurgården in Stockholm that serves as a qualifying race for the adidas Stockholm Marathon. The race is organized by Hässelby SK and Spårvägens FK within the Marathon Group and attracts approximately 5,000 runners. The start and finish are located at Fiskartorpsvägen, about 500 meters from the University subway station, and the course offers about 117 meters of elevation gain on a mix of asphalt, gravel, and trail surfaces. Premiärmilen is a qualifying race for the Stockholm Marathon; the registration fee varies between 395 and 645 SEK, with a tentative start around 11:00 AM, and a maximum time of two hours.
course_highlights: 10-kilometer course in Northern Djurgården serving as a qualifying race for adidas Stockholm Marathon
Start and finish at Fiskartorpsvägen, approximately 500 meters from the University subway station
Course includes approximately 117 meters of elevation gain with surfaces of asphalt, gravel, trail, and wooden bridge
additional: Qualifying race for adidas Stockholm Marathon; approximately 5,000 participants; age limit 15 years; tentative start around 11:00 AM; maximum time two hours; Northern Djurgården; start and finish area at Fiskartorpsvägen (about 500 meters from the University subway station); elevation gain approximately 117 meters; surfaces: asphalt 64.7%, gravel 29.8%, trail 5.3%, wooden bridge 0.2%; water stations and medical services in the area. Premiärmilen is a 10-kilometer race around Northern Djurgården and is a qualifying event for the adidas Stockholm Marathon.
