The age limit is 15 years, and certain aids such as strollers and wheelchairs are not allowed, with a tentative start at 11:00 AM and a maximum time of 2 hours.

name: Hoka Torekov-Båstad Lördag
description: HOKA Torekov‑Båstad is a coastal trail run of 21.4 km between Torekov and Båstad with varied terrain and beautiful views of the sea. The race is promoted with the slogan "Breathe Freedom" and is aimed at both recreational runners and those looking to challenge themselves in technical trail running. The event is part of the Outnorth Trailtour and also included in the Trails of SWE concept, attracting elite runners and providing a national competitive atmosphere.
course_highlights: 21.4 km varied trail running between Torekov and Båstad
Coastal views with sea vistas and natural surroundings
Part of Outnorth Trailtour / Trails of SWE - diverse natural environments (mountains, forest, sea)
additional: The event takes place on March 28 - 29, 2026. Hotel Skansen offers three different accommodation packages for participants. An After Run buffet is available in Hotel Skansen's banquet hall (price 445 SEK per person). Organizer/organization: Trailrunning Sweden AB, Hästtorget 6, 312 30 Laholm. Hotel Skansen offers three accommodation packages and an After Run buffet in the banquet hall; booking and package details are available via the hotels' website and code TRAILBÅSTAD.

name: Genarps IF Trail (GIFT)
description: Genarps IF Trail (GIFT) is a technical trail run on the Romeleåsens heights with start and finish at Ekevallen in Genarp. The event offers several distances (10, 25, and 40 km) with substantial elevation gain and is open to both elite and recreational runners. The courses are certified by ITRA/UTMB, and the 40 km distance serves as the Swedish Championship/Swedish Championship for short-distance trail running; there are water and energy stations along the course as well as changing rooms and showers at the race center. Registration is done via the specified registration page, and the registration fee includes post-race refreshments (burger/sausage and drinks according to information on the page).
course_highlights: Technical trails on Romeleåsens heights
Significant elevation gains: approximately 160 / 540 / 820 meters for 10 / 25 / 40 km
Courses are certified by ITRA and included in UTMB/World Series; 40 km is Swedish Championship/Swedish Championship
additional: Race bibs are collected on race day one hour before the start. Showers and changing rooms are available at the race center. Water and energy stations are placed along the courses (detailed location and offerings per distance are available on the information page). The 25 km distance is part of the Skåne Trailcup; the 40 km is Swedish Championship/Swedish Championship, and runners affiliated with clubs connected to SFIF can participate in the Swedish Championship/Swedish Championship according to the rules. The start is at 09:30; parking at Ekevallen; water and energy stations along the course and at the finish; showers and changing rooms; registration and results via Sportstiming; post-race meal includes food and drinks; finisher shirts made of functional material can be purchased for an additional fee.

name: Växjöloppet
description: Växjöloppet is a family-friendly race held in Strandbjörket in Växjö, scheduled for May 1, 2026. Runners can choose between 5 km, 10 km, 21.1 km, and the Little Växjöloppet for younger participants. The start and finish are located at Värendsgatan/Strandbjörkshallen, and the course offers a scenic route around Växjösjön and through the Bokhultet nature reserve. The event caters to recreational runners, teams, and families, and features services such as water stations and bib number distribution on site.
course_highlights: Start at Värendsgatan outside Strandbjörkshallen; finish at Lagunvallen by Växjösjön
Scenic course passing through Bokhultet (nature reserve with mostly deciduous trees)
Mixed terrain: first kilometer asphalt, then forest trail for 10 km/21.1 km and last ~3.5 km asphalt around the lake
additional: The last day for online registration is April 30 at 12:00. Late registration can be done at bib number distribution on April 30 from 14:00 to 18:00 at Intersport, Grand Samarkand, or in Strandbjörket on May 1 from 08:30 to 09:15. The 10 km race has four water stations (at 1, 3, 5.5, and 6.5 km); the 21.1 km race offers water at eight points (including 1, 3, 5.5, 6.5, 10, 13, 15.5, and 16.5 km). Companies/organizations can request an invoice by contacting vaxjoloppet@ifkvaxjo.se. There is a team competition and the Little Växjöloppet for younger runners; multiple water stations along the course, especially for longer distances.

name: Västerås Marathon
description: Västerås Marathon will be held on May 1, 2026, offering three distances: marathon (42 km), half marathon (21 km), and 10 km on a flat and fast course through Västerås and along the shores of Lake Mälaren. The course is GPS-measured and has low total elevation gain, making the race suitable for personal bests and seedings for other marathons. The race passes several local landmarks and is sanctioned by the Swedish Athletics Association. The organizers welcome runners of all levels to a day of community and running joy.
course_highlights: Flat and fast course along Lake Mälaren's shores
Passes Lögarängsbadet, Aseatornet, Turbinhuset, Isbrytaren, and The Steam Hotel
Tunnel section and the steepest hill about 400 meters from the start; total elevation gain approximately 32 meters
additional: Start and finish in Vasaparken. Start times: 09:00 (marathon), 10:00 (half marathon), 13:00 (10 km); starts may be divided into groups (e.g., 21k-A 10:00, 21k-B 10:05). Bib number distribution and baggage drop-off open from 07:00 in the City Hall restaurant. Water stations: 2 on 10 km, 4 on half marathon, and 8 on marathon; water and sports drinks from Umara. The central station is about 300 meters from the start/finish; several city parking options are available. The race can be used for seedings for the Stockholm Marathon (results must be uploaded on the same day).

name: Nordens Ark TrailRun
description: Nordens Ark TrailRun is a family-friendly trail race held in the scenic environment of Nordens Ark near Åby estate. The fifth edition of the event will take place on Saturday, May 2, 2026, organized by IK Granit. A wide range of courses are offered for all levels, from 1 km for the youngest to a challenging 30 km for the most enduring. The courses wind through Ekoparken, allowing participants to enjoy the arrival of spring in the park's natural surroundings.
course_highlights: Courses from 1 km up to 30 km
Winding trails through Ekoparken near Åby estate
Beautiful, scenic views and park environment - signs of spring and cultural-historical features in the area
additional: Organizer: IK Granit. Location is Nordens Ark, Åby estate, 456 93 Hunnebostrand. The event is promoted as a folk festival for both participants and spectators. Paragliding classes are planned; registration via IK Granit's website; the race is held in Ekoparken around Nordens Ark.

name: Förslöv Trail
description: Förslöv Trail is a trail race at the foot of Hallandsåsen scheduled for April 3, 2026, with start and finish at Förslöv Sports Hall. Participants can choose between 5 km, 10 km, and 24 km; all distances share the same first 2 km and the last kilometer. The courses offer varied nature with grassy trails, sections on Skåneleden, and shorter climbs—suitable for both experienced trail runners and recreational runners. After finishing, participants are offered a medal, fruit, and the opportunity to socialize in the event center at the sports hall.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the foot of Hallandsåsen with beautiful nature and views
Variable terrain: grassy trails, sections on Skåneleden, and short climbs
All distances share the same first 2 km and last 1 km; the first hill appears after about 100 meters
additional: Water stations: sports drink from Umara and water are placed along the course (5 km: sports drink at 2.5 km; 10 km: sports drink + water at 2.5 km and 7 km; 24 km: sports drink at 2.5, 12, and 20 km + water at 7 and 17 km). Fruit/snacks are available at one station. After the race, medals, fruit, and drinks are offered at the event center in the sports hall, which remains open until all participants have finished. Changing rooms are available before and after the race in the same building as the sports hall. Bibs are to be collected on race day no later than 20 minutes before your start (bibs available from 08:30 at the start/finish); there is an option to pick up bibs the day before at Stadium Outlet in Ängelholm. Distances: 5 km (325 SEK), 10 km (375 SEK), 24 km (425 SEK). Start times: 24 km at 10:00, 10 km at 10:30, 5 km at 11:00. Start and finish at Förslöv Sports Hall. Drinking stations: Umara sports drink and water at selected kilometers. After finishing: medal and fruit; the finish area remains open until all have finished; changing rooms available in the sports hall.

name: Påskrundan 2026
description: Vänersborgs AIK warmly welcomes you to Påskrundan - a popular cross-country race during the Easter holiday suitable for both elite runners and recreational athletes. The start and finish are located at the ski cabin in Vänersborg, and the main course is approximately 7 km long with varied terrain of gravel roads and trails. The race combines an easy first part with a more hilly and challenging finish, and there are also children's and youth races so the whole family can participate.
course_highlights: Approximately 7 km of varied running along gravel roads and trails
The first part is easy and invites speed, the finish is more hilly and challenging
Start and finish at the Ski Cabin in Vänersborg; children's and youth races included
additional: Schedule: 0 - 6 years start/assembly 09:30; 7 - 13 years start/assembly 10:00; main race assembly 11:00 (activities listed 11:00 - 13:00). Registration on activity pages is indicated as open only for club members and requires login. Prizes are awarded to the top in each class and all participants are entered into raffles.

name: Ryssbergsloppet
description: Ryssbergets IK welcomes you to the Ryssbergsloppet 2026, held at Hjortakroksskolan in Sölvesborg. The race is part of the Skånes VeteranCup 2026 and offers several distances for different ages and levels. Start lists, class divisions, and course maps are published on the club's website. The event is club-driven and welcomes both recreational runners and competitors.
course_highlights: Multiple distances: 1.9 km, 5.1 km, 7.5 km, and 12.6 km
Start and finish at Hjortakroksskolan, Sölvesborg
The courses are marked (kilometer markers) and officials are present at intersections
additional: Number bibs should be collected no later than 30 minutes before the start; the race is part of Skånes VeteranCup 2026; refreshments (water and sports drinks) are available at the turnaround/finish; award ceremony begins around 12:30; catering with coffee and grilled sausages is offered. Participants should pick up their start materials at least 30 minutes before the start. Prior to the race, there is an invitation, class division/start fee, registration, start list, PM, and course maps. The race is part of Skånes VeteranCup 2026.

name: Kanallöpet
organizer: Borensbergs IF, OK Skogsströvarna och Vreta SoMK
description: Kanallöpet is a welcoming race along the Göta Canal between Ljungsbro and Borensberg with courses for half marathon, 10 km, and 5 km recreational running, as well as a competitive class for the half marathon. The race is aimed at competitive runners, recreational athletes, and families, and in 2026, Kanallöpet will have DM/VDM status in the half marathon. The start takes place at the Sports Hall in Ljungsbro (half marathon), at Sjöbacka Bridge (10 km), and at Brunneby Musteri (5 km), with the finish line at the sports ground Bergvallen in Borensberg. Organizing clubs are Borensberg IF, Vreta SoMK, and OK Skogsströvarna.
course_highlights: The race follows the Göta Canal between Ljungsbro and Borensberg - scenic canal sections
Finish at the sports ground Bergvallen in Borensberg
Different start locations for each distance (Ljungsbro half marathon, Sjöbacka Bridge 10 km, Brunneby Musteri 5 km); common start at 13:00
additional: Transport: Buses are arranged from Borensberg to each start (booked and paid for during registration); bus costs 100 SEK and no transport is offered after the finish (option to book on race day at the location). Team registration: A team of 5 runners is available in the recreational classes, with a price per runner 20% lower than individual registration, team registration only via online registration. Bib numbers are collected at each start location. Registration and payment: payment via Swish or bank transfer; registration is valid only after payment is received, and if payment is not received within 10 days, the registration is canceled. A race info sheet with more details will be published later. Cross-country running along the Göta Canal between Ljungsbro and Borensberg; registration and payment via www.kanallopet.com as well as Swish or bank transfer; late registration between 11:30 and 12:30; medals including a special medal for participants up to 16 years old; no bus transport back after the finish.

name: SäterMaran inkl. DM i halvmaraton
description: Sätermaran 2026 is organized by Säters IF FIK and the invitation to this year's race is published on the club's website. The club encourages runners to review the attached invitation document for complete information. For questions, please contact the club via their email address.
course_highlights: DM in half marathon (Mittsvenska DM) is part of the competition
Offers both distances: half marathon and marathon
Held in Säter with results publication from previous years
additional: The invitation to Sätermaran is available as an attached document on the news page. The race information on the club's website recommends reading the PM/timetable before the trip, noting that check-in for race categories often occurs about 60 minutes before the start, and to bring food/drinks and rain gear as the race day can be long. The club prefers participants to wear race clothing (optional) and refers to the club shop via Intersport for orders. The 2024 edition of SäterMaran was organized as Mittsvenska DM in half marathon and displayed results for both half marathon and marathon, indicating the event's broad range and local significance.

name: Allstarsmilen
description: ALLSTARSMILEN is one of Sweden's fastest 10 km races and takes place on a flat, measured, and sanctioned course. The race is a good opportunity for runners who want to set a new personal best or use the result as seedings for other competitions. Welcome to participate and take the chance for a fast race on an even course.
course_highlights: Flat and fast 10 km course
Measured and sanctioned course
Suitable for PB and seedings for other races
additional: Three-lap course mostly on bike paths and will be marked with arrows at each turn. Maximum 150 participants. Sanctioned by Västsvenska Friidrottsförbundet.

name: Vårruset (Malmö)
description: Vårruset in Malmö is an evening race for women in Slottsparken held on Monday, May 4, 2026 at 6:30 PM. The race is part of Sweden's largest fitness tour for women and is offered on two distances, 2.5 km and a certified 5 km. The event welcomes both individual participants and teams (5 people) - teams receive a picnic after finishing - and the local organizer is MAI. Registration includes a medal, bib, and a race bag; timing is optional.
course_highlights: Certified 5 km course
Race in Slottsparken, Malmö - green park environment and evening event
Distances 2.5 km or 5 km; timing can be opted out
additional: Individual registration: medal, race bag, music quiz + prizes, bib; team registration (5 persons) includes a picnic after finishing. Timing for the 5 km is offered but can be declined (same price regardless of timing). Recommended age: 5 km from 13 years (11 with adult supervision), 2.5 km from 11 years (7 with adult supervision). Training session scheduled for Thursday, March 19 at 6:30 PM at Lördagsplan, Slottsparken. Registration can be done digitally until race day and no later than 1 hour before the first start. Training session in Slottsparken on March 19; Recommended age: 5 km - 13 years (11 years with adult supervision); 2.5 km - 11 years (7 years with adult supervision); Registration is digital; contact: varruset@mai.se

name: Påsksmällen

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Män och kvinnor öppen klass Landsväg 5 km 12:30 300:-

description: Easter Run is a classic road and trail race organized by Enhörna IF with start and finish at Enhörna Outdoor Recreation Area. The 2026 edition is the 48th and offers categories for kids, several youth classes, as well as open 5 km and 10 km for adults. The race welcomes both recreational and competitive runners and publishes start and results lists on the club's website and social media.
course_highlights: Combination of road and trail
Start and finish at Enhörna Outdoor Recreation Area (sports ground)
Children/youth distances from about 600 m up to 4 km; adult distances 5 km and 10 km
additional: The last registration day is April 3, 2026; late registration on site is possible until 60 minutes before each start signal. Late registration fee for adult categories is +100 SEK (total 400 SEK) and for youth categories +50 SEK (total 225 SEK). By registering, the participant agrees that their name will be published in start and result lists and that any images may be published on the club's website and social media. Competition rules from the Swedish Athletics Association apply and participation is at your own risk. Registration prices: adults 400 SEK and youth 225 SEK; on-site late registration costs +100 SEK for adults and +50 SEK for youth.

name: Hallarydsloppet

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Öppen klass: Herr 21 km 11.00 180:- Öppen klass: Dam 21 km 11.00 180:-

description: Hallarydsloppet is a friendly community event held on the Monday after Easter in Hallaryd, suitable for participants of all ages, from children to veterans. The race offers several distances - 21 km, 9.8 km, 6 km, as well as shorter children's and walking routes - and largely takes place on gravel roads surrounded by meadows, stone walls, and forests. The courses feature beautiful landscapes in the borderland between Skåne and Småland, with both open areas and shorter, challenging climbs. The welcoming organizer's message encourages runners, joggers, and walkers to participate or come and cheer.
course_highlights: Large parts run on gravel roads lined with winding stone walls, meadows, and forests
Passage over a historic stone arch bridge from 1870 on the 21 km course
Variable, gently hilly terrain with several clear ascents (including a steep one of ~30 m and another of ~25 m) and multiple water stations
additional: Registration is done via email to Hallarydsloppet@gmail.com; include name, address, class, year of birth, and possibly club affiliation. Payment via bankgiro 5436-8543 or Swish 1232141232. Pre-registration must be received by Hallaryds IF no later than March 31, 2026; late registration can be made on race day until start for an increased fee of 50 SEK (no increased fee for youth and walking classes). Start/finish at Hallaryds school (Häradsvägen 3), and bib numbers are collected no later than 30 minutes before each start. Timing is via the barcode on the bib. Changing rooms/showers: women in HIF's clubhouse, men in the school gymnasium. Water/energy drinks (Umara, lemon flavor) are served at several water stations; see the courses for exact locations. All finishers receive a Hallarydsloppet plaque; prizes for the top three in each class and a raffle for others. Registration is via email and payment via bankgiro or Swish; pre-registration by March 31, 2026; late registration on race day for an extra fee of 50 SEK; start/finish at Hallaryds school; drinks served at water stations; prizes for the top three in each class; plaque for all finishers.

name: Varvetmilen - Jönköping
organizer: Göteborgsvarvet i samarbete med IKHP Huskvarna Idrottsklubb
price_range: 349 kr t.o.m 31/1; 449 kr fr.o.m 1/2; anmälan möjlig t.o.m. 30 min innan start
description: Varvetmilen Jönköping is a well-organized 10 km race that starts and finishes in Knektaparken and goes two laps clockwise around Rocksjön. Your result will be seedings basis for Göteborgsvarvet 2026, which provides the opportunity for a better starting group at Göteborgsvarvet. The event is organized by Göteborgsvarvet in collaboration with IKHP Huskvarna IK and features a family element with Minivarvet for the youngest participants. Bib distribution and baggage drop-off are available in the start and finish area on race day.
course_highlights: Two laps clockwise around Rocksjön
Start and finish in Knektaparken (bib distribution and baggage drop-off on site)
Family element: Minivarvet 210 m for ages 0 - 6 held simultaneously (registration on site)
additional: Date: Monday, April 6, 2026. The start and finish area is located in Knektaparken; the course is two laps around Rocksjön. Minivarvet for children aged 0 - 6 is held on the same day (210 m, registration on site, 80 SEK via Swish). The race is seedings basis for Göteborgsvarvet 2026. Seedings rules via Göteborgsvarvet; Minivarvet for children; bib according to the information provided at registration; start confirmation will be sent via email; bib pickup the day before the race; hydration, showers, changing facilities, and baggage storage available; warm-up before the start.

name: Vårruset
description: Spring Races in Halmstad is part of Sweden's largest fitness tour for women and offers a wonderful spring atmosphere in Alet Nature Reserve. The race is offered in two distances, 2.5 km and 5 km (the 5 km is measured), and takes place at the event area at the civilian airfield near Aleskogen. All individual participants receive a medal, a finish bag, and a bib; teams registering five people are offered a picnic after the finish. Timing is available for the 5 km but can be opted out of during registration if you do not want your result published.
course_highlights: 5 km course is measured
The race takes place in Alet Nature Reserve and along Skepparegatan
Event area at the civilian airfield near Aleskogen
additional: Registration is done digitally and can be completed until race day (no later than 1 hour before the first start). Recommended age: 2.5 km from 11 years (7 years with adult), 5 km from 13 years (11 years with adult). Team registration (5 persons) includes a picnic after the finish. It is possible to opt out of timing so that results are not published; the price is the same regardless of timing. A separate digital race is offered for those unable to attend physically (medal mailed after the tour). A training session in Halmstad is planned for April 21 at Motorhalland Skoda at 18:30. Team registration requires five people; medal, finish bag, and music quiz with prizes are included per registration category; digital registration and picnic after race are available for teams of 5 persons.

name: Vårruset Uppsala
description: Vårruset Uppsala is an evening race for women in the Vårruset tour, offering distances of 2.5 km and 5 km (the 5 km is measured). The start and finish are located at Studenternas IP, and the event is both fitness- and team-friendly, with the option to register individually or as a team. All individual registrants receive a medal, a finish bag, and a bib; team registration also includes a picnic after the finish. Timing is available as an optional service during registration, and results are published only for those who choose timing.
course_highlights: Measured 5 km course
Start and finish at Studenternas IP (Ulleråkersvägen)
Evening race with options of 2.5 km and 5 km
additional: Registration is done digitally and is possible until race day, at least 1 hour before the first start. The price is the same whether you choose timing or not. Recommended age: 5 km from 13 years (11 years with adult), 2.5 km from 11 years (7 years with adult). Local contact: IF Mantrasport. Teams consist of five people, and team registration includes a picnic after the finish. Distances are 2.5 km and 5 km; age recommendations for the distances; timing can be opted out of so that results are not published.

name: Vårruset Vänersborg
description: Vår Ruset in Vänersborg is part of Sweden's largest fitness tour for women and offers a wonderful spring evening for everyone who wants to run, jog, or walk 2.5 or 5 km. The 5 km course is measured and the event provides a medal, a finish bag, and a bib number to participants; timing is optional. Team registration (teams of five people) is offered with a picnic after the finish. The start and finish are at Sanden, Vassbottenleden in Vänersborg, and the event is organized by Vänersborgs SK in collaboration with Vårruset/Marathongruppen.
course_highlights: Distance options of 2.5 km or a measured 5 km
Start and finish at Sanden (Vassbottenleden), Vänersborg
Evening race with a picnic for teams after the finish
additional: Included in the registration: medal, finish bag, bib number, and (if chosen) timing. Team registration (5 persons) includes a picnic after the finish. Recommended age: 13 years and older for the 5 km (11 years with adult supervision), 11 years and older for 2.5 km (7 years with adult supervision). Registration is digital and can be completed until race day, at least 1 hour before the first start. Timing can be opted out of during registration; the price remains the same regardless of timing. The distance options are 2.5 or 5 km (measured 5 km course); start and finish at Sanden, Vassbottenleden 46238, Vänersborg; the surface is partly asphalt and partly gravel; timing can be declined during registration; team registration includes a picnic after the finish; a music quiz and prizes are part of the experience.

name: Ölands Kyrkstafett
price_range: Long bana: 1 600-1 900 kr; Kort bana: 1 000-1 200 kr
description: Oland's Parish Relay is a classic relay race in the spring, organized by Högby IF and Öland's Sports District. The race is offered in two variants: a long course with eleven legs totaling approximately 67.5 km and a short course with six legs totaling 23.5 km. The start and finish are located at Hamnplanen in Färjestaden, and the race suits both experienced runners and beginners as there are legs of different lengths. GPX files for all legs are available for download, and the organizer offers group warm-up and extensive service along the course.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Hamnplanen in Färjestaden with audience encouragement along the course
Long course: 11 legs (2.7 - 8.5 km), total approximately 67.5 km; Short course: 6 legs (2.7 - 5.4 km), total 23.5 km
Leg 3 (Glömminge - Högsrum) has a detour via Rönnerumsvägen due to road construction
additional: Number bib collection: Friday, May 8th from 15:00 to 17:00 and race day, May 9th from 08:00 to 09:30 at Hamngrillen (the start location). Changing rooms and showers are available at the sports hall 200 meters north of Ölands Köpstad (opening hours 08:00 - 10:00 and 14:00 - 17:00). Wellness Studio offers group warm-up before the start. The long course has women's and open categories; the short course has an open category. GPX files are available for all legs. The start fee includes service and bib collection; times for bib pickup and start times are available at Hamnplanen; changing and shower facilities are at the sports hall near Ölands Köpstad; valuables can be left at the finish tent. EKERUM RESORT offers food and accommodation during the weekend.

name: Humlestafetten
description: Humlestafetten is a relay race with six legs, starting and finishing in Bruksparken in Bromölla. The race is open to both recreational and elite runners and offers a community-oriented team competition. The course is flat with varying surfaces of gravel and asphalt, and timing is done with a chip so both total finish times and individual segment times are recorded. Welcome to register your team and experience both competitive joy and camaraderie in the heart of Bromölla.
course_highlights: Six legs with start and finish in Bruksparken, Bromölla
Flat course with varying surfaces: gravel and asphalt
Water stations at start/finish and approximately 3 km on segment 1 and 4
additional: Number bibs are collected from 09:00 in Bruksparken; shower and changing facilities available in Sparbankshallen; timing is done with a data chip and both total times and segment times for all six participants are recorded; bib must be attached to the chest and be fully visible; runners who wish to take it easier are advised to stay to the right during laps; prizes for the top three in each category and a raffle for larger prizes. 6 legs per team; 20th anniversary celebration; hot air balloon rides as prizes; start at 09:00, bib pickup; registration via humlestafetten.se; shower and changing in Sparbankshallen.

name: Östhammars Stadslopp
description: The Östhammar City Run is organized by Östhammar Athletics and takes place in Östhammar. According to the club's website, the 2026 race starts at Frösåkersvallen. The site presents the event as a local city run and contains information about the club's handling of personal data and image use in connection with the race.
course_highlights: Start at Frösåkersvallen in Östhammar
additional: Contact information provided at registration is used only for contact regarding the race. After the race, information no longer needed is deleted, but some details such as name, age, and results may be retained for result lists and race statistics. Photos taken during the event may be used on the club's website, Facebook page, and Instagram; participants can contact the club to have photos removed. Start list, registration, and results are available for the City Run on Östhammar Athletics' website.

name: Östgötatidningen Mjölby Stadslopp

description: Mjölby City Run by Östgötatidningen is a welcoming recreational race starting and finishing in Stadsparken in Mjölby. The main race is six kilometers through the city with music and encouragement stations along the route, and there is also a shorter three-kilometer route (KyrkRundan) as well as a free children's race. The event emphasizes community, movement, and family celebration and is organized with local partners and warm-up sessions before the races.
course_highlights: Approximately 99% asphalt; fast surface with both uphill and downhill sections
Running along the Svartån river for about half of the course
The last kilometer through Mjölby city center via Gästisparken back to Stadsparken
additional: Number bibs are collected at Intersport on Friday, May 8 from 12-18; uncollected bibs will be handed out in Stadsparken no later than one hour before the start. Late registration is possible via the website from April 30 to May 7, as well as at the bib distribution on May 8 or on race day (Swish only). The small tab on the bib is the chip that records your time; without it, no time will be registered. Warm-up is provided by Fitness4You 15 minutes before the first children's start and 15 minutes before the main race. After finishing, participants can enjoy food and drinks provided by ICA Supermarket Mjölby and Finspångs Brunnsborrning; children receive medals after finishing. Results for 2025 are published at mjolbystadslopp.se; corporate/tent packages are available through partner Möllers Sverige.

name: Springtime Mariestads stadslopp
price_range: 10 km: 200-350 kr; 5 km: 200-350 kr; Ungdom (5 km): 120 kr; Minimara: 60 kr; Funkislopp: 60 kr
description: Springtime Mariestads city race is organized by Mariestads AIF (together with Korpen Mariestad) and is a welcoming city race held in early May. The race offerings cater to both recreational runners and competitive athletes with 10 km and 5 km distances, as well as special races for children (Minimara) and people with disabilities (Funkislopp). The event has been held since 1982 and in 2026, Springtime will be part of the West Swedish Running Cup. Start and category divisions are available for senior classes, juniors, veterans, and open recreational classes.
course_highlights: 10 km run as 2 x 5 km (two laps of 5 km)
City race courses in Mariestad (urban environment)
Separate short loops for children and Funkislopp: approx. 500 m and approx. 2000 m
additional: Start times and classes: Funkislopp starts at 10:30 (500 m or 2000 m, with the possibility of having companions/escorts), Minimara starts at 11:15 (about 500 m for preschool children, about 2000 m for grades 1 - 6). A competition license via a club affiliated with the Swedish Athletics Association is required for participation in senior and veteran classes. Springtime 2026 is part of the West Swedish Running Cup. Timing with chip; start and finish at the Town Square; water stations at 5 km and at the finish; changing rooms and showers at Korpen Mariestad; the event is part of the Western Running Cup; prize giving and raffles.

name: Kungsholmen Runt
description: Kungsholmen Runt is a popular running race in Stockholm offering both a half marathon and a 10 km race, starting and finishing at Rålambshovsparken. The course is described as flat and fast, suitable for runners aiming for a personal best; the event is also marketed as a festival around the island. There is also a kids' race for children. The organizer publishes course information and GPX files for download on the website.
course_highlights: Flat courses, good for personal best (PB)
Run around Kungsholmen with start/finish at Rålambshovsparken
Kids' race for children offered
additional: Course maps and GPX files are available for download (e.g., KR23gpx_v2.zip and KR23HMgpx.zip); information about start and finish areas is published on the invitation/course pages; a separate kids' race for children is indicated on the course/information pages. Registration is done via Runners' Store; cash payment is required; late registration costs 400 SEK for the half marathon and 300 SEK for the 10 km, and 100 SEK for the Kids' Race; three forms are required for late registration; on-site start places may be available on Saturday at the race venue (Rålambshovsparken) from 08:30; updates on registration status are closely monitored.

name: Strandmilen
description: Strandmilen in Hultsfred is a recurring running event on a beautiful, smooth course along Lake Hulingen. The event offers a 10 km course as well as two children's races in different age categories and is open to everyone, including those not affiliated with any club. Information about start times and the race briefing can be found on the registration page. Warm welcome to participate!
course_highlights: Beautiful, smooth courses along Lake Hulingen
10 km course for adults
Two children's races (different age categories, e.g., 0 - 6 and 7 - 12 years)
additional: Children's races start from 10:00 AM and the 10 km race starts at 11:00 AM. You do not need to be a member of any club to participate. There is a race briefing with more information linked from the registration page. Participant lists are published (page for those registered for Strandmilen). Registration opens via the club's page; the 2026 edition is planned with registration open from May 9.

description: Springtime in Helsingborg is a popular running event with several distances for different target groups: the classic 10 km, shorter 5 km, MiniSpringtime for children, and the inclusive "Everyone Can Run" race. The 10 km distance is the backbone of Springtime and has been part of the event since 1981, while team competitions offer the opportunity to compete together in mixed teams. The event is organized by IFK Helsingborg and offers medals, bibs, as well as water and fruit at the finish line.
course_highlights: The Classic 10 km - Springtime's backbone since 1981
Shorter and intense 5 km, also available in team competitions
MiniSpringtime 1 km for children born 2016 - 2020; the same course is used for "Everyone Can Run"
additional: When registering, there is an option to purchase insurance via Startklar.nu. The price includes a bib, medal, water, and fruit at the finish. Start places can be transferred to another runner by contacting ifk.helsingborg@springtimeihelsingborg.se no later than April 20th. Team competitions consist of four runners per team (mixed teams allowed) and times are adjusted with a correction factor to ensure equal conditions between women and men. Registration is open via the website, and the event includes several categories such as Company/Team, MiniSpringtime, Everyone Can Run, and Open IFK Championships.

name: Björnlunken 2026
description: Björnlunken is a welcoming cross-country race in the forests around Lockmora in Kungsör, organized voluntarily by Kungsörs SK. The course runs over a pine-covered moraine ridge and offers trails and gravel roads with moderate elevation changes and some technical sections, suitable for both runners and MTB cyclists. The race has a long tradition and is open to everyone - children, recreational runners, and experienced runners - where community is as important as the competition. The organizer also offers a combination of MTB + running ("Dagens Dubbel") for those seeking a greater challenge.
course_highlights: Cross-country running along pine-covered moraine ridge between Alberga and Kungsör
Mix of trails and gravel roads with moderate elevation changes and some technical sections
Combination MTB + running possible (MTB 18 km in Dagens Dubbel)
additional: Registration is handled via RaceId (link from the organizer's registration page). There is a virtual Björnlunken for those unable to participate on site. Group discount: register 10 people and pay for 8 - after registration, email info@bjornlunken.se with group details. Late registration can be done on race day, no later than 60 minutes before each start. Bibs are distributed at each start; the Björnlunken medal is awarded to all finishers. Parking is available at the finish area in Lockmora; free buses transport participants to each start. Changing and shower facilities are available, and outerwear can be left at the start and collected at the finish. For MTB, a helmet and regulation-compliant bike are required. Virtual Björnlunken is available; group discount at 10 registrations (pay for 8); registration via RaceId; free buses from the race center to the start; bibs are distributed at the start; water stations, showers, and refreshments after the race.

name: BLK Trailen (Bredared)
location: Björkehovsgården, Bredared, Borås, Västra Götalands län, Sweden
description: Borås Running Club, in collaboration with Bredareds IF, invites you to a wonderful trail race in beautiful and hilly nature around Bredareds exercise trail. The race offers several distances so that both experienced trail runners and recreational runners can find a race that suits them. The start and finish are located at Björkehovsgården, and parts of the course run on the blue terrain trail. The event is presented as a club event with a local character and focus on varied terrain.
course_highlights: Hilly terrain around Bredareds exercise trail
Parts of the course on the blue terrain trail at Björkehovsgården
Start and finish on the lawn behind Björkehovsgården
additional: The events are held around Bredareds exercise trail with varying trail lengths; several distances are offered. The club uses the blue terrain trail at Björkehovsgården and can include a small extension on the lawn behind the farm where the start and finish are also located. Backyard race on National Day, June 6; point system: 2 points per month for running around a long trail or both short trails.

name: Kurts Marathon / Kurts 300:e maraton (Hultsfred) — inkl. halvmaraton & Backyard Ultra

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startavgift 250 kr. Betalas via swish till 0706285728.

description: Kurt 300 Marathon is a privately organized marathon on Kurt Gustavsson's 80th birthday, open to everyone and sanctioned with a certified course. The course consists of park roads along Lake Hulingen in Hultsfred and is run as a 5-lap course (the last lap is shorter). Both full and half marathons are offered, with timing and support at the turn, as well as a social gathering for participants afterward.
course_highlights: The course runs on park roads along Lake Hulingen
5-lap course with the last lap 3 km shorter
Approximately 20% asphalt; two water stations along the course
additional: Start and finish at Knektavallen entrance facing Lake Hulingen. Changing rooms, showers, and toilets are available at Knektavallen. Bib numbers from 08:00 at the start. Timing by Reima and Peter. Water, sports drink, cola, bananas, and candy are available at the turn; at 4 km, water, sports drink, and cola. Register with Kurt via phone 070-628 57 28 or email kurt.gustavsson@hotmail.com. Swish payment details provided for registration (0706285728). For Backyard Ultra: 6.7 km laps every hour, course consists of park roads (gravel only) and is flat; pancakes served after 5 hours, sausages with bread and coffee offered, and a medal for all who complete at least one lap. Backyard Ultra: 6.7 km lap; start every full hour until participants can no longer continue; previous years' results and registration information available.

name: Vårruset (Växjö)
description: Växjö edition of Vårruset is part of Sweden's major spring race for women and takes place on Monday, May 11, 2026, at 6:30 PM with start and finish at Strandbjörket. Participants can choose a 2.5 km or a certified 5 km course, suitable for those who want to run, jog, or walk around the beautiful Växjö Lake. Individual registration includes a medal, a finish bag, Vårruset music quiz, bib, and timing (timing can be opted out). A team of five people can register and will receive a picnic after finishing.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Strandbjörket
The course goes around the beautiful Växjö Lake
Selectable distances: 2.5 km or certified 5 km
additional: Registration is done digitally and can be completed up until race day, no later than 1 hour before the first start. Recommended age: 13 years and older for the 5 km (11 years with adult supervision); 11 years and older for the 2.5 km (7 years with adult supervision). It is possible to opt out of official timing during registration; team registrations (5 people) include a post-race picnic. A digital option is available for those unable to attend physically (digital participants will receive their medal by mail after June 4). The distances are 2.5 km or 5 km; start/finish at Strandbjörket; course runs around Växjö Lake; teams consist of 5 people; digital registration; option to opt out of timing; post-race picnic for teams.

name: Blodomloppet (Uddevalla)
