description: Welcome to the Blood Run in Uddevalla - a local Blood Run where you can walk, jog, or run 5 km or 10 km in and around Museiparken. The race is organized to raise awareness of the vital blood donation and welcomes both individual and team registrations (teams of 3 - 5 people). The courses offer a varied urban environment with uphill sections, old railway embankments, and long downhill stretches towards the hospital area. There is also the Little Blood Run for children up to 12 years old and the picnic tradition after the finish line.
course_highlights: Start and finish in Museiparken; the course follows Kungsgatan and passes Sinclair as well as under the railway at Östra station
10 km: continues uphill at Dynamitbacken towards Bjursjön and along the old railway embankment (Lelångebanan)
5 km: turns towards Bleket with the highest point at Norrskolan, then mostly downhill towards Uddevalla hospital and through a long pedestrian tunnel under road 44
additional: Registration can be done individually or in teams (3 - 5 people); team registration includes a picnic bag and the last day for team registration is May 4. A 40 SEK discount is offered for blood donors upon registration. Wellness vouchers (Epassi, Wellnet, Benify) are accepted and payment can also be made via Swish, email invoice, or e-invoice. Late registration at Museiparken can be done on the race day (from 16:00 on the website). Wellness vouchers are accepted; registration is open with late registration until 16:00 on May 11; team registration (3 - 5 participants) includes a picnic bag; blood donor discount applies.

name: Varvetmilen (Malmö)
organizer: Göteborgsvarvet i samarbete med Heleneholms IF
description: Challenge yourself in the 10 km Varvetmilen Malmö - a faster race where your result is the basis for seedings to Göteborgsvarvet 2026. The start and finish are at Heleneholms IP and the race is organized by Göteborgsvarvet in collaboration with Heleneholms IF. The event also features the Minivarvet (210 m) for children aged 0 - 6 years, held on site. The information on the page encourages runners to take the opportunity to secure a better starting group for Göteborgsvarvet.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Heleneholms IP
The course runs south through Nydalaparken and circles the Almvik area
Water station at 5 km, the course returns through Nydala towards Heleneholms IP
additional: Seedings for Göteborgsvarvet 2026 are based on the result. The Minivarvet for children aged 0 - 6 years, 210 m, is registered on site (80 SEK via Swish). Bib distribution, baggage drop-off, and start/finish area are located at Heleneholms IP. A water station is available at 5 km. The Minivarvet for children (210 m) is held simultaneously; bib pickup (the day before at Stadium Södergatan 10:00-19:00) and on race day at Heleneholms IP (09:00-10:30); showers/changing rooms, baggage storage, and warm-up areas are provided; water is available at 5 km and at the finish; net time is recorded. Varvetmilen automatically seeds runners into a better starting group for Göteborgsvarvet 2026.

name: Startmilen (Örebro)
description: Welcome to the Startmilen in Örebro - an open recreational race suitable for many levels and often marks the start of the outdoor season. The start and finish are at Tybblelundshallen / Örebro University, and the course runs through the streets of Almby. The 2026 edition features a new course layout due to road work: 5 km run on one lap and 10 km on three laps, with both distances officially measured. The race includes categories for both recreational runners and competitors; the 10 km is also the Southern Svealand Championship (DM).
course_highlights: Start and finish outside Tybblelundshallen at Örebro University
Courses on streets in the Almby district: 5 km = one lap, 10 km = three laps
Both 5 km and 10 km are officially measured (federation-certified course)
additional: Race bibs are distributed at Tybblelundshallen on race day from approximately 10:30 AM. Timing is done with a transponder attached around one foot's ankle, which is loaned out at bib distribution (lost transponder incurs an 800 SEK fee); KnatteStarten has no timing. Late registration opens from April 6 and can be done via the registration system or on-site up to 60 minutes before the start at Tybblelundshallen, with an increased fee and subject to availability. Start times: KnatteStarten 1 km at 12:30, 5 km at 13:00, and 10 km at 14:00. New course in Almby; 10 km sanctioned by the Swedish Athletics Federation and part of the Southern Svealands Running Series and Championship; start and finish at Tybblelundshallen; transponder timing; bibs distributed at Tybblelundshallen; KnatteStarten 1 km at 12:30, 5 km at 13:00, and 10 km at 14:00; registration via AnmälMigNu; late registration before start against an increased fee.

name: Hässleholmsloppet
description: Hässleholmsloppet is a trail race held at Hovdala Castle organized by Hässleholms AIS with three distances: 21 km, 10 km, and 5.4 km. The courses feature soft, winding trails through varied forest environments with water crossings and beautiful nature around Hovdala. The 21 km route is part of Spring in Skåne's Trailcup 2026 and is aimed at runners seeking more elevation and technical challenge, while the 5.4 km is a shorter, less technical nature experience. Registration is done via Neptron's Entry system from the organizer's registration page.
course_highlights: Soft, winding trails through varied forest environments with water crossings
21 km is a route at Hovdala starting with parts of the 10 km course and has more elevation
5.4 km offers a beautiful nature experience with a simpler technical course and fewer elevation gains
additional: Max 400 participants; late registration is available via the website with an additional fee of 50 SEK from the Monday of the race week; name changes can be made via the registration site (cost 100 SEK); bib numbers are to be picked up on site no later than 30 minutes before the start and must be worn visibly; electronic timing; water stations with water and sports drinks (Umara) are available on all three courses; no facilities for changing or showers, toilets available; results are posted on site and live on the website. Start times: 5.4 km at 11:40, 10 km at 11:50, 21 km at 12:00. Max 400 participants. Late registration fee 50 SEK. Bib pickup on site at least 30 minutes before start. Hydration stations with water and sports drinks at designated points. No showers or changing facilities. Results published on the website; 21 km results are reported to Spring in Skåne's Trailcup.

name: Vårruset Göteborg
description: Spring Ruset in Gothenburg is part of Sweden's largest fitness tour for women and is held in Slottsskogen with start and finish below Björngårdsvillan. The race is an evening event with distances of 2.5 km and a verified 5 km, and is open to everyone who wants to run, jog, or walk. All participants receive a medal, a finish bag, and a bib; there is also a Spring Ruset music quiz and prizes, as well as the option for timing on the 5 km. Teams of five (lag om fem personer) are offered a picnic after the finish line to celebrate together.
course_highlights: Distances: 2.5 km or verified 5 km
Start and finish in Slottsskogen, below Björngårdsvillan
Evening race included in Vårruset's tour for women
additional: Registration is done digitally and accepted until the race day itself, no later than 1 hour before the first start. All individual registrations receive a medal, finish bag, and bib; team registrations (5 persons) also receive a picnic after the finish. Timing is offered for the 5 km but can be opted out of during registration; results are published only for those who choose timing. Recommended age: 2.5 km from 11 years (from 7 years with adult), 5 km from 13 years (from 11 years with adult). There is also a digital option (Vårruset Digitalt) where a medal is sent home after the tour ends; digital participants cannot take part in the physical events. The distances are 2.5 km or 5 km; teams consist of five people; start and finish are located below Björngårdsvillan in Slottsskogen; digital registration; picnic after the finish; timing can be opted out of; medal, finish bag, music quiz, and prizes are included.

name: Skärholmsloppet
description: Skärholmsloppet is a family-friendly fitness event organized by the non-profit association Löparakademin. The 14th edition will take place on May 16, 2026, featuring a timed 5 km race (for participants aged 13 and older), a Fun Run of 1.6 km for all ages, as well as Little and Mini Skärholmsloppet for children. The start and finish are at Puckelbollplanen, with DJs and music stations along the course for extra motivation. Registration is free through the initiative #RUN4ZERO, and all finishers receive a specially designed medal.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Puckelbollplanen
DJs and music stations along the course
Offerings: 5 km timed race, Fun Run 1.6 km, as well as Little (~1.6 km) and Mini (500 m) for children
additional: Registration for the race is free and includes a bib number, medal, and energy at the finish line. Registration on the website closes Thursday, May 14, at 17:00, and late registration is possible at the bib distribution on Friday (May 15) and on race day (May 16), subject to availability. Start times: Skärholmsloppet Mini (500 m) starts at 10:30; Lilla Skärholmsloppet begins with the first start at 11:30 (multiple children’s categories according to color code); Fun Run 1.6 km starts at 12:25; 5 km starts at 13:00. Race info with map, photos, and instructions will be sent to registered participants about a week before the race. At Lilla Skärholmsloppet, fruit and drinks are provided at the finish. The event also offers MINI races and Lilla Skärholmsloppet for children; registration is free and includes a bib, medal, and energy at the finish; after registration, activities are available on-site; start times: Fun Run at 12:25 and 5 km at 13:00; start/finish at Puckelbollplanen.

name: TEC 200 miles
description: Täby Extreme Challenge (TEC) is a well-known ultramarathon held on a recurring loop in the forests of Täby, starting/finishing at the Ensta Krog sports inn. The event takes place over a weekend in mid-April (TEC 2026 is scheduled for April 17-19) and offers several distances—including 50, 100, and 200 miles—as well as a Backyard/loop course and a shorter ultra for beginners. The course is approximately 11.5 km long, combining asphalt, gravel roads/trails, and forest paths, suitable for runners seeking a technical but clearly marked course early in the season. The organizer welcomes participants and emphasizes that the course may be icy or cold early in the season, which may require endurance even in difficult conditions.
course_highlights: Loop length approximately 11.5 km (runners complete 4/7/14/28 laps for Baby/50/100/200 miles)
Mixed surfaces: asphalt, gravel roads/trails, and forest paths
Approximately 126 m positive elevation gain per lap; start/finish and the only aid station at Ensta Krog
additional: Start and finish at Ensta Krog (easily accessible by public transport); the race's only aid station at Ensta Krog where runners can access drop bags; the course is marked and signposted where route choices may be uncertain; there is a risk of wintery/icy conditions early in the season, and the organizer may reroute the course if necessary; GPX file for the course is available. The weekend's distances include Backyard, 100 miles, and 200 miles; Pace on Earth team was present in various roles according to a blog article.

name: Kajenloppet
location: Kajen, Nacka Strand, Nacka Municipality, Stockholm County, Sweden
organizer: Nacka Hockey och Kajen i Nacka strand
description: Kajenloppet is a running festival in Nacka Strand offering a beautiful route along the water with views of Stockholm's inlet. The course passes historic sites and has start and finish at Kajen in Nacka Strand, in the midst of festivities. The race offers several distances - 10 km, 6 km, as well as children's races of 1,200 m and 400 m - suitable for both recreational runners and families. During the day, a family celebration with activities, music, and entertainment for all ages takes place.
course_highlights: Beautiful route along the water with views of Stockholm's inlet
The course passes historic sites along the coast
Start and finish at Kajen in Nacka Strand with family celebration, activities, and music
additional: Distances: 10 km, 6 km, Children's races 1,200 m and 400 m. Start and finish at the same location at Kajen in Nacka Strand. Family celebration on site with activities and music. Contact: info@kajenloppet.se. Children's races start at 10:30 (300 m) and 10:45 (800 m). The 10 km and 6 km distances are included in the program.

name: Premiärloppet
description: The premiere race in Gothenburg is organized by Sävedalens AIK Friidrott and takes place on April 18, 2026, starting and finishing at Skatås Motionscentral. The race is offered in two distances: 10 km on gravel terrain and 5 km on more hilly terrain up to Brudarebacken's highest point. Medals are awarded to all participants, and there are prizes from Löplabbet. Bib number distribution occurs before race day at Löplabbet in Gothenburg (for those registered before April 3) and on race day at Skatås between 10:00 AM and 1:15 PM; refreshments are available at 6 km in the 10 km race.
course_highlights: 10 km on gravel with refreshments at 6 km
5 km hilly terrain up to Brudarebacken's highest point
Start and finish at Skatås Motionscentral; medals to all participants and prizes from Löplabbet
additional: Bib number pickup before race day, Thursday-Friday 10:00-18:00 at Löplabbet in Gothenburg (for those registered before April 3). Bib number pickup on race day at Skatås at start/finish between 10:00 and 13:15. Medals are awarded to all participants. Refreshments at 6 km for the 10 km race. Race director Cecilia Hallin (cecilia.hallin@saik.nu). Nice prizes from our partner Löplabbet. The distances are 5 km and 10 km with slight elevation; refreshments at 6 km and at the finish. Bib numbers are collected before race day at Löplabbet in Gothenburg if registered before April 3, and on race day at Skatås start/finish between 10:00 and 13:15.

name: Tjust Trail Run
location: Västervik, Västervik Municipality, Kalmar County, Sweden
description: Tjust Trail Run is a trail race in Västervik, organized by Tjust Bike & Running Club. The eleventh edition is planned for April 18, 2026, and the course winds through forest trails and over rocky outcrops in the Småland nature. The race offers distances of 2.5 km, 5 km, 10 km, 23 km, and 46 km, suitable for both families and experienced ultrarunners. The start is on Saturday at 08:00, and the event provides a full-day experience in the area.
course_highlights: Winding forest trails through beautiful Småland nature
Rocky outcrops that challenge runners
Distances ranging from family-friendly 2.5 km to ultralong 46 km
additional: Distances are 2.5 km, 5 km, 10 km, 23 km, and 46 km; start time is Saturday at 08:00; the event is described as a full-day experience in the area. There is a cut-off time for the longest distance (The Long Run) — you must be at the turnaround point by 11:45 (3 hours and 45 minutes after start) to be allowed to go out for a second lap. Organizers recommend trail running shoes and a mobile phone; no special equipment is required, but the bib must be clearly visible.

name: Kalmar Backyard Ultra
description: Kalmar Backyard Ultra is a Backyard Ultra race organized by Högby IF and held on a loop in Stensö/First Camp Stensö in Kalmar. The race is run on a 6,706-meter-long loop with the first start at 10:00 AM and subsequent starts every full hour - each lap must be completed within one hour. Runners who do not finish a lap within an hour are forced to withdraw; those who continue are tied for first place after each lap, and the winner is the one who completes one more lap than the others. All levels are welcome, from those aiming to become ultrarunners to participants with lower ambitions.
course_highlights: 6,706-meter-long loop (per lap)
Start at 10:00 AM, then new start every full hour
Maximum of 1 hour per lap - 24 laps approximately equals 100 miles (161 km)
additional: Location: First Camp Stensö / Stensö jogging trail, Kalmar. Looping occurs on a 6,706 m loop; 12 laps ≈ 50 miles, 7 laps ≈ marathon distance. Next start every full hour - runners who do not complete a lap within an hour must withdraw. Volunteer registration is via WordPress (login required). The course is 6,706 meters long and runs on the Stensö jogging trail; during evening/night, the course switches to the illuminated trail. Energy and drinks are provided at the finish line between each start. Bibs are collected at the start/finish area at Stensö from 08:00. Accommodation is offered nearby with a discount (cabins/camping) and special discount codes.

name: Varvetmilen Sollentuna
organizer: Göteborgsvarvet i samarbete med Turebergs Friidrottsklubb
description: Varvetmilen Sollentuna is a 10 km qualifying race taking place on April 18, 2026, in Sollentuna. The race automatically qualifies you for a better starting group in Göteborgsvarvet 2026 based on your time. The start is at 11:00 and runs from Strandvägen (65) to the finish at Sollentunavallen; the course passes through central Sollentuna along Sköldvägen and Sollentunavägen, with a water station at 5 km and a finish along the water. There is also a mini race for children, bib number pickup, and baggage drop-off on race day. The organizers are Göteborgsvarvet in collaboration with Turebergs Friidrottsklubb.
course_highlights: 10 km course in central Sollentuna
water station at 5 km
qualifying race for Göteborgsvarvet 2026
additional: Start at 11:00; start area at Strandvägen 65; finish at Sollentunavallen; bib number pickup and baggage drop-off; mini race for children; qualifying rules for Göteborgsvarvet The results of Varvetmilen Sollentuna 2026 are used for seeding in Göteborgsvarvet 2026. The mini race is held simultaneously (210 m for ages 0–6) with on-site registration for 80 SEK (Swish); bib distribution and baggage drop-off take place at Sollentunavallen.

name: Rock The Trail
description: RockTheTrail is a family-friendly trail run organized by Ultra Uppsala with courses through varied terrain in Hågadalen/Nåsten. The race offers shorter and longer distances for different levels - from a children's course to a new 45 km classic - aiming to be both challenging and fun to run. The starting location is indicated as OK Linné (Tallbacksvägen 68) and the organizer welcomes runners to register via Ultra Uppsala's pages.
course_highlights: Course through Hågadalen/Nåsten with varied trail terrain
Start at OK Linné (Tallbacksvägen 68)
New 45 km challenge in addition to 7.5 km, 15 km, and children's course (~1 - 1.5 km)
additional: Date is set for Saturday, April 18. Distances: 7.5 km, 15 km, new 45 km, and children's distance approx. 1 - 1.5 km. Organizer: Ultra Uppsala. Registration and invitation links are available from the Rock The Trail pages to Ultra Uppsala's event page. GPX link, UL bus 100 to Björklinge, toilets at start/finish, hamburgers and drinks after finishing, parking at Ärentuna IP.

name: Krogsereds Trail Run
description: Krogsereds Trailrun is organized by Krogsereds IK and is presented as a recreational event with the slogan "Motion on your terms." On the club's website, it is stated that the race is part of this year's Tour de Falkenberg. The site is informative and welcoming from the organizer's perspective, with links to contact information and social media channels.
course_highlights: Scenic course around Lyngsjön with forest trails and coastal views
Multiple distances for the whole family: 400 m, 2,500 m, 5.6 km, and 10 km
Clear logistics: registration via Google Docs, Swish payment, and start times on Saturday
additional: Organizer: Krogsereds IK. The race is presented as the first event in Tour de Falkenberg. The website's meta-texts include the phrase “Till anmälan” followed by a YouTube link; the page also refers to the club's Facebook channel. The club mentions roller ski training on Wednesdays at Ätrans IP at 19:00 (club activities on the page). No shower facilities available. Swish number: 123-6408447. Start times: Children 10:00, Youth 10:10, Junior 10:30, Recreational 10:30, Main class 10:30. Registration via Google Docs; registration and payment via Swish.

name: Pop up Run Kinnekulle

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Pris: 350 kr, lunch på Hellekis Kök & Trädgårdscafé ingår.

description: Pop up Run Kinnekulle is a guided trail run organized by Trailrunning Sweden that takes you out into the spring greenery of Kinnekulle. The race is 13 - 15 km long, divided into 2 - 3 pace groups, and suitable for runners who want to experience nature, trails, and beautiful views together with others. After the run, a locally produced ramson soup is served at Hellekis Kök & Trädgårdscafé. The event is marketed as a weekend activity with the possibility of carpooling and a communal lunch.
course_highlights: Spring trails lined with ramsons and bird song
Passage by the stone quarry with a view of Vänern
Trail run of 13 - 15 km in 2 - 3 pace groups
additional: Gathering at 10:00 at Hellekis Kök & Trädgårdscafé. Lunch (locally produced ramson soup) is included in the registration fee. Carpooling is recommended; the organizer can assist in coordinating rides. Distance 13 - 15 km, 2 - 3 pace groups; carpooling recommended; lunch included (ramson soup) after the run at Hellekis Kök & Trädgårdscafé.

name: Vårruset (Stockholm)
location: Norra Djurgården, Stockholm Municipality, Stockholm County, Sweden
description: Vårruset in Stockholm is an evening race for women held in Norra Djurgården. The race offers distances of 2.5 km or 5 km (the 5 km course is measured) and is aimed at both recreational runners and teams who want to participate together. In addition to running, registration includes a bib number, medal, and a finish bag; teams of five people are also offered a picnic after crossing the finish line. It is a lighthearted and social event as part of Sweden's largest fitness tour for women.
course_highlights: Measured 5 km course
The race takes place in Norra Djurgården - green, natural environment
Nearest subway station: Universitetet (follow the signs)
additional: Registration is done digitally and closes on race day, no later than 1 hour before the first start. Timing is included for those who choose it during registration (can be opted out), along with a medal, finish bag, and bib number; team registration also includes a picnic after the finish line (team of five people). Recommended age: 13 years and older for the 5 km (11 years with adult supervision), 11 years and older for the 2.5 km (7 years with adult supervision). There is also a separate Vårruset Digital where medals are sent home and the race can be completed between May 4 and June 4. Bib distribution: participants registered before May 1 will receive their bib by mail to the provided address. The date for Vårruset in Stockholm is scheduled within the Vårruset collaboration route during spring/summer 2026. More information can be found on the official website and your city page.

name: Blodomloppet Kristianstad
price_range: 5 & 10 km – 350 kr t.o.m. 28 april; Efteranmälan: 400 kr fr.o.m. 29 april; Lag: 1 750 kr t.o.m. 28 april, därefter 2 000 kr; Lilla Blodomloppet – 100 kr t.o.m. 18 maj; Efteranmälan Lilla Blodomloppet: 130 kr fr.o.m. 19 maj.
description: Blood Run Kristianstad is a welcoming fitness race held in Tivoliparken, offering both 5 km and 10 km distances, as well as the Little Blood Run for children. The courses partly go through the scenic Vattenriket and vary in terrain between grass, gravel, and asphalt. The event is suitable for both individual participants and teams (up to 5 people) and combines exercise with the purpose of raising awareness for blood donation. The event has a family-friendly character with a picnic tradition after the race.
course_highlights: Scenic course through Vattenriket
Terrain varies between grass, gravel, and asphalt
Little Blood Run (100 - 1100 m) takes place inside Tivoliparken for children aged 0 - 12
additional: Registration is done individually or in teams (max 5 participants). The last day to register a team is May 12. The final regular registration day (individual) for all runs is May 19; late registration at Tivoliparken on May 19 from 16:00. Storage is available; bags can be left at your own risk. Start and finish near the main stage in Tivoliparken.

name: Blodomloppet
price_range: Individuell 5 & 10 km: 350 kr till 29 april, 400 kr till 19 maj, 450 kr tävlingsdagen; Laganmälan 5 personer: 1750 kr till 29 april, 2000 kr till 13 maj; Lilla Blodomloppet: 100 kr till 9 maj, 120 kr till 20 maj; blodgivare/ICA-medlemmar rabatt 40 kr per person.
description: Welcome to the Blood Race in Karlskrona - an open fitness race for everyone where you can walk, jog, or run to raise awareness for the vital blood donation. We offer short and accessible courses suitable for competitive runners, casual walkers, and children. The courses are measured and verified by officials from the Swedish Athletics Federation, and the event has a strong social element with team registrations and a picnic afterwards. The event is organized locally by a sports club in collaboration with blood centers and welcomes both individual participants and teams.
course_highlights: Measured/verified race courses of 5 km and 10 km (verified by the Swedish Athletics Federation)
Separate 5 km walking lane so that walkers can start earlier for a joint picnic afterwards
Children's race of about 800 meters for the youngest participants
additional: Teams can consist of a maximum of 5 participants, and team members can participate in different distances. For larger registrations, an Excel template is available for import into the registration system and an option for a customer page for companies/organizations. Blood donors and ICA members receive a 40 SEK discount per person. Contact for the Blood Race in Karlskrona: KA 2 IF, email karlskrona@blodomloppet.se, phone 0793-299924. Short course of 800 m; start times and warm-up details will be announced later; registration is via the website; start package with a shirt, bib, and medal will be delivered approximately two weeks after registration completion; the distance race runs from May 17 to September 7; Excel template for larger registrations and options for corporate customer pages and discount codes; contact: karlskrona@blodomloppet.se.

name: Sandbäckens Norrköpingsstafetten
price_range: Gratis för barn/ungdomar och kommunanställda; övriga deltagare: prisuppgift inte angiven
description: Sandbäckens Norrköpingsstafetten is a team relay race in Folkparken where four people form a team and take turns running or jogging a lively four-kilometer stretch. The race is suitable for both recreational runners and competitive runners and has a social, team-oriented character. Children and youth participate for free thanks to HSB. The organizer also offers rental solutions for tents and event equipment via Rent a Tent for those who want to set up on the race area.
course_highlights: Four-kilometer stretch in Folkparken (each team member runs a segment)
Relay for teams of four - take turns jogging or running
Children and youth participate for free thanks to HSB
additional: Team of four people; each segment is approximately 4 km in Folkparken; children and youth participate for free thanks to HSB; Rent a Tent offers tents and event products with the last booking date for guaranteed access on May 5 (contact: norrkoping@rentatent.se). Medal after finish; picnic bag from ICA Kvantum Mirum Galleria; small open environment; possibility to rent tents via Rent a Tent (booking by May 5); Fiskeby has been main partner since 2018 and Toyota Askling Bil is the event's car partner.

name: Stafettvarvet
description: The Relay Race is a cheerful relay event for teams of four running the same 3.2 km course around Slottsskogen, with start, exchange, and finish inside the historic Slottsskogsvallen. The event offers a lively atmosphere before, during, and after the race, and each team receives a picnic bag included in the registration. The race is also a popular corporate event with the option to book a tent spot in the corporate village and pay via invoice when registering the team. The organizer's website states that the date for this year's event is May 20, 2026.
course_highlights: 3.2 km fast course around beautiful Slottsskogen
Start, exchange, and finish inside Slottsskogsvallen
The course runs through Slottsskogen and back into the entrance park at Slottsskogsvallen
additional: Each team consists of four participants; relay baton, bib, and picnic bag are to be picked up outside Slottsskogsvallen in the entrance park. Registration is done via the website and is open until 5:00 PM on race day (subject to the race selling out earlier). Companies can register multiple teams (not individual runners), pay by invoice, and book tent packages in the corporate village. The race is part of Varvetveckan and encourages team spirit and activity; age is recommended over 15 years; possibility to book corporate villages/tents; first race start time: 18:00; finish at Slottsskogsvallen.

name: Vårruset
description: Vårruset in Västerås is part of Sweden's largest fitness tour for women and invites you to an evening in spring with a 2.5 km route or a certified 5 km course. The start and finish are at Lögastrand, and the race runs through central Västerås. All participants receive a bib, a finish bag, and a medal; groups that register together are offered a picnic after the finish. The event is open to runners, joggers, and walkers, welcoming both experienced and new participants.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Lögastrand
The course runs through central Västerås
The 5 km course is certified (optional timing)
additional: Included in the registration: medal, finish bag, Vårruset music quiz + prizes, bib, and timing for those who choose it (timing can be opted out, and results will not be published); team registration (5 persons) includes a picnic after the finish; recommended age for 5 km: from 13 years (11 years with adult supervision), 2.5 km: from 11 years (7 years with adult supervision); registration can be made until race day, at least 1 hour before the first start; training session offered before the race (for example, March 19 at 18:30 at Intersport Erikslund according to local information). DISTANCES: 2.5 or 5 km; team registration for five persons with a picnic after the finish; individual registration includes a medal, finish bag, Vårruset music quiz + prizes, timing on 5 km (optional), and bib.

name: Blodomloppet Linköping
organizer: IK Akele och Blodtappen i Östergötland
price_range: Rabatt 40 kr per person för blodgivare; full pris ej angivet
description: Welcome to the Blood Race in Linköping - a fun run aimed at raising awareness about the need for blood donation. The race offers distances of 5 km and 10 km as well as the Little Blood Race and welcomes walkers, joggers, and runners in both women's and men's categories. Many participants join in teams of five people, and the event traditionally concludes with a large communal picnic. Registration can be done individually or in teams, and several practical instructions (bib numbers, late registration, public transport tickets, etc.) are available on the information page.
course_highlights: Offers 5 km and 10 km distances as well as the Little Blood Race (women's/men's categories)
Road race - separate course maps for 5K and 10K are attached
The event traditionally ends with a communal picnic
additional: Registration can be done individually or in teams (3 - 5 persons); always pay for five people in a team, and it is possible to complete a full team by April 30th without additional cost by emailing linkoping@blodomloppet.se. Blood donors receive a 40 SEK discount per person. All participants registering by May 14th and providing a mobile number will receive an SMS link for an Östgötatrafiken ticket valid for 6 hours on May 21st. Bib number distribution and late registration options are available on specific dates and locations (e.g., GeBlod and Saab Arena; times and days are listed on the info page). For large registrations, an Excel template for import and options for customer pages/discount codes are available - contact linkoping@blodomloppet.se for corporate solutions. Registration occurs in three steps; teams can consist of 3 - 5 persons; the last day for team registration is May 14th; start/timing classes and information about bibs and changes are included in the PM; training evenings before the race are offered free of charge; approximately 12,300 pre-registered participants are mentioned in the material.

name: Stallbackamilen 2026
organizer: Trollhättans IF Friidrott och Vänersborgs AIK
description: Welcome to the premiere of Stallbackamilen in Trollhättan on April 21, 2026. The race is designed for you to run fast over 10 km, and the course is measured. The course runs on fast bike paths around Stallbacka and consists of a 3.3 km loop that is run three times. Start and finish are at the tennis hall, and the event is organized by Vänersborgs AIK together with Trollhättans IF Friidrott.
course_highlights: Measured 10 km (3.3 km loop x3)
Runs on fast bike paths around Stallbacka
Start and finish at the tennis hall; pacers 35 - 60 min
additional: Gathering at 17:00 at Bäckelyckepark. Registration is done via RaceID and can be completed up to thirty minutes before the start; no late registration fee. Bibs can be collected near the start and finish. A test run is organized on March 25, 2026 at 18:00 (gathering at the tennis hall). Opportunity to register simultaneously for Digitala Varvetmilen for seeding to Göteborgsvarvet. Gathering at 17:00 at Bäckelyckepark; start at Kardanvägen 2, 461 38 Trollhättan; start time 18:00 - 20:00; bibs are collected at the start and finish.

name: Kolmården Vertical
location: Hults Bruk gamla fotbollsplan, Kolmården, Sweden
price_range: 100 kr (till 19 april); 150 kr (efteranmälan/vid tävlingsdagen); försäkring 155 kr; startklar paket 275 kr

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 100 kr per deltagare fram till den 19 april.

description: Kolmården Vertical is a short but steep trail run: 5 km with approximately 300 meters of elevation gain, held on April 22, 2026. The course consists of beautiful trails and technical sections on singletrack where strong legs and quick feet are rewarded. You will pass, among other things, Koklämman, Jakob's Cave, and enjoy views over Ågelsjön. The start is at the old football field at Hults Bruk, and the organizer welcomes both experienced trail runners and strong beginners who enjoy challenging terrain.
course_highlights: 5 km with approximately 300 meters of elevation gain - short but very hilly
Nice singletracks and technical sections, including 'Koklämman' (Timtomaras staircase) with a rope
View over Ågelsjön and passage at Jakob's Cave/Grill area
additional: The start is at the old football field at Hults Bruk (the football field is about 200 meters from the parking lot). Prizes are awarded to the top three in each class, and there are raffle prizes. Cancellation and accident insurance are offered for 155 SEK or a variant that also covers training for 275 SEK. Late registration is available from April 20 and on race day on site for 150 SEK. Early and late registration options, as well as separate insurance and race-ready packages as add-ons.

name: Varvetmilen Göteborg
description: Varvetmilen Gothenburg is a qualifying 10 km race that gives participants the opportunity to be seeded into a better starting group at Göteborgsvarvet 2026. The start is at the entrance park of Slottsskogsvallen, and the course passes through central Gothenburg, passing iconic locations in the city. The registration fee is 349 SEK until January 31 and 449 SEK from February 1. There is also a Digital Varvetmilen, a digital qualifying race held from April 18 to 26, allowing participants worldwide to compete and be seeded for Göteborgsvarvet 2026.
course_highlights: 10 km course starting and finishing at the entrance park of Slottsskogsvallen
Qualifying result for seedings at Göteborgsvarvet 2026
Opportunity to participate digitally via Digitala Varvetmilen (April 18 - 26) for international participants
additional: 10 km course starting at the entrance park of Slottsskogsvallen; water station at 5 km; seeding rules mean that the result automatically qualifies for a better start group at Göteborgsvarvet 2026; registration via the website; start confirmation sent via email; bib number pickup according to schedule at Friidrottens Hus and Stadium Run Nordstan. The Varvetmilen starts at the entrance park of Slottsskogsvallen and has seeding rules that automatically assign a better start group at Göteborgsvarvet 2026. The start times are between 11:00 and 11:20, and the start confirmation with detailed start group information is delivered approximately two weeks before the race; a mini race for children (210 m) can be registered on-site for 80 SEK (Swish).

name: Skrylleloppet
location: Skryllegården, Södra Sandby, Lund Municipality, Sweden
description: Björnstorps IF invites you to the 54th Skrylle Race on April 25, 2026. The races are offered in 3, 5, and 10 km, with a new recreational class for men and women at 3 km. The courses run on Skryllegården's exercise trails through varied forest terrain and have gravel surfaces. Here is practical information about registration, bib numbers, parking, and race day.
course_highlights: 3, 5 and 10 km on Skryllegården's loop courses
Varied forest terrain with recreational trails
Surface: gravel
additional: Online registration is available until 30 minutes before the start; Early bird until February 22, regular until April 19, and late registration until April 25. On race day, registration is possible on-site with the option to change name or category for a fee of 100 SEK; only Swish payments are accepted on-site. Bib numbers are sent via email during race week and can also be collected at Löplabbet in Lund on the Friday before the race from 10 am to 6 pm (20% discount at pickup). Results for the 10 km can be used for seeding in the TCS Lidingöloppet. Participants cycling to the event can register this at bib pickup for a chance to win prizes. Online registration is open until the start; Early Bird prices until February 22, regular until April 19, and late registration until race start. On race day, registration is available on-site with Swish payment. Bib numbers are sent via email or can be picked up at Löplabbet in Lund. There is baggage check.

name: Skälbyloppet
location: Skälby loge, Kalmar kommun, Kalmar län, Sweden
description: Skälbyloppet is a family-friendly recreational race in Kalmar organized by Högby IF on April 25, 2026. The race offers two main distances, 4 km and 8 km (1 and 2 laps over the bridge), as well as youth categories from 600 meters to approximately 1.9 km. The course runs through the Skälby environment with gravel and park paths, as well as a short asphalt section, and fluids are available at the turnaround and finish. Medals are awarded to all finishers, and registration is conducted according to the schedule provided by the organizer.
course_highlights: 4 km and 8 km courses (1 and 2 laps over the bridge)
Youth distances from 600 m to 1.9 km
Easy-to-run gravel and forest paths with a short asphalt section
additional: Fluids are available at the turnaround on the long course and at the finish. Bib numbers are collected at Skälby lodge; start times are according to the schedule, and late registration is possible as per the organizer. The routes for 4 km and 8 km are standard (1 and 2 laps over the bridge). Presence on site is required for certain volunteer registrations according to RF standards. Bib numbers can be picked up at Skälby lodge on Friday, April 24, from 15:00 to 17:00, and on race day from 08:30; late registration is accepted at bib pickup no later than 1 hour before the start. Fluids are available at the turnaround on the long course and at the finish; medals are awarded to all who complete the race.

name: Billingen Trail
description:
We invite you to running experiences at Billingen. This year, the start and finish will be at the Stadium in Billingens recreational area.
The long course is just over 47 km with approximately 930 meters of elevation gain. It takes you around the northern part of Billingen with beautiful trails along the mountain edge. As a runner, you will experience a varied terrain such as deciduous forest, mountain ravines, meadows, coniferous forest, and in several places, stunning views of the landscape. The surface varies from easy to run on, with about 6 km of asphalt and some more demanding sections.

The medium course, 21 km, runs on the northern part of Billingeleden and reaches about 500 meters above sea level. This course goes on mixed trails, meadowland, and roads.

Our shortest distance, 12 km, measures just over 200 meters of elevation gain and runs on trails of varying difficulty and shorter sections of road.

Information about courses and markings may change.

Start:

47 km, at 10:00 at the Stadium, Billingens Fritidsområde Skövde.
21 km, at 10:45 at Björnasäter, Lerdala. Buses depart from Billingens Fritidsområde at 10:05.
12 km, at 11:30 at the Stadium, Billingens Fritidsområde Skövde.

Finish:

At the Stadium, Billingens Fritidsområde Skövde.
All finish lines are at the stadium.
course_highlights: 47 km across the entire northern Billingen - just over 47 km and approximately 930 meters of elevation gain
Varied terrain: deciduous forest, mountain ravines, meadowland, coniferous forest, and sections with asphalt (about 6 km)
12 km follows Blue Trollstigen (just over 200 hm); 21 km runs on the northern Billingeleden (about 500 hm) and participants are bused from the stadium
additional: Start/finish for the 47 km at Billingens fritidsområde (Stadium). 21 km starts in Björnasäter, Lerdala (about 12 km from the stadium) and participants are bused out - the bus is included in the registration fee and departs from the southern end of the stadium (visible from the secretariat and finish line), around 10:05 after the 47 km start. Course markings: orange pennants and arrows as well as Billingeleden's orange marking ("B") for 47/21 km; 12 km follows Trollstigen's blue markings. The surface varies from easy to more technical sections; there are also shorter asphalt sections (~6 km). Videos and photos from previous years are linked on the page. Start times: 47 km at 10:00; 21 km at 10:45; 12 km at 11:30. Bus to the start for 21 km around 10:05. Parking is available at the large parking lot; changing/shower facilities at Billingecentret.

name: adidas Premiärhalvan
description: Adidas Premiärhalvan is a half marathon of 21.1 km held in Stockholm on April 25, 2026. The race starts at 11:00 AM and has a maximum time of three hours, with start and finish areas at Biskopsudden. The course runs around Southern Djurgården and passes through scenic natural areas near central Stockholm. The event is organized by Marathongruppen and is seen as a good preparation for the adidas Stockholm Marathon, while also welcoming all who want to experience springtime in a beautiful city environment. Registration is available at different price levels (495-745 SEK), and bib and start information are shared in advance; water stations and medical personnel are available along the course.
course_highlights: The course runs around Southern Djurgården with start and finish at Biskopsudden
Beautiful spring environment and scenic views near central Stockholm
Mixed surface with asphalt, gravel, and cobblestones along the course
additional: The race is a preparation for the adidas Stockholm Marathon and includes bib distribution in advance as well as start information. Water stations and medical personnel are available along the course. The maximum time is 3 hours and the age limit is 17 years. The deadline for reporting results for seeding is March 31. The course is a single lap of 21.1 km around Southern Djurgården (asphalt/gravel/cobblestones) and sports drinks from Enervit are offered along the course.

name: Bålsta Stadslopp
description: Welcome to Bålsta City Race, held on April 26, 2026 at Gröna Dalens IP in Bålsta. The race is known as a fast, spectator-friendly course where many have set personal bests - the course is organized by Bålsta IK and has grown every year since its start in 2019. The competition offers the Sparbanksloppet 5 km (possible one lap) and 10 km (two laps) with the finish inside the Gröna Dalens athletics track. The organizer emphasizes speed, joy, and a friendly event atmosphere for both elite and recreational runners.
course_highlights: 5 km loop that can be run once or twice (resulting in 5 km or 10 km total)
Approximately 99% asphalt; finish inside the athletics track at Gröna Dalens IP
Known as a fast course where many have achieved personal records and several course records are documented
additional: Number bib distribution takes place inside Gröna Dalens IP from 08:00. Late registration can be done digitally subject to availability until 1 hour before each start on race day. Start and finish are located at Gröna Dalens sports field (Badhusvägen); commuter train (line 43) to Bålsta station is about 850 meters walk from the venue. There are several parking options within 100 - 900 meters; Badhusvägen will be closed during the race day. There is clothing drop-off (instructions to attach the lower part of the bib to the bag), limited changing/shower facilities, and toilets near the venue. Sports drinks (Umara) and water are available at the turn-around for the 5 km race. A team competition for the 5 km (Sparbanksloppet) is introduced; the course is described as fast and PB-friendly.

name: Landsjön runt
price_range: 12,5 km: 250-350 kr; 5,5 km: 150-250 kr; Vista FUN RUN: gratis eller 100 kr efter sista anmälningsdatum

description: Landsjön Runt is a road race in a scenic environment by Landsjön in Kaxholmen outside Huskvarna. We offer a family day with races for all ages - 12.5 km and 5.5 km for adults/youths as well as several children's classes including Vista FUN RUN. The race goes around the lake with start and finish at Vistavallen, and musicians and water stations along the course contribute to the atmosphere. The event encourages both individual registration and team competitions for four participants.
course_highlights: Road race in a scenic environment around Landsjön, start/finish at Vistavallen
Distances 12.5 km and 5.5 km along the lake; the course is run clockwise so the climbs come early
Music along the course and water stations for participants
additional: Parking at Vistavallen is available (recommendation to use public transport or park at Hunnerydsbadet); team competitions consist of four people all running the same distance and total time is recorded, teams receive a bag from Rudenstams Gårdsbutik; in case of a course record on 12.5 km, 5,000 SEK is awarded to the runner's club; payment is made via Swish to 123 429 98 22 and no automatic confirmation is sent - you are registered if you receive a six-digit number and have paid; IK Vista members participate free if registering by April 20 (the website also mentions April 19); registration closes on April 25 at 17:00 but registration on race day can be done at least one hour before if space permits. Registration closes April 25 at 17:00. Payment is via Swish. IK Vista members participate free if registering by April 20; specify IK Vista as club and do not pay. The start list is published one week before the race. The race includes water stations and music along the course; team registration is possible with combined finish/result.

name: Tolvanloppet
description: Tolvanloppet is a historic race for all ages, with a children's race in the morning and an adult race at 12:30 PM. There are two classes to choose from, 6 and 12 kilometers, with or without timing. The course is as beautiful as it is challenging (it's not completely flat...), starting and finishing on Ålstensgatan, which offers perhaps the most magnificent starting line in the race world. In between, runners will pass through Bromma's streets, feeling as if they are running through gardens in apple blossom. This experience is enhanced by many neighbors coming out to cheer or even setting up small water stations or sprinklers—each refreshing in their own way. Among other things, this has given rise to the race's slogan: Stockholm's most charming running race.
course_highlights: 12.0 km control-measured asphalt course shaped like an eight (one lap), also 6 km and several children's classes
Steep inclines, especially two hills on Grönviksvägen; beautiful view of Lake Mälaren from Grönviksvägen
Four water stations along the course (water/sports drink/cola and bananas depending on the station)
additional: Timing is done with a chip on the bib (Racetimer). The start is on Ålstensgatan, with the first 600 meters downhill on Ålstensgatan. There is a Stadium Active Zone at Ålstens Schoolyard with a bouncy castle, climbing wall, etc. Minimum age is 14 years (runners 16+ preferred); wheelchairs are not accepted and runners with strollers need special permission. Group registration (10+ runners) offers a discount—contact johan@tolvanloppet.se. Water stations are available (4); start/finish area on Ålstensgatan; the 12 km race has been a loop since 2008; HalvTolvan approximately 6 km; registration: last regular registration day 15/5; late registration until 22/5; on-site registration up to 45 minutes before the race; bib distribution on 23/5 from 08:00 to 12:00 in Ålstens School cafeteria; start confirmation sent via email; public transportation recommended (Tolvan tram via Nockebybanan); medical services available at the finish area.

name: Hörby Marknadslopp
description:
Frosta OK is organizing the 53rd evening race during Hörby Market with three different distances:

Market Race 12.6 km: competition class starts at 18:30, recreational class starts at 18:40

Bil-Månsson Race 6.1 km: all start at 18:50.

CAN-CAN Race 3.4 km: all start at 19:00.

The race starts and ends within Hörby town center, with large parts run in forest environment.
Varied terrain: asphalt, gravel roads, trails. See maps.

Don’t miss this opportunity!
course_highlights: Three distances: 12.6 km, 6.1 km, and CAN-CAN 3.4 km
Start at Lågehallarna and finish at Folkets Hus in Hörby
Electronic chip timing and sanctioned by the Swedish Athletics Association
additional:
Register at www.marknadsloppet.nu - up until the race begins.

Late registration can be done at the entrance of Lågehallarna (Byggmästaregatan 4) after 16:00 on race day.

Parking for runners at Lågehallarna from 16:00.
Directions from Riksväg 13. 55.8552, 13.6528

All information regarding preparations, registration, course, and directions can be found at: 
https://marknadsloppet.nu/information/

Karta över Hörby Marknadslopp med tre olika distanser markerade
Karta över Hörby Marknadslopps banor med distanser 12,6 km, 6,1 km och 3,4 km.

name: Saucony Djurgårdsvarvet 10K
description: Saucony Djurgårdsvarvet is this year's most generous race, where running joy meets beautiful nature in Djurgården. With a course that winds along gravel and asphalt roads, the race offers a delightful mix of challenge and enjoyment. The first 600 registered participants will receive a specially designed shirt, and after crossing the finish line, there will be a relaxing After Run with grilling and non-alcoholic drinks from Bryggmästaren. Additionally, part of the registration fee goes to Sweden for UNHCR, making every step meaningful – both for you and someone in need.
course_highlights: A lap on scenic trails and asphalt roads on the northern and southern sides of Djurgården
The course is measured (10 km)
Views and terrain typical for Djurgården - a mix of natural trails and asphalt
additional: Clothing drop-off at the start and finish area at Djurgårdsbrunnsbron (the organizer is not responsible for valuables). A unique race shirt can be purchased during registration - order before 1/8 2026 to receive the shirt; it will be picked up together with the bib number. Pacers are available for sub60, sub50, sub45, and sub40. After the race: all runners are invited to a barbecue after crossing the finish line. Strollers and dogs are not allowed this year. Registration management (e.g., transfer) is handled via Raceid. Charity component; post-race hangout; exclusive race shirt; pre-race preparation program mentioned (Uhrbom's program).

name: Varberg Halvmarathon
description:
FK Friskus-Varberg invites you to a running race on Saturday, October 18, starting and finishing at Friskusstugan.

Along the course, you pass through large parts of Varberg. You run along the beach in Apelviken and up on Hästhagaberget with a magnificent view of the sea. The course also goes through several parks and city forests, including the beautiful Påskbergsskogen and Brunnbergsskogen. In addition to the half marathon, there is also a course of 11.5 km.

All info and registration: https://varberghalvmarathon.se
course_highlights: Running along the beach in Apelviken
Up on Hästhagaberget with a magnificent view of the sea
The course goes through several parks and city forests, including Påskbergsskogen and Brunnbergsskogen
additional: Start and finish at Friskusstugan (Träslövsvägen 142B). Late registration possible at the competition center until 45 minutes before the start for an increased fee. Bicycle parking at Friskusstugan; no car parking at Friskusstugan - free car parking is available at Varbergs Hospital approximately 600 meters from the competition center (check local parking regulations). Photos of participants may be published. Registration deadline: no later than Sunday, October 11; late registration: until 45 minutes before the start for an increased fee.

tiers.description: Gratis för alla barn att anmäla sig till Jumpyard Lilla Nyårsloppet.

description:
For the 43rd time, Vallentuna Athletics invites everyone from elite athletes to cheerful recreational runners and children to participate in a winter race on our streets and squares in central Vallentuna. Participants and spectators can expect challenging ice, slush, wonderful winter crispness, or a fast asphalt course.
The New Year's Race is a pleasant occasion to be active before the New Year's feast and to reflect on the year. As some say, "What you do on New Year's Eve, you do the rest of the year!" So take the opportunity to be active, bring a friend, and run or jog around the course.
course_highlights: Course through Himmelstalund area with a section in Folkparken
Measured 5 km and 10 km with clear markings and km signs
Start, finish, and lap at the parking lot outside Stadium Arena
additional: Warm-up on stage at 10:45. Bib number pickup at Mio Norrköping on Tuesday, December 30 from 14:00 to 18:00, and remaining bibs will be handed out at the start area no later than 30 minutes before the start; late registration is accepted on site (cashless via Swish). Bib pickup is indoors in the foyer of Stadium Arena; the top flap of the bib contains the chip. Drinks are available at the start/finish and at the lap point for the 10 km race. Toilets are available inside Stadium Arena, baggage and outerwear can be deposited, timing is managed by Racetimer, and results will be published via a link on the race website. The race starts at 11:00; registration via RaceID; late registration fee is 345 SEK; bib collection on December 30 from 14:00 to 18:00 at Mio Norrköping or at the start on December 31; chip in the upper flap of the bib; medals for all participants; baggage and outerwear deposit; post-race snacks (ICA Maxi Norrköping).

name: Å-Varvet
description: The Å-varvet in Eskilstuna is an urban quarter marathon offered in two distances: 5 km and 10 km, with start and finish in the city park in central Eskilstuna. The race is organized by Eskilstuna Municipality in collaboration with Eskilstuna Athletics and includes Knatteknatet for children on the same day. The event is promoted as Sweden's most beautiful quarter marathon and follows a course of approximately 10,549 meters through the city environment. Official information can be found at avarvet.se and in Visit Eskilstuna's event calendar, and the event is also on Facebook.
course_highlights: Urban course through central Eskilstuna
Start and finish in Eskilstuna city park
Knatteknatet for children on the same day
additional: 5 km and 10 km distances; start and finish in the city park; Knatteknatet for children on the same day; course approximately 10,549 meters; promoted as Sweden's most beautiful quarter marathon

name: Tolvanloppet
description: Tolvanloppet is a charming street race in Bromma, starting and finishing on Ålstensgatan. You can choose between a certified 12 km race course and an easier 6 km for recreational runners, as well as several children's categories from 150 m up to 6 km. The course is challenging with several steep climbs and strong spectator support along the way, and the event is organized by Bromma IF to benefit children's and youth activities. At the start/finish, festival atmosphere awaits with Stadium Active Zone, music, and activities for families.
course_highlights: Certified 12.0 km (asphalt) shaped like an eight with finish at the start
Steep climbs, especially the two hills on Grönviksvägen (the last quarter)
Four water stations along the course; sports drink at Ålstensgatan/Grönviksvägen
additional: Start and finish on Ålstensgatan; the first 600 m run straight down Ålstensgatan. Timing with data chip on bib (Racetimer). Minimum age 14 years (runners 16+ recommended); wheelchairs cannot be accepted; runners with strollers require special permission (contact johan@tolvanloppet.se). Bib distribution and start number information sent via email; group registration for 10+ runners available with discount (contact johan@tolvanloppet.se). Stadium Active Zone at Ålstens Schoolyard with activities for families. Four water stations; timing by Racetimer; bib distribution 08:00 - 12:00 on race day; start/finish area on Ålstensgatan; parking very limited; medal for all finishers; new course debate 2026 according to race information; directions via tram (Nockebybanan) to Ålstensgatan.

name: Ludvika stadslopp
description: Ludvika City Run is an urban running event with start and finish at Charlie Norman's Square in Ludvika. The day offers races for children and youth as well as 5 km and 10 km for adults, where participants can choose to run with or without timing. There are special children's races - the Toddler Race for ages 0-6 and the Little City Run for children up to 12 years old. For the 10 km race, there is an extra reward if the course record is broken.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Charlie Norman's Square in the center of Ludvika.
Children's races: Toddler Race (0-6 years) and Little City Run (up to 12 years).
5 km and 10 km with the option to participate with or without timing; breaking the 10 km course record offers extra prize money.
additional: Registration via the Google form (https://forms.gle/Q5BfNzbjmGGyDGy46). Start times: 11:00 Toddler Race (0-6 years), 11:30 Little City Run (up to 12 years), 13:00 5 km and 10 km. The 10 km course is presented as a route where course records and prize money may be awarded. According to Ludvika Municipality, food and coffee are offered on the event day; previous years' activities also included various community initiatives such as kettlebell walks via Ludvika Fundraising Foundation.

name: Luleå Stadsmara
description: Luleå City Marathon is one of Northern Sweden's largest and oldest running festivals, designed to suit both recreational runners and competitive athletes, as well as children. The event offers several races of different lengths - from toddler races to half marathons - and is characterized by a family-friendly festival atmosphere. Choose your distance and run along both nature trails and classic city routes in Luleå. Welcome to participate and experience the city's running festival!
course_highlights: New route for the Half Marathon along the water around Luleå city
Scaniamilen: classic 10 km to Storgatan and back
5 km course around the illuminated trail at Mjölkuddsberget (JIAB Scaffold Erection Race)
additional: The races mentioned and their start times: VR-Profile Toddler Race 800 m (starts at 10:00), MAX Race 3 km (starts at 10:30), JIAB Scaffold Erection Race 5 km (starts at 11:00), Renta Half Marathon 21 km (starts at 11:30), Scaniamilen 10 km (starts at 12:30). The event is described as suitable for all levels of ambition and as a folk festival; the Half Marathon has a new route along the water and the 5 km course runs around the illuminated trail at Mjölkuddsberget. Contact via StiL Sports Center reception: phone 0920 - 50 21 20. New start and finish area; new course routes; Corporate Challenge; Corporate Village; Food court; T-shirt and logo.

name: Uka Pain
description: Uka Pain is a series of trail races in Älvdalen with distances ranging from approximately 12 km up to 100 miles. Sweden Runners IF organizes the event, which in 2026 will also include the Trail Swedish Championships (SM/VSM) on 28 km and the Junior Swedish Championships (JSM) on 12 km. The races take place on marked trails with finish at Hotell Älvdalen and are designed to provide both challenge and experience in Dalarna. The event welcomes runners in several categories and offers services such as water stations, timing, and finisher medals.
course_highlights: Trail in varied forest and mountain terrain in Älvdalen
Finish at Hotell Älvdalen (race center)
Orange trail markings and orange Uka Pain bands on trees/markers
additional: Number bib, timing, energy and water stations, and finisher medals are included. Participant T-shirt is included if registered by 30/4-2026. Bus transport is offered for the 100 Miles (departure from Hotell Älvdalen around 15:10 to Boggberget). Number bib distribution at The Running Company on Friday 22/5; GPS trackers are issued to 100 km/100 miles participants. Mandatory equipment applies for 50 km, 100 km, and 100 miles. No late registrations on site. Race center and finish at Hotell Älvdalen; number bib can be picked up at The Running Company approximately 100 m from the hotel; distances include 12 km, 28 km, 52 km, 102 km, and 100 miles; drop bags allowed for 100 km and 100 miles; GPS trackers are used for 100 miles and 100 km; mandatory equipment applies for 50 - 100 km and 100 miles.

description: Welcome to Stadionloppet organized by Djurgårdens IF Friidrott with start, lap, and finish at Stockholm Stadion. The main race is 5 km on a two-lap course through the scenic surroundings of the Stadion, and there are also classes for children and youth. The race is chip-timed (the bib contains the chip) and is held on the same day as the cycling event Stadiongirot. For questions, contact info@stadionloppet.se.
course_highlights: Start, lap, and finish at Stockholm Stadion
5 km main race on a two-lap course around the scenic areas of the Stadion
Children's and youth classes with shorter distances (some races not timed)
additional: Registration via RaceID closes at 09:00 on race day; thereafter, registration is only possible on site. The chip is attached to the bib, and both net and gross times are used. Race confirmation can be collected on race day from 10:00 (show race confirmation via email/SMS or ID). Payment is accepted by card and Swish online; on race day, only Swish. Members of Djurgårdens IF Friidrott can register for free with a special code. All registered participants receive two football tickets (one for a men's match and one for a women's match). Medical personnel are on site.

name: Munkastigen Trailrun
description: Munkastigen Trailrun is organized by Laxå OK and will take place on Saturday, April 25, 2026, starting in Olshammar. On the race page, there are maps, elevation profile, and a GPX file available for download to plan your run. Invitations and registration links are published during the current year in the menu on the club's page. Welcome to participate and access course information before the race.
course_highlights: Start in Olshammar
Maps (Map Part 1 and Map Part 2) and elevation profile available
GPX file available for download (Munkastigen_trailrun.gpx, thanks Jonas Brännmyr)
additional: Invitations and registration links are published during the current year in the menu on the page. Course information includes Map Part 1 and Part 2 as well as elevation profile. GPX file (Munkastigen_trailrun.gpx) is available for download. The race runs from Olshammar on the shores of Vättern to Laxå in Tiveden. Teams consist of 2 - 5 runners with relay points at any location along the course. SI-pins are recommended or can be rented. Start and finish: start at 11:00 in Olshammar, finish at Laxå OK's clubhouse.

name: Utö Backyard
description: Utö Backyard is a backyard trail race on the beautiful Utö in the Stockholm archipelago that welcomes both social runners and competitive ultrarunners. You can run one lap, several laps, or as many as you can manage - in Backyard 3.3K, 15 laps are completed for a total of 49.5 km, and in Utö Backyard Extreme, a warm-up lap is followed by 7 laps of 6.4 km each. The rules are simple: each lap must be completed within the maximum time (30 minutes for 3.3K, 60 minutes for 6.4K), and the fastest on the last lap is declared the winner. The organizers encourage making the weekend a mini-weekend with accommodation at Utö Värdshus and socializing after the race.
course_highlights: Backyard 3.3K: 3.3 km hilly trail running along the northern part of the island (15 laps = 49.5 km)
Extreme 6.4K: 6.4 km technical trail around eastern and northern Utö with a mix of trail and gravel roads (1 warm-up lap + 7 laps)
Beautiful archipelago environment with varied terrain, elevation, and views over the island
additional: Start: Backyard 3.3K starts every 30 minutes (first start 10:30, last start 17:30). Extreme 6.4K starts every hour (same first start time). Award ceremony at 18:00 and food served at Utö Värdshus after the ceremony. Transportation: recommended by Vaxholmsbolaget's boat Silverpilen from Årsta Brygga (departing 09:20, arriving 10:00); last boat back departs at 19:50. Practical: bib number pickup at start/finish, limited indoor storage (bring a trash bag/cover), energy station at start/finish with drinks and snacks. Age rules/offers: youth up to 18 years old get 50% discount on 3.3K with code "UTÖUNGDOM2026"; 6.4K has an age limit of 18+. Accommodation discount of 25% at Utö Värdshus with code "UtöBackyard". Two distances: Utö Backyard 3.3K and Utö Backyard Extreme 6.4K; Backyard Ultra‑style format; full support with food, drinks, and energy; youth up to 18 years get 50% discount on 3.3K with code UTÖUNGDOM2026; age limit 18+ for 6.4K Extreme; start/finish at Utö Värdshus; accommodation options and transportation to Utö (Waxholmsbolaget) available; this year's edition is limited to approximately 250 participants (150 in 3.3K and 100 in 6.4K).

description: Lidingöloppet Spring Mile is a spring race of 5 and 10 kilometers with start and finish at Lidingövallen. The course is called one of Stockholm's most beautiful mile routes and runs through winding forest roads, meadows, and along the archipelago coast, mostly on soft trails and sometimes hilly. The race serves as a qualifying event for TCS Lidingöloppet and is suitable for those wanting to check their fitness or secure a better starting group. Before and after the race, coffee and light food are available for purchase at the café at Lidingövallen.
course_highlights: Winding forest roads past meadows and along the archipelago coast
Mostly soft trails; hilly (10 km 127 m elevation, 5 km 52 m elevation)
Water station at 5 km and at the finish; course marked with red/white ribbons and km flags
additional: Number bib distribution from 09:30 on race day until 30 minutes before start. Late registration is available at Lidingövallen from 09:30 and no later than 60 minutes before start. Name and class changes can be made via Mina sidor for a fee (details and fees are on the website) or on-site for a higher fee. Free baggage drop-off is available; baggage storage costs 20 SEK (Swish 1235557608). Parking near Lidingövallen is limited (fee 40 SEK via Swish 1234575775); the organizer recommends public transport (metro to Ropsten + bus 204/211/212). Changing rooms, showers, and sauna are available indoors at Lidingövallen. Course surface: asphalt for the first 2.5 km, then gravel and trails; last 350 m on the running track. Distances are 5 km and 10 km; Kids' Spring Run for younger participants; water station at 5 km and water supplies at the finish; seeding for TCS Lidingöloppet.

name: Retrovarvet 2026
description: Retrovarvet is a running event held on Saturday, April 25, 2026, at Heden in Gothenburg. The gathering is at 07:45, and the event runs approximately from 07:45 to 09:00. Registration is open to club members and is done via the provided email; more information is available on the club's website and Facebook event.
course_highlights: Start and gathering at Heden in Gothenburg
Approximately 10 km (Trailvarvet test) to prepare for the Varvet race
Part of Gothenburg Half Marathon's spring training program focusing on warm-up and community
additional: Registration is only open to club members; the page indicates registration via email (premiarbanan1980@gmail.com) and that members should log in to the club's website. Gathering at Heden at 07:45. A Facebook event is linked from the event page. Contact details for the club's office are available on the contact page. Gathering at 07:45 at Heden; April 25, 2026; registration requires login and is for club members. Retrovarvet serves as a warm-up for the Gothenburg Half Marathon and is connected to spring training sessions and race preparation.

name: MRC Finspång Loop Trail Ultra
description: A tough and challenging low-key trail ultra on a 10 km lap course with 400 meters of elevation gain. Total distance over five laps is 50 km with 2000 meters of elevation gain. Technical trail on single track and animal trails in dramatic forest! Welcome
course_highlights: Very technical terrain on animal trails and narrow single tracks
Five loops of 10 km with approximately 400 m climb per loop (50 km / approximately 2000 m total)
Possible thin morning snow that thaws as the sun rises (seasonal conditions)
additional: More information is available on Instagram

name: Isaberg500
description:
Isaberg 500 is the race we love to run ourselves and forms the foundation of the entire trail weekend. A perfect mix of trails, hills, sweat, and tears reminiscent of spectacular races in our Swedish mountains as well as in the Alps of Europe. Isaberg 500 also features switchbacks, long delightful downhill sections, and stunning views. In between, you enjoy winding trail running through enchanting forests. Isaberg 500 offers at least 500 meters of elevation gain and is perfect for those training for mountain marathons and similar races.

NEW FOR 2025!
When Isaberg 500 started, Jättestigen was a big topic of discussion. A few years later, it was closed due to landslide risk. In 2025, Jättestigen will be revived under a new name - Jättetrappan...

Isaberg 500 is a part of Outnorth trailtour 2025.
course_highlights: Trail run with varied trails and hills, technical character reminiscent of mountain and alpine races
Multisport around Isabergstoppen: paddling, MTB, and trail running - categories for Solo and Duo
Isaberg Gravel: lap course approximately 45 km with start/finish in Åsenhöga; Elite/up to 50 years 3 laps, older/sporty 2 laps, recreational 1 lap
additional: Contact via GI: mobile +46 703 815 118 and email gimulti@gmail.com. Organizers: GI Folkestad and Martin Jepson. Opportunity to book guided cycling groups; organizers have ready-made routes that can be adapted to the group's needs. Main distance approximately 10.5 km (Trail Tour distance); Kids Trail approximately 2 km with about 150 meters of elevation gain; start time Sunday 12:00; location Isaberg/Anderstorp; contact niklas@isabergtrail.se.
