name: Vårruset (Jönköping)
description: Vårruset in Jönköping is part of Sweden's largest fitness tour for women and invites you to a cheerful and accessible evening run by Rocksjön in Knektaparken. The race is offered at 2.5 km and a certified 5 km course and welcomes both individual runners and team registrations. All participants receive a medal, bib, and finish bag, and teams of five are offered a picnic after crossing the finish line.
course_highlights: Course around Rocksjön in Knektaparken
Optional distances: 2.5 km or certified 5 km
Evening start in a park-like, natural environment (start at 18:30)
additional: Included in the individual registration: medal, finish bag, Vårruset music quiz + prizes, timing for 5 km* and bib. For team registration, a picnic after the finish line (team of 5 people), medal, finish bag, music quiz + prizes, and bib are included. It is possible to opt out of official timing for 5 km; the price remains the same regardless of timing. Recommended age: 5 km from 13 years (11 years with adult supervision); 2.5 km from 11 years (7 years with adult supervision). Registration is digital and can be completed until the race day, at least 1 hour before the first start. There is also a digital race (2.5 km or 5 km) conducted between May 4 and June 4 with medals sent by mail afterward; digital participants cannot participate on-site. Distances: 2.5 km or 5 km; team of five allows for a picnic; digital registration and option to opt out of timing; age recommendations: 5 km from 13 years (11 years with adult supervision), 2.5 km from 11 years (7 years with adult supervision).

name: Lindeborgs Nature Run
location: Lindeborgs Eco Retreat, Vrena, Södermanland, Sweden
description: Welcome to Lindeborgs Nature Run at Lindeborgs Eco Retreat – a personal trail race where nature, health, and sustainability are in focus. The race is built around a beautiful 5 km loop that leads through soft forests, open meadows, and over rocky outcrops with ancient remains. The course is open during a period so you can choose how many laps you want to run, and the event combines the running experience with meals from the farm kitchen and access to the farm's eco-pool, shower, and sauna. With only 120 spots in the first year, we aim to create a close, family-like atmosphere where each completed lap also generates a donation to the World Wildlife Fund (WWF).
course_highlights: 5 km loop through varied nature: soft forest, open meadows, and rocky outcrops with ancient remains
The race runs as an independent loop open between 10:30 and 13:00 – choose the number of laps yourself
Expansive views over the nature reserve and the natural farm environment around Lindeborgs Eco Retreat
additional: Date for the Nature Run weekend: April 25 – 26, 2026. Maximum 120 participants in the first year. For each lap completed, sponsors donate money to WWF. Light refreshments are served before the start and a warm organic lunch from the farm kitchen (farm-to-table) is offered after the finish. Participants have access to Lindeborgs eco-pool, shower, and sauna. Lindeborgs offers accommodation packages for those who want to extend their stay. Advice: wear weather-appropriate clothing; the course runs through forest and meadows and requires shoes suitable for terrain. Lindeborgs Eco Retreat offers a Nature Run weekend with accommodation packages (overnight stay, sauna, natural pool, breakfast, and a 3-course vegetarian dinner); booking via info@lindeborgs.com

name: Göteborg City Run 2026
description: Göteborg City Run is a cheerful and social city race taking place on April 25, 2026, offering approximately 6 km through Gothenburg's city center. The start is at 09:00 from Brofæstet on Gullbergs Strandgata, and the focus is on community rather than timing – everyone is encouraged to run, jog, or walk and have fun. Along the course, you will meet local members who offer activities and tastings, and after the finish, all participants receive a goodie bag and have a chance to win prizes in raffles.
course_highlights: Approximately 6 km through Gothenburg's city center
The course passes by and through certain buildings
Local members offer activities and tastings along the route
additional: Start and finish: Brofæstet, Gullbergs Strandgata 2. Start groups will be announced closer to the race. Photography will take place during the race. All participants receive a goodie bag and prizes are raffled. About 6 km course through Gothenburg's city center; start at 09:00; activities along the route; after-run goodie bag and raffles; focus on experience and community rather than timing.

name: Ältasjön Runt 2026
location: Älta IP, Älta, Nacka kommun, Stockholm County, Sweden
description: Ältasjön Runt is a family-friendly running race organized by Älta IF, typically held on the last Saturday of April (2026: 25/4). The race offers several distances for all ages - from 850 meters for the youngest to 13.4 km for those who want to run two laps around the lake. The goal is a local festival with a carnival atmosphere at Älta IP where both experienced runners, casual participants, and children should enjoy themselves. Many participants return year after year, which the organizing committee sees as a sign of a pleasant event.
course_highlights: The course goes around Ältasjön - one lap is 7.2 km
Start and finish at Älta IP in conjunction with a festival-like event
Multiple distances: 850 m (children 3 - 7 years), 2.5 km (children 7 - 15 years), 7.2 km (1 lap), and 13.4 km (2 laps)
additional: The event is family-friendly: 850 m for 3 - 7-year-olds (no timing, medals for participants), 2.5 km for 7 - 15-year-olds (timing but no prizes). 7.2 km corresponds to one lap around the lake and 13.4 km to two laps. The organizing committee invites everyone to a local festival at Älta IP, and many runners return annually. Registration is done via the link on the page; 850 m: 3 - 7 years without timing; 2.5 km: 7 - 15 years with timing but no prize distribution; 7.2 km and 13.4 km: timed longer distances; gathering for the 7 km race at 11:30 at Älta IP; start window 12:15 - 13:30; the 7 km race will also be offered with shirts in various sizes.

name: Kvantumloppet (Kvantumloppet med Trail 7+17km)
description: Kvantumloppet is Huddinge AIS Athletics' running festival at Källbrinks IP, open to all levels with both shorter recreational runs and technical trail options. The event offers a kids' class, recreational runs of 3 and 5 km, as well as trail runs of 7 and 17 km, welcoming both casual runners and more experienced trail runners. The course mostly runs on smaller forest paths and features sections of technical terrain with stones, roots, and steep inclines, as well as several scenic parts. Prizes are awarded to the fastest woman and man in several categories, and all finishers receive a medal.
course_highlights: Mostly runs on smaller forest paths, partly very technical with stones, roots, and steep inclines
Several scenic sections along the course
17 km follows Gömmaren's black/white trails "SKATAN"
additional: Date and location: April 26 at Källbrinks IP (Gamla Stockholmsvägen 91, Huddinge). Start times: Kids' class 700 m at 11:00; Trail 17 km at 11:10; Recreational 3 and 5 km at 12:00; Trail 7 km at 12:00. Prizes: Trophy for the first woman and man to finish in the 3 km, 5 km, and Trail 7 km and 17 km; medals for all finishers. Large prize table from ICA Kvantum Kungens Kurva where bib numbers serve as raffle tickets; award ceremony around 13:00; practical prizes and medals for the kids' class immediately after finishing. Organizer: Huddinge AIS (contact: pelle@huddingeais.se, phone 0706758799). Registration by April 19, 2026; team discount for at least 5 participants; bibs are picked up on race day; results available at kvantumloppet.se

name: Orion Trail
location: Ådalen, Jämjö, Karlskrona kommun, Blekinge län, Sverige
description: Orion Trail takes place in Ådalen in Jämjö outside Karlskrona in Blekinge. The race follows nature-rich trails along the river and passes a waterfall as well as a sea of wood anemones, and can be completed as running or walking. The organizer OK Orion welcomes participants to a scenic terrain experience on April 26, 2026. The event focuses on an easy to moderately challenging course in a beautiful environment near Karlskrona.
course_highlights: Trails along Ådalen and the river with varied terrain
Waterfall along the course
Wood anemones in springtime natural environment
additional: Booking is done via the MittLopp link. Trail running on trails in Ådalen; Facebook event: https://fb.me/e/1TyHBrexxh

name: Strömsnäs Trailrun
location: Graalstugan, Strömsnäsbruk, Ljungby kommun, Kronobergs län, Sverige
description: SK Graal invites you to the Strömsnäs Trailrun, a trail race held on April 26, 2026, starting and finishing at Graalstugan in Strömsnäsbruk. The courses mainly run on trails and forest roads, with sections of unpaved terrain in the forests around Strömsnäsbruk/Traryd. The event is open to both competitors and recreational runners, with electronic chip timing, and all finishers receive a medal. The race director and club will provide ongoing information via SK Graal's website.
course_highlights: Mainly runs on trails and forest roads
Sections through the forests around Strömsnäsbruk/Traryd, with some unpaved parts
Road crossings occur - traffic regulations apply
additional: Start and finish at Graalstugan. Pre-registration via the website by April 23 (payment can be made to bank transfer 879-0545, marked with name and birth year); late registration is only accepted on race day from 09:30 until 30 minutes before each start, payment via Swish or cash. Late registration fee varies on the website (+50 SEK or +60 SEK beyond the regular fee). Electronic timing with chip in the bib number (to be returned at the finish). Prizes for 1st to 3rd in each class, raffle prizes, and medals for all finishers; award ceremony around 12:30. Limited changing and shower facilities; cafeteria available at the finish. Clubs registering more than 3 participants can send a registration list to info@skgraal.se and will be invoiced afterward. Race director: Jonas Almarsson (contact details on the website). Sanctioned by the Swedish Athletics Association; start times generally between 11:00 and 14:00, start lists and results published on the website; late registration accepted on race day no later than 30 minutes before start; limited changing/shower facilities and cafeteria at the finish; participation at own risk.

description: Welcome to the Blood Race in Uppsala - a community event to raise awareness about vital blood donation. You can walk, jog, or run 5 km or 10 km, and there are also Little Blood Race and Special Race for other target groups. The event is organized by Upsala IF Athletics in collaboration with local blood centers and traditionally concludes with a communal picnic. Registration is open and you can sign up individually or as a team.
course_highlights: 10 km course will be officially measured
Estimated length for 5 km: approx. 4,950 m
Estimated length for 2.5 km (Little Blood Race): approx. 2,440 m
additional: The 10 km course is officially measured; other courses are not measured. Estimated course lengths: 5 km ≈ 4,950 m, 2.5 km ≈ 2,440 m. For group registrations, an Excel template is available for import in step 2 of the registration; contact uppsala@blodomloppet.se for assistance with the registration site or discount code. The blood donation gift is distributed at GeBlod’s blood trailer. Dog permission in walking class. Start at Gränby sports field near IFU Arena. An Excel template for group registration is available. Contact: uppsala@blodomloppet.se. The race is part of a national campaign to promote blood donation and raise awareness.

name: Vårruset — Norrköping
description: Spring Ruset in Norrköping is part of Sweden's largest sports tour for women and invites you to an evening at Himmelstalund starting near Stadium Arena. The race is offered at 2.5 km or a certified 5 km course and suits both recreational runners and those who want to compete. Registration can be done individually or as a team (teams of five people get a picnic after the finish), and the organizer is Tjalve OK in Norrköping. The start time for the 2026 event is Tuesday, May 26 at 19:00.
course_highlights: Optional distance: 2.5 km or certified 5 km
Start/finish area in Himmelstalund, next to Stadium Arena
Short, city-centered routes suitable for recreational runners
additional: Registration includes a medal, a finish bag, and a bib; timing is offered as an option (same price regardless of whether you choose timing or not). Team registration (5 people) includes a picnic after the finish. Recommended age: 13 years and older for 5 km (13+ in adult company from 11 years), 11 years and older for 2.5 km (7+ in adult company from 7 years). Registration is digital and can be done until race day, no later than 1 hour before the first start. Contact for local organizer: Tjalve OK (phone 0705-173173). Distances are 2.5 or 5 km; digital registration until race day, no later than 1 hour before the first start; after the finish, teams are offered a picnic; event area at Himmelstalund; option to opt out of timing in registration.

name: Trollhättan 5k - 2026
description: Warmly welcome to Trollhättan 5K - a city race in Trollhättan run on a certified and fast course. The 2026 race is the fifth edition on the established course, where the course record is very attractive for fast runners. The goal of the course is to offer a quick 5 km race suitable for those preparing for longer competitions and those aiming for their best on 5 km. The routes and invitation are published on the race page.
course_highlights: Certified 5 km course
Fast city race course suitable for personal bests
Routes and invitation linked from the race page (THN5K courses)
additional: Invitation: "Invitation Trollhättan 5K 2026 V1 260311" is published. The race manual (PM v1.0 250310) is provided and will be updated for 2026. The routes are accessible via a link (THN5K courses) that opens in a new window. The event date is 2026-04-26. The race is conducted on a controlled 5 km course (THN5K courses) and aims to give runners good opportunities for fast times and a solid preparation for upcoming competitions.

name: SpriT Frontyard - Staffanstorp (NY)
description: Welcome to SpriT Frontyard Staffanstorp on April 26, 2026. The race is a 1 km easy trail course (Light Trail) where participants run as many laps as they can on Truckstigen in Staffanstorp. The course is 100% trail with small technical paths and no large hills. The first lap is estimated at 10 minutes, the second at 9:40, the third at 9:20, with the possibility to reach a total of 20 km; water and soda are available at the lap point and after the finish. Registration is done via Sports Timing and places are limited.
course_highlights: 1 km easy trail course (Light Trail)
Run as many laps as you can - up to approximately 20 km
100% trail without large hills and with small technical paths

name: Vårruset — Karlstad
location: Mellan Sundstagymnasiet och Sundstabadet, Karlstad, Sweden
description: Spring Races in Karlstad is part of Sweden's largest fitness tour for women and offers a pleasant spring evening with distances of 2.5 km and 5 km. The race takes place in the area between Sundstagymnasiet and Sundstabadet and is suitable for those who want to walk, jog, or run. Registration can be done individually or as a team (a team of five people gets a picnic after finishing) and timing is optional during registration. The event is organized locally by IF Göta Karlstad in collaboration with Vårruset/Marathongruppen.
course_highlights: Distance options of 2.5 km or 5 km (5 km course is measured)
Event area between Sundstagymnasiet and Sundstabadet in Karlstad
Suitable for all levels - walk, jog, or run; timing is optional
additional: A medal, finish bag, Vårruset music quiz + prizes, bib number, and (for those who choose it) timing are included. Team registration (5 persons) includes a picnic after the finish; a team consists of five people, and all team members can run different distances. Recommended age: 5 km from 13 years (11 years with adult supervision), 2.5 km from 11 years (7 years with adult supervision). Registration is digital and can be done up until race day, no later than 1 hour before the first start. Local organizer: IF Göta Karlstad, phone 054-21 23 27, address Johan Banérs väg 5, 653 48 Karlstad. The distance runs between Sundstagymnasiet and Sundstabadet; registration is digital and binding no later than race day about 1 hour before the first start; age recommendation: 5 km from 13 years (11 years with adult supervision), 2.5 km from 11 years (7 years with adult supervision). Training sessions: April 15 and May 6 at 18:00 at Skutberget. Payment is only by card. Collaborates with the Childhood Cancer Foundation according to the Vårruset concept.

name: Gladsheim Finspångs Stadslopp
description: Gladsheim Finspångs Stadslopp is an annual fitness event starting and finishing in Bruksparken in Finspång, offering a 7 km city run through central parts of the city. The race welcomes walkers, joggers, and runners of all ages and also includes AktivRundan (approximately 3.8 km) and XL Bygg Lilla Slottsrundan for children. Participants receive a medal upon finishing, and the organizer offers energy products from sponsors. In 2026, the race will celebrate its 10th anniversary, and the course is lined with spectators and music to motivate runners and spectators.

AktivRundan approximately 3.8 km without timing for those who want to walk or jog
XL Bygg Lilla Slottsrundan children's race (approximately 1.7 km) with multiple starts from 17:00
additional: Start and finish in Bruksparken. Registration fee is paid via secure online payment; payment can also be made with Swish at the bib distribution. Online late registration from May 18 to 25 costs 395 SEK; late registration at bib distributions on May 26-27 costs 425 SEK. Medals and energy products from sponsors are handed out at the finish. Bibs are collected at Stora Coop Finspång/Viberga on Tuesday, May 26 from 15:00 to 19:00. At the bib distribution, you can also register and pay on site (Swish). Participants receive a medal, a finish bag, and a bib; timing is available as an option during registration and can be opted out of. Event area at Gustavsviksbadet

name: Änglamilen
description: Änglamilen is a historic running race in the heart of Ängelholm. Participants will experience the city, sea, and forest over the same mile. The 5 km race initially offers a lovely park run in the cozy Hembygdsparken. After approximately 2.7 km, the course crosses the Rönne River, continuing along the beautiful river walk in Nybroskogen. Finally, the course turns back over the river, where a sprint awaits before finishing at Tullakrok. Our 10 km course has the same start as the 5 km, but turns north after about a kilometer. Here, runners are treated to scenic views of Skälderviken and its harbor, with Kullaberg in the background. After approximately 7.7 km, the courses converge again, allowing runners to enjoy the beautiful river walk in Nybroskogen.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Tullakrok (just west of Hembygdsparken); start in the northern part and finish in the southern part
The course passes through cozy residential areas, lush greenery, and coastal sections along Rönneå
10 km has two water stations (at Hamnkrogen after 5 km and at Haradalsbron after 7.7 km); 5 km has a water station at Haradalsbron after 2.7 km

name: Nyårsloppet Vallentuna
description:
The New Year's Run is a perfect way to get active during the holiday season. Now in its 42nd year, Vallentuna Athletics invites you to run on New Year's Eve, attracting everyone from elite runners to those who prefer a more relaxed pace. A winter race can feature challenging terrain or fast asphalt; we won't know until race day. Keep an eye on weather forecasts and read our information. Statistically, the terrain has been favorable for running most years, as reflected in the results from previous years.

Above all, the New Year's Run is a pleasant way to come together to close out the old year and have something to talk about during the celebrations later in the day.

You're also welcome, see you there!
course_highlights: The course runs on paved park paths and roads in central Vallentuna
Race center and bib number pickup at Rosendalsskolan South
Winter conditions can vary (ice, slush, winter crisp, or fast asphalt)
additional: Remember that the New Year's Run is a winter race and the terrain can vary from year to year. Some years, studded shoes may be recommended.

name: Lerumsloppet 2025
description: Lerumsloppet is a traditional spring race organized by Lerum Athletics with various distances from 250 meters up to 10 kilometers, with the finish and competition center at Bagges Square in Lerum. The race is described as hilly and spectator-friendly, suitable for both recreational and competitive runners. Start and bib number distribution are centered around Brobacken / Bagges Square, and the organizer emphasizes good service with water stations, medical services, and changing and shower facilities close to the race area. A welcoming message on the page encourages registration via the partner EQ Timing and to register early for a lower entry fee.
course_highlights: Hilly 10 km course with the steep 'Kyrkbacken' and a long ascent up towards Laggarns road
Mixed terrain: flat asphalt sections along Säveån / Aspen and gravel roads around Stamsjön and Laggarns road
Beautiful views along Säveån / Aspen and passages through picturesque residential and rural areas
additional: Start for all courses takes place at Brobacken near the competition center at Bagges Square. Bibs can be collected on Friday evening (specified 17:00 - 20:00) at the municipal building on Bagges Square or on the morning of the race from 09:30; race confirmation will also be sent via SMS/email (for example, Friday 2/5 at 12:00 for late registrations). Changing and shower facilities are available in cooperation with Actic Vattenpalatset near the race center (bib must be shown at the reception). Approximately 55 marshals/route guards, bike marshals, and sweepers are used along the course. Water stations: Vattenpalatset (~2.5 km / 800 m for the 1.6 km course), Laggarns road (after ~5 km for the 10 km), and water immediately after the finish. Medical tents are located at the race center, and course officials carry first aid equipment. Lerumsloppet is a family-friendly community event with several distances for children and adults, with start lists and information available on government platforms and the official website.

description:

name: Taube-loppet - Bohusläns vackraste lopp
description:
People, running & community on the wonderful Flatön.
On August 23, 2025, we will hold the Taube Race for the fifth year in a row, and it will be the best year yet!
This year, in addition to music, food, and folk festival: 21 km, 10 km, 5 km, children's race of about 400 meters, and, new this year, a combo race of 36 km! That is, all races, excluding the children's race, in combination. We have had runners who have completed the distance in previous years, but now we formalize the distance. Regardless of your choice of distance, you are welcome to the most beautiful race in Bohuslän on Flatön!
The races run in beautiful Bohuslän archipelago environment in the spirit of Evert Taube. On beautiful Flatön at Malö, just north of Orust in Bohuslän, and through the singing of Evert Taube's Handelsman Flink, these races are held, along with food and entertainment at Flatö School. There is a ferry to the island from both north and south.
The race crosses the islands with beaches, forests, and fields along the route.
This year, there are only 150 exclusive spots for each race (half-marathon and 10 km) and 100 spots for the small Taube race and 25 spots for the combo race. First come, first served.
Registration for the children's race will open later, via www.taubeloppet.se.
For more information, see the event's website www.taubeloppet.se/
Start and finish at Flatö School.
The race is organized by Flatö Association. Timing is provided by ArenaTime.
course_highlights: Run in the Bohuslän archipelago environment in the spirit of Evert Taube
Crossing islands with beaches, forests, and fields
Limited spots: 150 for each of the 21 km and 10 km races, 100 for the children's race, and 25 for the combo race
Start and finish at Flatö School
Ferry access from north and south

ARENA
Flatö School, Flatön. Here you will pick up your bib and ask questions. The start and finish are here.

PARKING
Free parking on the grass areas at Flatö School, although limited in number, so try to carpool as much as possible. If you live on Malön, Flatön, or Ängön, we appreciate if you walk or cycle to the start. Follow signs and instructions from officials.

FERRY TO THE ISLAND
You reach Flatön by ferry from Orust (Fröjdendal) or from Skaftölandet (Dragsmark). The ferry takes only a few minutes and runs twice per hour during the day. Current timetable can be found here: Link

START
Outside Flatö School.
The race will be conducted in start groups. Final start times will be announced a few weeks before the start to registered participants. It is important to be in the starting pen when your group's start goes, as timing cannot be guaranteed otherwise.

FINISH
At Flatö Church, located 100 meters from Flatö School.

RACE OFFICE
Here you will pick up your bib and ask questions. The race office is at the Local History Museum at Flatö School.
Opening hours:
Friday 16:00–20:00
Saturday 10:00–19:00

BIB
The bib must be worn visibly on the chest. We provide safety pins, but you are welcome to bring your own – reusing is good! If you register by July 31, we will print your name on the bib, making it a personal memento and allowing the audience to call your name when they see you!

TOILETS
Available at Flatö School and Flatö Church, and after about 6 km at the Square.

BAG DROP
At the race office, you can leave your bag. Valuables are not the responsibility of the organizers. Labels are available in the bag you receive at the race office to attach to your bag.

OVERSHIRT
With your bib, you will receive a bag for your possible overclothes. Mark it with one of the labels you get when you pick up your bib, and leave it before the start at the race office.

BANANA
The route is marked with ribbons (orange for 21 km, blue for 10 km, and green for 5 km), arrows, and kilometer signs in the terrain. Some parts are rocky and possibly slippery (depending on high water levels, for example), so take care! There are easier sections later where you can stretch out and run.

TIMING
Electronic timing from ArenaTime, with a chip per runner, presented immediately after the race (and on taubeloppet.se after a day).

ENERGY STATIONS
It is important to hydrate and refuel early in the race! At our energy stations, you can recharge with energy drinks and water. Bananas, buns, and pickled cucumbers are other good options. After the race, food is available for purchase at Flatö School.

MAX TIME/REPEATS
At the energy stations, a rope is drawn at a specific time, indicating that you cannot continue the race after that. This is for your safety. If you pass the last rope in time, you can continue to the finish – it does not close until everyone is back!
We use the following times at energy stations:
Energy Station 1 (Björnsund)
Energy Station 2 (Kila)
Energy Station 3 (Lökebacken)
Energy Station 4 (Ängön)

DISQUALIFICATION
...littering along the route is strictly prohibited and will result in immediate disqualification. Trash bags are available at energy stations. Please sort your waste.

IF YOU HAVE HAD ENOUGH
If you need to withdraw from the race for any reason, go to the race office and inform the officials. This is important so that no search and rescue operation is initiated when you are actually relaxing in a jacuzzi.

FIRST AID/HEALTHCARE
First aid equipment and a nurse are available at the energy stations. Medical care is also available near Flatö School, along with a doctor. In case of serious accidents or illness, always call 112!

INSURANCE
For those who wish, the Startklar insurance can be purchased at this link. You can also read what coverage it includes.

PRIZE GIVING
Everyone who completes their race receives the Taube Race medal and diploma (the latter emailed in PDF format if desired). Prizes will also be awarded to the top three in each class in the form of a trophy made of Swedish crystal glass from our local sponsor LifeStone (women's and men's classes in all three distances, and children's classes in 10 km and 5 km races). We also give out nice raffle prizes from our other sponsors, and the award ceremony takes place on the stage at Flatö School after the race (see the final time for the award ceremony in the schedule).

AFTER RUN
Saturday afternoon is dedicated to a relaxing After Run with music in the spirit of Evert Taube and food at Flatö School. Food, sausages, and coffee are available.

RESULTS
Live results will be available on the website (ArenaTime).

PHOTOGRAPHY AND FILMING
We will have photographers on site taking both still and moving images for publication on our social media and websites. If you do not want to be photographed, please notify us at: taube-loppet@flaton.se. Include your name and which race it concerns. We will respect images where you are clearly identifiable, but not group shots where you are one of many participants. Those images will be permanently removed from our channels.
Furthermore, several webcams will be placed along the route, and these will be displayed on a projector at Flatö School and streamed.

REGISTRATION FEE
Like many other races, we have a tiered pricing system for the Taube Race distances. The earlier you register, the more time we have for preparations, medal purchases, timing equipment, volunteer booking, etc., and the lower the price.
December 1 – February 28: 21 km 395 SEK, 10 km 350 SEK, 5 km 225 SEK, Combo 595 SEK, Children's race 50 SEK
March 1 – May 31: 21 km 495 SEK, 10 km 450 SEK, 5 km 250 SEK, Combo 695 SEK, Children's race 50 SEK
June 1 – August 22: 21 km 595 SEK, 10 km 550 SEK, 5 km 300 SEK, Combo 795 SEK, Children's race 50 SEK
On-site registration August 23: 21 km 695 SEK, 10 km 650 SEK, 5 km 400 SEK, Combo 895 SEK, Children's race 50 SEK

CONTACT

If you have questions or concerns, we are available at taube-loppet@flaton.se

name: Fredsloppet
description: Fredsloppet is a peace and solidarity run in Sweden that combines running and walking activities with a message of peace and justice. The races are held in several locations across Sweden, including Umeå, and offer distances of 5 km and 10 km as well as walk categories and mini peace runs for children, making it accessible for both runners and families. Start times vary by location and results are published without strict timing requirements in some categories. The event encourages participants to start their own Fredslopp, and the proceeds go to peace and solidarity work.

name: Lejonbragden
description: The race takes place on an 8-shaped 10 km course, mostly paved bike and pedestrian path, passing the depot every 5 km. This is Sweden's oldest 100 km race! name: Tjejstafetten
organizer: Stiftelsen Tjejkraft Tillsammans och Tjejstafetten AB
description:
The Women's Relay is Sweden's first women's relay race at Stockholm Stadium.
But it is much more than that – it is a new way to make a difference.
Each participating team donates 500 SEK directly from the registration fee to nine organizations focused on women, which amounts to 100 SEK per person at each relay exchange. We call it charitable exchange rate.

Welcome to a folk festival filled with joy of movement and community!
additional:
Here's how it works:
You run in teams of 5 women, and it is you and your team who choose which class to participate in, and whether you will run, jog, or walk around the course.

The relay is divided into two classes:
- Recreational class 3 km per person without timing
- Competition class 5 km per person with timing.

Start, exchange, and finish inside Stockholm Stadium with lovely loops in Lill-Jansskogen.

Gather your team of 5 friends, family, or colleagues – register today!

name: Nordiska Mästarnas Backyard Ultra
description:
Location:
Fyskompaniet Training Center at Rattens gränd 1, Bromölla

Venue:
The venue is located adjacent to the entrance of Fyskompaniet. The area is paved; we will know in early October whether we can hold the event indoors in a large warehouse or outside on the asphalt in a large event tent. The start and finish will be outside on the asphalt area, where there is also the possibility to set up smaller tents.

Course:
The course is carefully assembled with the following surfaces to generate as many laps as possible and is currently suitable for 81 laps. Asphalt 2530m, Grass 152m, Path 1301m, Gravel/Field road 2700m, Wooden bridge 23m, with approximately 30 meters of elevation.
Trash bins are located at approximately 1 km, 3 km, and 6 km.
Please check the route on this YouTube video www.youtube.com/watch?v=GBX3idm2zDo; however, the start will differ slightly from the video depending on how we set the start in October. Additionally, the entire course is beautifully colored by the hues of autumn.
The entire course is marked with fabric ribbons with reflectors. The course is also marked with arrows at all junctions or where there may be uncertainty.

Energy Station:
There will always be a well-stocked energy station with water, sports drinks, food, snacks, and other items you might need for long-distance running.

We will also set up:

Dinner: after 17:00 per lap
Evening sandwich after 20:00 per lap
Breakfast: between 05:30-07:30 - from Sunday
Lunch: after 11:00 per lap - from Sunday
And so on... We always offer vegan and gluten-free options.

Changing rooms, showers, sauna, toilets:
The changing rooms are located close to the venue. There are spacious changing rooms for women and men with multiple showers and a sauna. Toilets are also available.
Toilets on the venue will be in the form of portable toilets, accessible before and after the start.

Start:
Saturday, October 11th at 10:00

Finish:
When the last runner completes their final lap

Rules:
We follow the official rules which can be found here ultrasignup.com/register.aspx?did=113992

Timing / Results:
Timing is done with a chip attached around the ankle. The time is registered at the lap portal after each completed lap.

Accommodation:
We have a couple of suggestions for those traveling from afar:

Hotell Iföhus
Approximately 1.3 km from the venue
hotellifohus.se/

Bromölla Camping & Hostel
Approximately 0.8 km from the venue
bromollacamping.se/

There is no possibility to camp on the event site.

Spectators:
Feel free to come and cheer on your friends; the easiest way is to follow them from the start area. It is also a pleasant environment near Käsebron or along the northern parts along Lilla Kungsleden.

Race Management:
Jimmy Schön: 076 105 73 77
Anna Schön: 073 355 64 68
Email: tavling@fyskompaniet.se

description:
Gävle Advent Race is the winter city race that everyone can participate in, young and old, slow and fast.
With this race, we want to inspire running joy even during our colder months!

The start is located below the mini-golf course, then the race goes through the beautiful Boulognerskogen and ends at Boulognerskogen café where we serve hot juice and gingerbread cookies.
Prizes are awarded to the top finishers in each category, and there is also a raffle for nice prizes among all participants.

uddloppet.ifudd.se

10 km (11:00)

Children's race 400 m (10:30)
Walking class 2.5 km (between 09:00-13:00)

uddloppet.ifudd.se

name: STHLM Trail Marathon
description:
Warmly welcome to the second edition of STHLM TRAIL MARATHON
All races take place on a very beautiful, approximately 15 km long course. Each lap will offer you nearly 500 meters of elevation gain. Expect great views and a challenging run, mostly in hilly terrain, mostly on trails, sometimes unpaved but also on a couple of gentler sections where you can stretch out and run for a few hundred meters.

New for 2026
•	Start line already in April! This time we are running in early spring, so mark April 18th in your calendar now.
•	Kids Trail, a free race for our younger runners (born 2014 or later).
•	Hjärnloppet, a virtual race lasting 18 days where the entire registration fee goes directly to the Brain Foundation and vital research on epilepsy.
•	Course preview runs. On two occasions, we will run through the first and second parts of the course.
•	Virtual running sessions in the Heyey app to ensure you stay in shape all the way to the start line in April.

What is not new for 2026
•	The course, a tough and very beautiful trail around Flatensjön.
•	Sprint and Ultra, two trail races that challenge you a bit extra.
•	Grit, the ultimate test which we do not believe anyone can complete. Prove us wrong, and you will earn both fame and fortune, as well as some prize money.
course_highlights: Approximately 15 km per lap (loop)
About 500 meters of elevation gain per lap
Challenging and beautiful trail around Flatensjön

name: Österlen Spring Trail
description: Österlen Spring Trail was started in 2015 and can be described as a recreational race where nature, community, and experience are in focus, while performance and time are secondary. The race offers a fantastic opportunity for all runners, regardless of level, to participate in three distances: 60 km (Simris Alg Ultra), 30 km (Duo Trail), and 22 km (Teleservice trail). It takes place in the beautiful nature around Christinehof Castle in Andrarum, Skåne County, and has an elevation gain of 500 meters.
course_highlights: Trail on Österlen's paths - varied trail terrain around Simrishamn/Österlen
Alunbruket passages (passed twice on several distances)
Start/finish and some limited gathering points at, for example, Christinehof Castle (14 km)
additional: Equipment and safety requirements are specified per distance: for example, a windproof jacket or first aid blanket, energy, mobile phone (with sufficient battery) for 14 km; own mug/drink container (no disposable cup) and UMARA water/sports drink for 22 km; for 60 km, waterproof/warm gear (jacket >10,000 mm), extra clothes, extra energy, and the possibility to leave a drop bag at Bengtemölla (around 32 km). Medical personnel are stationed at stations and finish lines (number and placement are specified in the respective runner's PM). Registration opens according to the website on Saturday, October 25 at 08:00. The registration opens on Saturday, October 25 at 08:00 according to the registration page.
